pmid-6250719.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で処理したF9奇形癌幹細胞が、ジブチリルcAMPによって体壁内胚葉様の細胞へ分化することを示しました。誘導された細胞はラミニンやIV型コラーゲンなどを産生します。薬剤を除去しても分化状態は維持されました。
pmid-6250719.summary_en: This study shows that F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells treated with retinoic acid can be converted into parietal endoderm by dibutyryl cAMP. The induced cells synthesize plasminogen activator, laminin, and type IV collagen, and show low alkaline phosphatase and lactate dehydrogenase. Their phenotype matches definitive parietal endoderm. The differentiated state persists without continued drug exposure, and cAMP agents act only on cells pretreated with retinoic acid.

pmid-6251723.summary_ja: 治療後1年以上経過してから妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍が再発した2例を報告しています。両例とも非転移性で、再発前2〜3年間は血清hCG値が陰性でした。見かけ上治療が成功した後も、長期のフォローアップが必要であると強調しています。
pmid-6251723.summary_en: This report describes two patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia who relapsed more than one year after apparently successful therapy. Both had nonmetastatic disease, were clinically disease-free, and had negative serum beta-hCG titers for two to three years before recurrence. The authors emphasize the need for prolonged follow-up monitoring of patients even after apparently successful treatment and long periods of negative hCG results.

pmid-6251724.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者20例で甲状腺機能を評価しました。広範な転移を伴う絨毛癌の2例が明らかな甲状腺中毒症を示し、血清hCG値は極めて高値でした。甲状腺刺激活性はhCG値と密接に相関し、絨毛癌に伴う甲状腺中毒症の原因はhCG自身の甲状腺刺激作用であると結論づけています。
pmid-6251724.summary_en: This study evaluated thyroid function in 20 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Two patients with widely metastatic choriocarcinoma were overtly thyrotoxic and had very high serum hCG levels. Thyroid-stimulating activity in serum and urine correlated closely with hCG levels and had the biologic characteristics of purified hCG. The authors conclude that the thyrotropic activity intrinsic to hCG causes choriocarcinoma-associated thyrotoxicosis.

pmid-6251725.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患のモニタリング用マーカーとして妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク(SP1)を評価しました。非転移性の病変では、SP1とhCGの減少曲線はよく一致しました。転移性絨毛癌の3例中2例では、hCGが低下する一方でSP1は横ばいまたは上昇しました。
pmid-6251725.summary_en: This study evaluates pregnancy-specific beta 1-glycoprotein (SP1) as a marker for monitoring trophoblastic disease. In patients with post-molar pregnancy and nonmetastatic disease, SP1 and hCG regression curves closely paralleled each other. In metastatic choriocarcinoma, SP1 and hCG patterns were discordant in two of three patients, with SP1 plateauing or rising while hCG fell. The authors suggest SP1 may give additional information beyond hCG, but its role is incompletely defined.

pmid-6252781.summary_ja: 等電点電気泳動と放射免疫測定法を用いて、血清hCGの等電点不均一性を比較しました。正常妊娠、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎では同じ7つの成分が見られました。絨毛癌の血清にのみ、等電点3.2、3.5、3.7の3成分が追加で認められました。
pmid-6252781.summary_en: This study compares the isoelectric heterogeneity of serum hCG in normal pregnancy and trophoblastic disease using isoelectric focusing and radioimmunoassay. Normal pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, and invasive mole all showed the same seven hCG components. Sera from patients with choriocarcinoma contained three additional components with isoelectric points of 3.2, 3.5, and 3.7. The authors suggest these choriocarcinoma-specific components could support a new diagnostic test for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6253107.summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍の免疫組織化学で、早期胎盤・胞状奇胎・絨毛癌の合胞栄養膜にLRF様物質を認めた。妊娠中の志願者10名に外因性LRFを投与したが、2時間の経過中に血清の絨毛性ゴナドトロピンや他の胎盤性蛋白の濃度に変化はなかった。正常および悪性栄養膜におけるその意義は今後の検討課題とされた。
pmid-6253107.summary_en: This study used immunoperoxidase staining to detect luteinizing hormone-releasing factor (LRF)-like material in the syncytiotrophoblast of early placenta, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma. It then tested exogenous LRF in ten pregnant volunteers, finding no change in serum levels of chorionic gonadotropin or other placental proteins over 2 hours. The authors conclude that the significance of LRF-like material in normal and malignant trophoblast remains unclear and requires further study.

pmid-6254188.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎や絨毛癌に由来する転移性栄養膜疾患が原因で、くも膜下出血を起こした2症例を報告した。悪性転化は主に妊娠後1年以内に起こるため、胞状奇胎後はフォローアップと妊娠回避が重要とされる。血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の持続高値が指標となり、絨毛癌は胞状奇胎より予後が不良である。文献的考察も含む。
pmid-6254188.summary_en: Two women presented with subarachnoid hemorrhage caused by metastatic trophoblastic disease, a complication of molar pregnancy or choriocarcinoma. The authors emphasize that malignant transformation can occur at any time, most often within a year of pregnancy, so close follow-up and pregnancy prevention are important. Persistent serum hCG elevation is a key indicator, and chemotherapy and irradiation give a good prognosis for persistent molar disease but a less favorable one for choriocarcinoma. The report includes a review of the literature.

pmid-6254740.summary_ja: 子宮の絨毛性偽腫瘍の症例を報告した。掻爬および子宮摘出標本の誤った解釈により、不要な手術と化学療法が行われた。絨毛癌との鑑別に役立つ組織学的基準を強調し、ホルモン産生と掻爬後数か月にわたる腫瘍の持続も記録している。悪性腫瘍に似る胎盤部位病変の典型例である。
pmid-6254740.summary_en: This case report describes a trophoblastic pseudotumor of the uterus, initially misinterpreted on curettage and hysterectomy specimens, which led to unnecessary surgery and chemotherapy. The paper emphasizes histologic criteria that distinguish this lesion from choriocarcinoma. The authors also document hormone production and persistence of the tumor for months after curettage, illustrating how these placental-site lesions can mimic malignancy.

pmid-6255743.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患の19例の血清を用い、妊娠特異的β1グリコプロテイン(SP1)の分子的不均一性を交差免疫電気泳動で示した。絨毛癌の1症例では、SP1を消費する因子が検出され、硫酸アンモニウムで沈殿した。血中SP1の定量への影響と、病勢モニタリングでの解釈が議論されている。
pmid-6255743.summary_en: Sera from 19 patients with trophoblastic disease were analyzed by immunoelectrophoresis using antisera against pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein (SP1). Crossed immunoelectrophoresis revealed molecular heterogeneity of SP1. A factor that consumes SP1 was identified in a patient with choriocarcinoma and was precipitated with ammonium sulfate. The authors discuss implications for quantifying circulating SP1 in trophoblastic disease, which may affect how the marker is interpreted during disease monitoring.

pmid-6256264.summary_ja: 和歌山県の栄養膜性疾患登録制度に基づき342例を解析した研究（1972〜1977年）。胞状奇胎が81.3%、侵入奇胎が8.2%、絨毛癌が5.3%を占めた。胞状奇胎の16.5%が悪性合併症を生じ、40歳以上で頻度が特に高かった。疫学的検討の重要性を強調している。
pmid-6256264.summary_en: Retrospective registry analysis of 342 trophoblastic disease cases in Wakayama, Japan (1972 to 1977). Hydatidiform moles comprised 81.3%, invasive moles 8.2%, choriocarcinoma 5.3%, and transitional moles 3.5%. Malignant complications developed in 16.5% of molar pregnancies, with a markedly higher frequency in women over 40. The authors emphasize that epidemiologic study of trophoblastic disease can yield important data.

pmid-6261041.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌細胞株の胚外内胚葉への分化に伴うヒストンH1A/H1B比とヌクレオソーム反復長の変化を解析した研究。胚性癌細胞ではH1A/H1B比が高く、分化した内胚葉では低下する。一方、ヌクレオソーム反復長と基底膜糖タンパク質やプラスミノーゲン活性化因子などの分化機能との単純な相関は認められなかった。
pmid-6261041.summary_en: Compares histone composition and nucleosome repeat length in murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines (F9.22, PSA1), primary extra-embryonic endoderm derived from PSA1 EC differentiation, and long-term endodermal lines. The H1A/H1B ratio shifts markedly during differentiation: EC cells showed 1.49 or greater, versus less than 0.9 for endoderm. Nucleosome repeat length varies between states, but the authors find no simple correlation with differentiated functions such as basement membrane glycoprotein expression and plasminogen activator activity.

pmid-6263807.summary_ja: ラット胚性癌由来株F3/1は、C型ウイルス粒子を産生しないため同系宿主で非免疫原性であった。内在性マウスC型ウイルスの重感染によりMSVゲノムが救済され、MSVを放出する産生株F3/1-Pへ変換された。F3/1-Pは同系動物で強い免疫原性を示し、潜在性ウイルスゲノムの活性化により腫瘍の免疫原性を変えうることを示唆している。
pmid-6263807.summary_en: Describes a rat embryonal carcinoma-derived cell line (F3/1) that is non-immunogenic in syngeneic hosts because it does not produce C-type virions. Superinfection with endogenous mouse C-type virus rescued the murine sarcoma virus genome, converting the line into a producer (F3/1-P) that releases MSV and became strongly immunogenic in syngeneic animals. The study suggests that non-immunogenic tumors may be converted to immunogenic ones by activating dormant viral genomes with a helper virus.

pmid-6263992.summary_ja: 大阪大学病院で18年間に治療した卵巣腫瘍504例の臨床病理学的検討。大半は良性の嚢胞性腫瘍で、類皮嚢腫が191例を占めた。若年者では未分化胚細胞腫と胎児性癌が多く、悪性卵巣腫瘍の予後は概して不良であった。
pmid-6263992.summary_en: Clinicopathologic review of 504 ovarian tumors treated at Osaka University Hospital over 18 years. Most were benign cystic tumors, including 191 dermoid cysts. Among malignant tumors, dysgerminomas and embryonal carcinomas were common in young patients. Malignant transformation of dermoid cysts was rare and occurred in older women. Bilaterality was more frequent in malignant tumors (20%). Marker substances aided diagnosis and follow-up, and malignant tumors were treated with radical surgery and chemotherapy, though prognosis was generally poor.

pmid-6263994.summary_ja: 1971〜1976年に治療された侵入奇胎39例を検討した研究。手術（病巣切除または子宮全摘）と化学療法がそれぞれ約80%に施行された。治療後に11例で計14回の妊娠があり、2例が自然流産、1例が奇胎妊娠であった。絨毛癌を2例に生じたが、いずれも寛解している。
pmid-6263994.summary_en: Reviews 39 invasive mole patients treated at one clinic between 1971 and 1976. Surgery was performed in 79.5% (focal removal or hysterectomy) and chemotherapy in 79.5%. Invasive lesions were uterine, with variable myometrial invasion depth. Fourteen pregnancies occurred in 11 patients afterward, including two spontaneous abortions and one molar pregnancy. Two patients developed choriocarcinoma, both in remission, and 37 patients were healthy at the time of reporting.

pmid-6263995.summary_ja: 人工妊娠中絶2,433例、流産695例、正期産1,724例、胞状奇胎43例を対象に、妊娠終了後の尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の消退を検討した研究。消退は正期産で最も速く、胞状奇胎で最も遅かった。3〜8年のフォローアップで悪性合併症は認められず、hCG測定が奇胎後絨毛癌の予防に有用であることを示唆している。
pmid-6263995.summary_en: Examines urinary hCG regression after termination of various pregnancies: 2,433 induced abortions, 695 spontaneous abortions, 1,724 term deliveries, and 43 hydatidiform moles. hCG regression was fastest after term delivery and slowest in hydatidiform mole, and was slower when trophoblast gestational age was younger. No malignant sequelae were observed during 3 to 8 years of follow-up, supporting the role of hCG monitoring in preventing postmolar choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6263999.summary_ja: 1971〜1978年に血清hCG値で経過観察した栄養膜性疾患の臨床経過を解析。胞状奇胎178例のうち20例が掻爬後に侵入奇胎または絨毛癌へ進展した。侵入奇胎・絨毛癌59例では、化学療法を追加しなかった3例に再発がみられたが、追加した40例には再発がなかった。寛解の判定基準を提示している。
pmid-6263999.summary_en: Analyzes clinical courses of trophoblastic disease monitored by serum hCG from 1971 to 1978. Of 178 hydatidiform mole cases, 20 progressed to invasive mole or choriocarcinoma after curettage. Among 59 invasive mole and choriocarcinoma cases, hCG normalized after treatment; recurrence occurred in 3 patients without additional chemotherapy but in none of 40 who received it. Remission criteria are defined: hCG at the LH level for hydatidiform mole, and no cellular effect after two chemotherapy courses for malignant disease.

pmid-6283861.summary_ja: 1980年、ナイジェリア・ザリアの病院で6年間に診察された奇形腫132例を検討した。成人例の大半は良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫で、悪性転化は3例、卵巣甲状腺腫は4例だった。精巣および仙尾部奇形腫は極めてまれで、後者は卵黄嚢腫瘍と再分類された。
pmid-6283861.summary_en: This 1980 hospital-based study from Zaria, Nigeria reviewed 132 teratomas over six years. Most extragonadal tumours occurred in children, while among 105 adult tumours, 94 were benign cystic ovarian teratomas, mainly in the third and fourth decades. Malignant transformation occurred in three benign ovarian teratomas, and four struma ovarii cases were identified. Testicular and sacrococcygeal teratomas were rare, and the latter was reclassified as an endodermal sinus tumour.

pmid-6449607.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の小児25例(卵黄嚢腫瘍20例、奇形腫5例)を後方視的に検討した。先天奇形は卵黄嚢腫瘍3例と成熟奇形腫1例で認められ、後大静脈尿管、膀胱憩室、ダウン症候群、同側鼠径ヘルニアがみられた。精巣腫瘍の小児では先天異常の有無を注意深く診察すべきと結論している。
pmid-6449607.summary_en: This retrospective study examined congenital anomalies in 25 children with testicular germ cell tumours, including 20 yolk sac tumours and five teratomas. Anomalies were found in three yolk sac tumour patients and one patient with mature teratoma. Observed defects included retrocaval ureter, bladder diverticulum, Down syndrome and ipsilateral inguinal hernia. The authors recommend that children with testicular tumours be carefully examined for congenital abnormalities.

pmid-6453912.summary_ja: 絨毛癌培養上清に含まれる免疫抑制物質の性質を検討した研究である。hCGに依存せず、抗原非特異的サプレッサーT細胞を介して混合リンパ球反応や抗体産生を抑制した。作製した抗血清は絨毛癌細胞と正常栄養膜細胞に反応し、抑制活性を中和した。絨毛癌の栄養膜細胞が母体の免疫攻撃を逃れる機構が示唆された。
pmid-6453912.summary_en: This 1980 Japanese study examined an immunosuppressive substance released by choriocarcinoma culture fluid. The fluid suppressed mixed lymphocyte reactions, antibody production, and allo-killer induction independently of hCG, acting through antigen-nonspecific suppressor T cells. A rabbit antiserum against the fraction reacted with choriocarcinoma cells and normal trophoblast and neutralized the suppression. The authors propose that choriocarcinoma trophoblasts escape maternal immune attack through this mechanism.

pmid-6775725.summary_ja: 腫瘍の臨床的・画像的徴候がない精巣悪性腫瘍治療後の患者で血清ホルモン値を測定した1980年の研究である。LHは15%、FSHは50%で上昇し、特に放射線療法や化学療法後に顕著だった。テストステロンは多くの患者で低値を示し、併用化学療法中に著明に低下したが、治療終了後に可逆的に回復した。
pmid-6775725.summary_en: This 1980 study measured serum hormone levels in patients treated for malignant testicular tumours who had no clinical or radiological evidence of tumour. LH rose in 15% and FSH in 50%, particularly after radiotherapy or chemotherapy. Testosterone was low in most hemicastrated patients, and during combination chemotherapy it fell markedly but recovered after treatment. Oestradiol and prolactin rose slightly to moderately.

pmid-6777031.summary_ja: ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍3株をヌードマウスに継代移植し、形態と機能を検討した1980年の研究である。移植腫瘍の超微細構造は原発巣と一致したが、管状構造が主体となった。腫瘍株ごとに異なる成人型血漿タンパク質やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を産生し、その産生は継代間で安定していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍は正常組織の蛋白産生機能をほぼ保持していると示唆された。
pmid-6777031.summary_en: This 1980 study serially transplanted three human yolk sac tumours into nude mice and characterised them morphologically and functionally. Transplants showed mainly tubular structures with less endodermal sinus architecture, though ultrastructure matched the originals. Transplanted tumours produced adult-type plasma proteins and AFP, and the set of proteins varied by tumour line but remained stable across passages. Immunoelectron microscopy localised these proteins to the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi, suggesting near-complete retention of normal protein-producing function.

pmid-6781377.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の治療を受けた患者の血清ペプチドホルモンを検討した1980年の研究である。治療後にLHやFSHが変化し、TSH上昇を伴う代償性甲状腺機能低下症や、プロスタグランジンF2αの上昇がみられた。ホルモン評価では、治療後の正常な変化と内分泌活性腫瘍の再発を区別する必要があると述べている。
pmid-6781377.summary_en: This 1980 study assessed serum peptide hormones in patients treated for testicular tumours. Treatment caused significant changes in LH and FSH, sometimes with compensated hypothyroidism marked by raised TSH, and prostaglandin F2 alpha levels rose after therapy regardless of stage. Patients often reported impotence and infertility during follow-up. The authors stress that hormonal interpretation must distinguish normal post-treatment changes from recurrence of an endocrine-active tumour, and that some impotence arises from primary testicular damage rather than recurrence.

pmid-6893396.summary_ja: 精巣に生じた組織学的に非典型的なセミノーマの症例報告です。腫瘍は篩状の胞巣構造を示し、典型的なリンパ球浸潤を欠く線維性間質に囲まれていました。超微細構造は古典的セミノーマと区別できませんでした。腹部転移を伴う大きな腫瘍でしたが化学療法に良好に反応し、初回治療後4年の時点で腫瘍は認められていません。
pmid-6893396.summary_en: This report describes a histologically atypical testicular seminoma with a cribriform, nested growth pattern and sclerosing fibrous bands lacking typical lymphoid infiltrates. Ultrastructural features matched classic seminoma. Despite a large tumor and abdominal metastases, the patient responded favorably to chemotherapy and remained tumor-free four years after initial therapy. The case highlights that seminoma variants may lack the usual lymphocytic infiltrate, which could complicate diagnosis.

pmid-6929907.summary_ja: 77歳男性に生じた、上顎歯肉への絨毛癌転移の症例報告です。原発巣の病勢は入院時から急速で、診断は口腔内生検で確定しました。このような転移形式は極めてまれで、原発巣の同定が困難だった点が特徴です。歯肉病変が未同定の悪性腫瘍の初発徴候となりうることを示しています。
pmid-6929907.summary_en: This case report describes choriocarcinoma metastatic to the maxillary gingiva in a 77-year-old man. The primary disease was fulminant from admission, and the diagnosis was established through oral biopsies. The authors highlight the rarity of this metastatic pattern, the patient's age and race, and the difficulty in identifying a primary site. The report emphasizes that gingival involvement can be the first presentation of an otherwise unidentified malignancy.

pmid-6930148.summary_ja: 悪性縦隔奇形腫から樹立されたヒト細胞株の報告です。細胞は軽度に異型性のある線維芽細胞様で、倍加時間は24時間でした。幹細胞系は過三倍体で78本の染色体を持ちました。多くの核型で7個の共通マーカー染色体が見られました。原腫瘍には複数の組織成分があったにもかかわらず線維芽細胞様の細胞が優勢となった理由も考察されています。
pmid-6930148.summary_en: This 1980 report describes an established human cell line derived from a malignant mediastinal teratoma. The cells were slightly atypical fibroblast-like, doubled every 24 hours, and had a hypertriploid karyotype with a stemline of 78 chromosomes. Most karyotypes shared seven marker chromosomes, with additional low-frequency markers. The authors discuss why fibroblastic cells dominated despite the original tumor containing multiple tissue types, suggesting that fibroblasts grow readily in culture.

pmid-6931103.summary_ja: 再発した卵巣奇形癌患者の腹水細胞から樹立された細胞株PA Iの特性を報告した研究です。初期継代は異数性でしたが、後期継代は二倍体核型を示し胎児性癌細胞に類似しました。後期の細胞は胎児性癌の核とエンドダーム様の外層からなる胚様体を形成しました。ヒト発生機構の研究モデルとしての有用性が示唆されています。
pmid-6931103.summary_en: This 1980 Int J Cancer study characterizes PA I, a cell line derived from ascitic fluid of a patient with recurrent ovarian teratocarcinoma. Early passages were aneuploid, while later passages showed a diploid karyotype and resembled embryonal carcinoma cells. Late-passage cells formed embryoid bodies with an embryonal carcinoma core and endoderm-like rind, and showed limited differentiation in vitro. The authors propose PA I as a model for studying human developmental mechanisms.

pmid-6931966.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の体外分化過程から分離された、初の骨形成細胞株の報告です。同系マウスへの皮下注射で、軟骨基質を経て形成される骨小体が生じました。骨小体は非悪性で約2週間後に増殖を停止しました。特定条件下では骨肉腫などの腫瘍が生じ、そこから新たな細胞株が樹立されています。
pmid-6931966.summary_en: This 1980 Nature article reports the first bone-forming cell line, isolated from in vitro differentiating teratocarcinoma (embryonal carcinoma) cells. Subcutaneous injection into syngeneic mice produced ossicles that formed via a cartilage intermediate and were colonized by host marrow. The ossicles were non-malignant and stopped growing after about two weeks. Under certain conditions, osteosarcomas, chondroosteosarcomas, and fibrosarcomas arose, from which further cell lines were established.

pmid-6932211.summary_ja: 1980年の報告で、子宮内妊娠に併存した絨毛癌の2症例を提示している。既報28例を文献的にレビューし、初発症状の形式、母体の生存率、発症機序について検討した。妊娠と絨毛癌の併存はまれであり、本論文は絨毛癌の臨床像と母体予後を把握するための歴史的な臨床参考文献である。
pmid-6932211.summary_en: This 1980 report describes two cases of choriocarcinoma coexisting with an intrauterine pregnancy. The authors review 28 previously published cases, examining mode of presentation, maternal survival, and proposed pathogenesis. Coexistence of choriocarcinoma with pregnancy is rare, and the review gives an overview of how these tumors present and what outcomes mothers experience. It is a historical clinical reference for gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6932851.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、精巣腫瘍患者の血清プロラクチン値を測定した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の11例中7例で高値を示し、特に転移性疾患で顕著だった。セミノーマ症例ではほぼ正常範囲だった。非セミノーマ性腫瘍2例では、プロラクチンとhCGが並行して推移し臨床経過をよく反映した。血清プロラクチンは非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の補助的な腫瘍マーカーとなり得ると結論づけている。
pmid-6932851.summary_en: This 1980 study measured serum prolactin in patients with testicular tumors. Prolactin was elevated in 7 of 11 patients with non-seminomatous tumors, especially those with metastatic disease, while seminoma patients were largely normal. In two non-seminomatous patients, prolactin and hCG levels changed in parallel and tracked clinical course. The authors suggest serum prolactin may serve as an additional tumor marker for non-seminomatous testicular tumors, complementing established markers such as hCG.

pmid-6935496.summary_ja: 1980年の症例報告で、精巣由来と推定される胚細胞癌の男性患者に、診断後9か月以内に急性リンパ性白血病が発症した経過を記述している。両腫瘍の関係の可能性について考察している。胚細胞腫瘍患者は生存期間の延長に伴い二次がんのリスクが高まる可能性があるため、継続的な経過観察の必要性を強調している。
pmid-6935496.summary_en: This 1980 case report describes acute lymphocytic leukemia that developed within nine months of diagnosis in a man with germ cell carcinoma of presumed testicular origin. The authors discuss possible relationships between the two neoplasms. They also emphasize the need for ongoing surveillance of patients with germ cell tumors, since improved survival means these patients live longer and may face a higher risk of developing a second cancer.

pmid-6968677.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、絨毛癌由来のヒト細胞株JEG-3におけるプロゲステロン産生に対する上皮成長因子（EGF）の作用を検討している。EGFは時間および用量依存的にプロゲステロン産生を促進した。さらにコレステロールへのアセテート取り込みを増加させ、コレステロール合成の亢進がその機序である可能性を示した。臨床管理ではなく、絨毛癌細胞モデルを用いた基礎内分泌研究である。
pmid-6968677.summary_en: This 1980 study examines the effect of epidermal growth factor (EGF) on progesterone production in JEG-3, a clonal strain of human choriocarcinoma cells. EGF stimulated progesterone output in a time- and dose-dependent manner. It also increased incorporation of radiolabeled acetate into cholesterol, suggesting that enhanced cholesterol synthesis is the mechanism by which EGF boosts progesterone production. The work is basic endocrine research using a choriocarcinoma cell model rather than clinical management.

pmid-6969322.summary_ja: 手術で切除したヒトセミノーマ組織に浸潤したリンパ球を分離し、純粋型精巣セミノーマの患者7例の末梢血と表面マーカーを比較した。T細胞およびIgG Fc受容体を有するT細胞サブセットは腫瘍組織で増加したが、B細胞の割合は変化しなかった。このリンパ球浸潤がセミノーマの良好な予後に寄与している可能性を指摘している。
pmid-6969322.summary_en: This study isolated lymphocytes infiltrating surgically resected human seminoma tissue and compared their surface marker profile with peripheral blood from seven patients with pure testicular seminoma. T cells and an IgG Fc receptor-bearing T-cell subset were increased in tumor tissue relative to blood, while B cell proportions were unchanged. The authors suggest this lymphocytic infiltration may contribute to the favorable prognosis typically seen in seminoma.

pmid-6988611.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍97例中、血清SP1高値の13例を対象に免疫組織化学を行った1980年の研究。SP1は絨毛癌や胎児性癌で合胞体栄養膜細胞に局在した。絨毛癌3/4例、胎児性癌4/5例で陽性であり、腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性が示唆された。奇形癌は2/4例で陽性だった。
pmid-6988611.summary_en: This 1980 study measured pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein (SP1) in sera and tumor tissue from patients with testicular germ cell tumors. Thirteen of 97 patients with elevated serum SP1 underwent immunoperoxidase staining. SP1 localized to syncytiotrophoblastic cells in choriocarcinoma, placenta, and some embryonal carcinoma and teratocarcinoma cases. Tissue positivity was found in 3 of 4 choriocarcinomas, 4 of 4 placentas, 4 of 5 embryonal carcinomas, and 2 of 4 teratocarcinomas. The findings suggest SP1 may serve as a tumor marker reflecting trophoblastic differentiation within germ cell tumors.

pmid-6989095.summary_ja: 妊娠中期に羊水過多・胎児死亡を伴った仙尾部奇形腫の2症例を報告した1980年の論文。両例とも胎盤が著明に肥大していた。腫瘍が動静脈瘻のように働き、胎児の前方不全を起こしたと推測している。大きな絨毛血管腫でも同様の現象が見られることがあり、2例に基づく病態仮説の提示が中心である。
pmid-6989095.summary_en: This two-case report describes pregnancies complicated by hydramnios, fetal death, and sacrococcygeal teratoma in the second trimester. In both cases the placenta was markedly enlarged. The authors propose that the tumors acted like arteriovenous fistulas, causing forward failure in the fetus, a mechanism similar to that seen with large chorangiomas. The paper links fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma with placental hypertrophy and fetal circulatory compromise, offering a pathophysiologic hypothesis based on two patients.

pmid-6990747.summary_ja: 23歳女性の原発性胃絨毛癌の症例報告。腹痛と著明な肝腫大で発症し、血清CEAと血清・尿中β-hCGが著増していた。免疫染色で腫瘍細胞にCEAとhCGが確認され、β-hCGが胃癌の腫瘍マーカーとして有用である可能性が示唆された。性腺外に生じる絨毛癌の消化管発生例として示唆に富む。
pmid-6990747.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old woman with primary choriocarcinoma of the stomach, presenting with abdominal pain and massive hepatomegaly. Serum CEA and serum and urine beta-hCG were markedly elevated. Immunoperoxidase staining showed both CEA and hCG in morphologically typical carcinoma cells. The authors suggest serum beta-hCG may be a useful tumor marker for gastric carcinoma. The case shows that extragonadal choriocarcinoma can arise in the gastrointestinal tract and can be identified through tumor marker and immunohistochemical profiling.

pmid-6994676.summary_ja: 死産した男児の巨大エピグナサス(口腔咽頭由来の奇形腫)の症例報告。胎盤肥大、羊水過多、胎児水腫を伴っていた。大きな血管性腫瘤を循環する血流による心代償不全が原因と考えられた。腫瘍内のY小体から宿主細胞由来の可能性が示唆された。巨大胎児奇形腫が胎盤・羊水の異常を来しうることを示す症例である。
pmid-6994676.summary_en: This case report describes a stillborn male infant with massive epignathus, a teratoma arising from the oropharynx. The infant had placental enlargement, hydramnios and hydrops. The authors attribute these changes to cardiac decompensation from circulation through the large vascular tumor mass. Y bodies in the tumor suggested a mitotic origin from host cells. The case illustrates how a large fetal teratoma can cause placental and fluid abnormalities through high-output circulatory load.

pmid-6998614.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、原発性または転移性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者23例の血清を、間接免疫蛍光法により奇形癌関連抗原に対する抗体について検討した。15例が陽性で、そのうち6例は精子と腫瘍細胞の両方に反応した。精子では尾部の染色が最も多く認められた。精巣腫瘍患者の血清中に、共通の奇形腫定義抗原に対する抗体が存在すると結論づけている。
pmid-6998614.summary_en: This 1980 study tested serum from 23 patients with primary or metastatic germ cell testicular tumors for antibodies against teratocarcinoma-associated antigens, using indirect immunofluorescence. Human and mouse sperm and a mouse teratocarcinoma line (402 AX) served as target cells. Fifteen sera were positive, six of them reacting with both sperm and tumor cells. Tail staining predominated on spermatozoa. The authors concluded that antibodies to a shared teratoma-defined antigen are present in patients with testicular tumors.

pmid-7006065.summary_ja: 23歳の初産婦に生じた化膿性卵巣類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。原因はSalmonella typhiで、血液、便、尿からは菌が分離されなかった。著者らは、非排菌保有者として菌が卵巣組織内に長期間潜伏していたと考察している。良性の胚細胞由来病変に生じた稀な感染例として示されている。
pmid-7006065.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old primigravida with a suppurative ovarian dermoid cyst caused by Salmonella typhi. The organism could not be isolated from blood, feces or urine. The authors propose that the patient was a non-excretory carrier, with S. typhi lying dormant in the ovarian tissue for a long time. The report highlights an uncommon infection of a benign germ cell lesion arising during pregnancy, a combination clinicians should keep in mind when evaluating ovarian masses in pregnant women.

pmid-7008252.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、絨毛癌細胞株におけるHLA抗原の発現を、モノクローナル抗体パネルを用いて検討した。HLA-A、B、C、DRwおよびβ2ミクログロブリンは、いずれの細胞株にも検出されなかった。一方、ほかのヒト組織に広く発現する抗原は全細胞株で認められた。絨毛癌細胞が古典的HLA抗原を欠くことを示し、腫瘍の免疫認識に関する知見を与えている。
pmid-7008252.summary_en: This 1980 study examined HLA expression on choriocarcinoma cell lines using monoclonal antibodies against HLA-A, B, C, DRw, beta-2 microglobulin and other determinants. Indirect trace binding and absorption assays were performed. HLA-A, B, C, DRw and beta-2 microglobulin were absent from all tested lines, while other antigens widely expressed in human tissues were present on every line. The findings indicate that these choriocarcinoma cells lack the classical HLA antigens tested, with implications for immune recognition of such tumors.

pmid-7021106.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、マウス奇形癌細胞に対する5-ブロモデオキシウリジン(BrdUrd)の作用をフローサイトメトリーで解析した。胎児性癌細胞(EC細胞)において、自然分化を模倣する変化は2～3倍速く生じた一方、自然分化と一致しない変化もみられた。アルカリホスファターゼ活性は自然分化とは逆に上昇した。胚発生を模倣する系としての奇形癌細胞の利用が示されている。
pmid-7021106.summary_en: This 1980 study used flow cytometric techniques to examine how 5-bromodeoxyuridine (BrdUrd) affects growth and differentiation of mouse teratocarcinoma stem cells, termed embryonal carcinoma cells. BrdUrd produced a pleiotropic response: some changes mimicked spontaneous differentiation but occurred two to three times faster, while others were inconsistent with it. It accelerated the appearance of a tetraploid population in one diploid line and raised alkaline phosphatase activity, opposite to spontaneous differentiation. Esterase kinetics were not changed. The teratocarcinoma system was used as an in vitro model of embryogenesis.

pmid-7024957.summary_ja: 1980年の総説で、性腺および泌尿器系の癌で発現する胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼであるReganアイソザイムの免疫学と生化学をまとめている。腫瘍と胎盤の遺伝子産物の比較や、オンコトロホブラストの遺伝子発現が論じられている。セミノーマがReganアイソザイムを一貫して産生することが指摘されたが、臨床的有用性の確立にはさらなる検討が必要とされる。
pmid-7024957.summary_en: This 1980 review covers the immunology and biochemistry of the Regan isoenzyme, a placental-type alkaline phosphatase expressed in gonadal and urologic cancers. It compares tumor and placental gene products, discusses developmental phase-specific L-leucine sensitivity, and reviews oncotrophoblast gene expression in cell lines. The authors position the Regan isoenzyme among oncodevelopmental tumor markers and note that seminoma consistently produces it, although its clinical utility requires further study.

pmid-7188600.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、破傷風トキソイドに結合させたhCGβサブユニットによる能動免疫が、ハムスター頰嚢で増殖させたヒト絨毛癌(BeWo株)に効果を示すかを検討した。免疫群では完全なhCGに結合する抗体が大量に産生されたが、抗腫瘍効果は認められなかった。腫瘍体積や生着率、増殖開始までの時間は対照群と差がなかった。移植可能な絨毛癌の増殖は変化しないと結論されている。
pmid-7188600.summary_en: This 1980 study tested whether active immunization with the hCG beta subunit coupled to tetanus toxoid could affect BeWo human choriocarcinoma growing in hamster cheek pouches. Immunized hamsters produced large amounts of antibodies that bound intact hCG, but these antibodies showed no antitumor activity. Tumor volume, take rate, lag phase and timing of necrosis did not differ from controls immunized with tetanus toxoid alone. The authors conclude that hCG beta-tetanus toxoid immunization does not alter the growth of transplantable choriocarcinoma.

pmid-7188695.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、hCGのαおよびβサブユニットを本来の遺伝子産物として産生する絨毛癌細胞株JARを用い、パルス・チェイスにより合成と分泌を検討した。成熟サブユニットは細胞内に蓄積せず、プロセシング後速やかに分泌された。異所性にαまたはβを産生する3株も比較されている。サブユニットのプロセシングと分泌の研究に用いる生物学的試薬として有用とされた。
pmid-7188695.summary_en: This 1980 pulse-chase study examined synthesis and secretion of hCG alpha and beta subunits in JAR choriocarcinoma cells, which produce both subunits as expected gene products. Mature subunits were secreted rapidly after intracellular processing rather than accumulating. Three cell lines that produce a single subunit ectopically were also studied: ChaGo bronchogenic carcinoma and HeLa S3 cervical carcinoma secreted alpha subunit, and the CBT glioblastoma-derived line produced beta subunit. The authors propose these four lines as biological reagents for further study of subunit processing and secretion.

pmid-7188748.summary_ja: 本研究は絨毛癌クローン細胞株JEG-3におけるhCGおよび遊離αサブユニットの生合成と分泌を、代謝標識とパルスチェイス法で解析した。分泌型の遊離αサブユニットは細胞内型より分子量が大きく、細胞内型が前駆体である可能性が示された。分泌されるhCGβサブユニットも標準品より大きく、分泌過程での糖鎖付加が示唆された。
pmid-7188748.summary_en: This 1980 study examined de novo biosynthesis and secretion of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and its free alpha-subunit in the JEG-3 human choriocarcinoma clonal cell line. Using metabolic labeling with [35S]methionine, pulse-chase, and immunoprecipitation, the authors found that the predominant secreted free alpha-subunit has a higher apparent molecular weight than the intracellular form, suggesting the intracellular alpha-subunit is a precursor of the secreted form. Secreted hCG beta-subunit was also larger than standard, consistent with posttranslational oligosaccharide addition during secretion.

pmid-7188878.summary_ja: 精巣の播種性胎児性癌に対しシスプラチン(PDD)治療を受けた30歳男性の症例報告である。治療中に痙攣と一過性の皮質盲が生じ、当時あまり知られていなかったシスプラチンの神経毒性が示された。精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する白金製剤による化学療法では、神経合併症の監視が重要であることを示している。
pmid-7188878.summary_en: This 1980 case report describes a 30-year-old man treated with cis-platinum diamminedichloride (PDD) for disseminated embryonal cell carcinoma of the testicle. The patient developed seizures and transient cortical blindness during therapy, illustrating a neurotoxic adverse effect of cisplatin not widely recognized at the time. The report highlights the need to monitor for neurological complications during platinum-based chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-7189050.summary_ja: 46,XY純粋性性腺形成不全（Swyer症候群）の2症例を報告した。1例では両側の性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマが認められ、異形成性腺における胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを示している。もう1例では卵管間膜の子宮内膜症が見つかり、純粋性性腺形成不全では従来報告のない所見であった。
pmid-7189050.summary_en: This 1980 report describes two cases of 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis (Swyer syndrome). In one patient, laparotomy for gonadal extirpation revealed bilateral gonadoblastomas with dysgerminomas, illustrating the risk of germ cell neoplasia in dysgenetic gonads. The second case was notable for endometriosis on the mesosalpinx, a finding not previously described in pure gonadal dysgenesis. The authors discuss the unusual features of both cases.

pmid-7189222.summary_ja: 精巣癌に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に生じた腰椎部のリンパ嚢胞の症例報告である。典型的な局所所見ではなく消化器症状で発症した。超音波検査で診断し穿刺吸引の指針とした。傍大動脈や腎門部の郭清後にも非典型的な症状を伴うリンパ嚢胞が生じうると述べている。
pmid-7189222.summary_en: This 1980 case report describes a mid-lumbar lymphocele arising after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy performed for testicular carcinoma. Unusually, the patient presented with gastrointestinal symptoms rather than typical local signs. Ultrasonography established the diagnosis and guided aspiration. The authors note that lymphoceles after para-aortic or renal hilar dissection may also produce atypical manifestations, and emphasize the established value of ultrasound in such cases.

pmid-7190089.summary_ja: 絨毛癌を移植したハムスターに対し、hCGβ-ttによる能動免疫が腫瘍由来のhCGの性腺刺激作用を抑制するかを検討した。腫瘍増殖の初期5日間は、hCG誘発性の嚢胞状卵胞や莢膜黄体化が抑えられた。非荷癌動物では卵巣構造や発情周期に影響はなく、in vivoでhCGの生物活性を抑制できることを示した。
pmid-7190089.summary_en: This 1980 study examined whether active immunization with hCGbeta-tt could neutralize the gonadotropic activity of hCG secreted by human choriocarcinoma implanted in hamsters. Histology of the ovaries showed that hCG-induced cystic follicles and thecal luteinization were prevented for the first five days of tumor growth, while normal follicular development persisted. Immunization did not affect ovarian structure or the estrous cycle in tumor-free animals, indicating in vivo inhibition of hCG bioactivity.

pmid-7190461.summary_ja: 大腸腺癌で死亡した49歳女性の症例報告である。肝転移と肺転移の部分に、形態学的および免疫細胞化学的に確認された絨毛癌が認められた。絨毛癌成分は胚細胞ではなく癌組織内の化生により生じたと考えられ、混合腫瘍の起源と分類への示唆を論じている。
pmid-7190461.summary_en: This 1980 case report describes a 49-year-old woman with colon adenocarcinoma whose hepatic and pulmonary metastases contained choriocarcinoma, confirmed by morphology and immunocytochemistry. The authors suggest the choriocarcinomatous component arose by metaplasia within carcinomatous tissue rather than from ectopic germ cells or embryonic totipotent cells. They discuss the implications of such mixed tumors for the histogenesis and classification of tumors.

pmid-7190464.summary_ja: 腫瘍分泌物質に対する異種抗体を用いた予備的な治療および局在化研究である。薬剤抵抗性の絨毛癌と悪性奇形腫の患者に、抗ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)抗体と抗αフェトプロテイン(AFP)抗体を化学療法と併用したが、結果は確定的でなかった。ヌードマウスでは抗hCG抗体による腫瘍増殖抑制は認められなかった。
pmid-7190464.summary_en: This 1980 report presents preliminary therapeutic and localization studies using heterologous antibodies against secreted tumor products. In patients with drug-resistant choriocarcinoma and malignant teratoma, anti-hCG and anti-alpha-fetoprotein antibodies were combined with continued cytotoxic chemotherapy, with inconclusive results. In nude mice, anti-hCG failed to inhibit choriocarcinoma growth. Radiolabeled anti-hCG and anti-CEA showed specific-to-nonspecific ratios up to 2:1 in localization studies.

pmid-7190621.summary_ja: ミュラー管性偽半陰陽を伴い子宮を有する男性の症例報告である。両側精巣の精細管内に未分化な胚細胞腫瘍が広がり、左精巣にはセミノーマと胎児性癌の領域があった。子宮を有する男性の陰嚢内精巣に生じた腫瘍として初例であり、精細管形成異常や未熟なセルトリ細胞との関連を論じている。
pmid-7190621.summary_en: This 1980 case report describes a male with müllerian pseudohermaphroditism and a uterus, whose testes both harbored diffuse intratubular undifferentiated germ cell tumor. The left testis had seminoma and embryonal carcinoma areas, and the right abdominal testis showed similar undifferentiated germ cells. The authors describe the first case of tumor in a scrotal testis of a male with a uterus and discuss its relation to tubular dysgenesis and immature Sertoli cells.

pmid-7190958.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞株の複数のサブラインを用い、長期培養でhCGとαサブユニットの分泌比が変化する現象を検討した。当初はhCGの分泌がαサブユニットを上回っていたが、培養期間が長くなるとhCGβの産生が著明に低下し、αサブユニットは維持された。hCGβ産生は絨毛癌細胞においてαサブユニットより不安定であると結論づけている。
pmid-7190958.summary_en: This 1980 study investigated why continuous BeWo trophoblastic (choriocarcinoma) cell lines increasingly secrete gonadotropin alpha-subunit relative to intact hCG. Across BeWo sublines, hCG secretion initially exceeded alpha-subunit, but with prolonged culture hCG beta production declined markedly while alpha-subunit output remained stable. The authors conclude that hCG beta synthesis by BeWo choriocarcinoma cells is more labile than alpha-subunit production.

pmid-7191721.summary_ja: 経産の女性2例で、高プロラクチン血症、乳汁漏出、無月経を認めた症例報告である。良性卵巣奇形腫を外科的に摘出したところ、両症例とも症状が治癒した。腫瘍壁に異常な内分泌組織は認めず、ホルモン異常の機序は説明できなかった。卵巣奇形腫が産後の内分泌症状と関連しうること、腫瘍摘出により症状が改善しうることを示唆している。
pmid-7191721.summary_en: This short report describes two multiparous women with hyperprolactinaemia, galactorrhoea and amenorrhoea. Both were cured after surgical removal of a benign ovarian teratoma. Histological examination of the tumour walls found no unusual endocrine tissue, so the mechanism of the hormonal disturbance remained unexplained. The findings suggest that an ovarian teratoma can be associated with postpartum endocrine symptoms, and that removing the tumour may resolve them.

pmid-7192206.summary_ja: 嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の症例報告で、皮膚、神経膠組織、軟骨、脂肪などに加え前立腺組織を含んでいた。腫瘍細胞の約15%に二重バー小体を認めた。前立腺分化に必要なテストステロンの供給源や、単為生殖起源の可能性について考察している。
pmid-7192206.summary_en: This case report describes a benign cystic ovarian teratoma containing prostatic tissue, in addition to skin, glia, cartilage, fat, smooth muscle and respiratory epithelium. About 15% of tumour cells showed double Barr bodies. The authors discuss the source of testosterone needed for prostatic differentiation, since prostate development depends on androgen. They also consider whether the tumour arose by parthenogenesis before the first meiotic division, or from heteropyknosis of a single X chromosome, as the Barr body findings suggest.

pmid-7192265.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者で血清ホルモン値を測定した研究である。腫瘍によるゴナドトロピン産生により、LH値が上昇する例が多かった。化学療法中もテストステロン値が高い例があり、腫瘍hCGが生物活性を持つことが示唆された。E2-17βとプロラクチンは早期発見には有用性が低く、FSHは腫瘍マーカーにならなかった。
pmid-7192265.summary_en: This study measured serum hormones in patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumours. Raised LH, due to cross-reactivity with hCG in the assay, was common in active disease, mainly from tumour gonadotrophin production. Testosterone stayed high in many patients on chemotherapy, suggesting that tumour hCG is biologically active and stimulates the remaining testis. Oestradiol and prolactin were of limited value for early detection. Serum FSH was not a useful tumour marker.

pmid-7192326.summary_ja: 右鼠径部精巣捻転で初診した多精巣症の男性の症例報告である。その後、右陰嚢内精巣に絨毛癌型の悪性奇形腫が発生した。患者は脳および肺への転移により死亡した。初診時に触知できなかった精巣に悪性胚細胞腫瘍が生じうること、急速に致死的な転移へ進行しうることを示している。
pmid-7192326.summary_en: This case report describes a man with polyorchidism, a duplicated testis, who first presented with torsion of a right inguinal testis. A malignant trophoblastic-type teratoma, choriocarcinoma, later developed in the right scrotal testis. The patient died of cerebral and pulmonary metastases. The report highlights that a testis which was initially impalpable can harbour a malignant germ cell tumour, and that the disease can progress rapidly to fatal metastatic spread.

pmid-7192596.summary_ja: 1965年から1977年に治療された絨毛癌患者122例を検討した。肺転移は82例に認められ、21例に開胸肺葉切除と化学療法が行われた。術前のhCG値と肺病変の広がりが予後を最も左右した。手術適応として、手術耐容性、原発巣の制御、他部位転移がないこと、片肺病変、尿中hCG 1000 mIU/ml未満などの基準を提案している。
pmid-7192596.summary_en: This study reviewed 122 patients with choriocarcinoma treated from 1965 to 1977, 82 of whom had pulmonary metastases. Twenty-one underwent lobectomy with chemotherapy, and fifteen achieved complete remission. Pre-operative hCG levels and the extent of lung disease most strongly affected outcome. The authors propose criteria for surgery: good operative risk, controlled primary disease, no metastases elsewhere, unilateral lung disease, and urinary hCG below 1000 mIU/ml.

pmid-7192747.summary_ja: 骨盤内に広範な絨毛癌を有し、骨盤神経叢が破壊された若年男性の報告である。排尿動態検査で膀胱と尿道の副交感、交感、体性神経支配の障害が確認された。排尿動態検査は胸腰髄および仙髄機能の神経学的検査として有用であると示している。
pmid-7192747.summary_en: This report describes a young man with extensive pelvic choriocarcinoma that destroyed the pelvic plexus. Urodynamic testing showed deficits of parasympathetic, sympathetic and somatic innervation of the bladder and urethra. The authors show that urodynamic evaluation can serve as a neurological test of thoracolumbar and sacral cord function. The case illustrates how a pelvic germ cell tumour can cause neurogenic bladder dysfunction.

pmid-7192840.summary_ja: ステージIIIの精巣腫瘍で肺転移を有する54例に対し、放射線療法と化学療法を併用した成績を検討した。奏効率はセミノーマで43%、非セミノーマで63%であった。未治療例では奏効率73%、完全寛解34%であった。前治療歴や全身状態不良が影響した可能性があり、期待より低い成績であったと結論している。
pmid-7192840.summary_en: This study evaluated combined radiotherapy and chemotherapy in 54 patients with stage III testicular tumours and lung metastases, comprising seminoma and nonseminoma. Overall response was 43% in seminoma patients and 63% in nonseminoma patients, with 31% complete remission in nonseminoma. Previously untreated patients had a 73% overall response rate and 34% complete remission. The authors conclude that results were less favourable than expected, partly due to poor general condition and prior treatment.

pmid-7193412.summary_ja: 原発性無月経、両側性ゴナドブラストーマ、低身長を示した22歳女性の症例報告である。末梢血では46,XYや縦列転座による二動原体Y染色体を含む3細胞系が認められた。Y染色体を持つ女性では、H-Y抗原陰性でもゴナドブラストーマの危険が高いことを確認している。
pmid-7193412.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with primary amenorrhoea, bilateral gonadoblastomas and short stature, without the typical features of Turner syndrome. Blood showed three cell lines, including 46,XY and a dicentric Y chromosome. Gonadal culture showed only 45,X, whereas frozen sections showed Y-chromatin, which suggests cell selection in culture. The case confirms the high risk of gonadoblastoma in women carrying a Y chromosome, even without H-Y antigen.

pmid-7195417.summary_ja: 剖検例30例の解析で、絨毛癌の脳転移の多くは脳神経外科的に切除可能であった。名古屋大学病院の35例では、手術と化学療法の併用群が化学療法単独群より明らかに生存期間が長かった。頭蓋内圧亢進があれば速やかに減圧し、その後多剤化学療法と全脳照射を行うことが推奨されている。症状がなければ化学療法と放射線照射の併用が第一選択とされる。
pmid-7195417.summary_en: This 1980 study analyzed 30 autopsy cases of cerebral metastasis from choriocarcinoma, finding that most were neurosurgically resectable. Among 35 patients treated at Nagoya University Hospital, those receiving surgery plus chemotherapy survived markedly longer than those given chemotherapy alone. Surgery was most beneficial when brain damage was mild, the lesion was accessible, and chemotherapy had not failed. The authors recommend immediate decompression for raised intracranial pressure, followed by multidrug chemotherapy and whole-brain irradiation. Without such symptoms, chemotherapy combined with irradiation is preferred.

pmid-7205797.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成症の22歳女性で、左卵巣にTeter分類III型の性腺細胞腫が認められた症例である。ホルモン、遺伝学的、腹腔鏡による検査を経て性腺異形成と診断された。腫瘍は両側性腺摘出後に発見された。性索異常を伴う異形成性腺では胚細胞性腫瘍のリスクがあることを示す。
pmid-7205797.summary_en: This report describes a 22-year-old woman with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis who was found to have a Teter type III gonocytoma in her left ovary. Hormonal, genetic and laparoscopic evaluations were performed before the dysgenesis diagnosis was made. The neoplasm was discovered only after bilateral gonadectomy. The case illustrates the risk of germ cell neoplasia arising in dysgenetic gonads associated with sex chromosome disorders.

pmid-7214301.summary_ja: 縦隔原発悪性セミノーマの症例群を報告し、既報の症例群と比較した。潜在性の原発性性腺病変を完全に除外することの難しさが指摘されている。縦隔セミノーマは放射線感受性が高いため、縦隔奇形腫より予後が良好である。心室中隔欠損と胸椎半椎の先天性欠損を伴った1例を提示し、腫瘍発生との関連を考察している。
pmid-7214301.summary_en: This series of malignant mediastinal seminomas is compared with previously reported series. The authors note the difficulty of conclusively excluding occult primary gonadal disease. Primary mediastinal seminomas have a better prognosis than mediastinal teratomas, largely because of their radiosensitivity. A case of mediastinal seminoma associated with a ventricular septal defect and congenital absence of a thoracic hemivertebra is described, and its possible relationship to tumor origin is discussed.

pmid-7217869.summary_ja: 多能性胎児性癌細胞がin vitroで胚様体へ分化する過程で、二次元電気泳動によりタンパク質合成の変化を解析した。変化の大部分は12時間以内に起こり、内胚葉が形態的に現れるより前であった。EC細胞とマウス内部細胞塊の間には大きな差があり、多能性との関連が議論されている。
pmid-7217869.summary_en: Two-dimensional electrophoresis was used to track changes in protein synthesis as pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cells differentiate into embryoid bodies in vitro. Most changes occurred within 12 hours, before endoderm was morphologically visible. Patterns were compared with other embryonic cell lines and mouse inner cell mass cells, revealing substantial differences between EC cells and the inner cell mass. The authors discuss these differences in relation to pluripotency, and some changes may serve as differentiation markers.

pmid-7220416.summary_ja: 体重194.1kgの37歳女性で、少なくとも42kgに達する巨大な卵巣類皮嚢腫が見つかった。この腫瘍は以前見過ごされ、全身性肥満の一因となっていた。これほど大きな類皮嚢腫の報告は過去になかったとされる。重度の全身性肥満患者では嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍を考慮すべきと著者らは述べている。
pmid-7220416.summary_en: A 37-year-old woman weighing 194.1 kg was found to have a massive ovarian dermoid cyst weighing at least 42 kg, which had been overlooked and had contributed to her generalized obesity. The authors state that a dermoid of this size had not previously been reported. The case is presented as a clinical report, and the authors emphasize that cystic ovarian tumors should be considered when evaluating severe obesity, since such lesions can be misattributed to body habitus.

pmid-7240825.summary_ja: 卵巣由来のヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍をヌードマウスに移植し、YST-1腫瘍株を樹立した。組織像はヒト腫瘍に保持され、α-フェトプロテインを産生した。腹腔内投与した数種の抗癌剤のうち、ビンブラスチンとブレオマイシンの併用が腫瘍増殖を有意に抑制した。実験的化学療法の基盤となるモデルである。
pmid-7240825.summary_en: A human ovarian yolk sac tumor was transplanted into nude mice, producing a transplantable line called YST-1 that retains the histology of human yolk sac tumor and produces alpha-fetoprotein. Several anticancer agents used clinically for ovarian cancer were tested intraperitoneally in tumor-bearing mice. Among them, the combination of vinblastine and bleomycin significantly arrested tumor growth. The model provides a platform for experimental chemotherapy studies.

pmid-7240840.summary_ja: 久留米大学で1960年から1979年に治療した卵巣腫瘍355例を検討し、うち336例は準悪性群または最悪性群に属した。5年生存率は準悪性群67.6%、最悪性群30.8%であった。若年女性に多く妊孕性温存が必要なディスジャーミノーマと、高齢者に多い上皮性癌の臨床管理を述べている。
pmid-7240840.summary_en: This Kurume University review covers 355 ovarian neoplasms treated from 1960 to 1979, of which 336 belonged to the semimalignant or most malignant groups. Five-year survival was 67.6% for the semimalignant group and 30.8% for the most malignant group. The paper describes the management of dysgerminoma, which is common in the semimalignant group among young women who wish to preserve fertility, and of common epithelial carcinoma, which is frequent in older patients.

pmid-7240873.summary_ja: 妊娠13週の28歳女性で、左卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫内の甲状腺組織から生じた濾胞腺腫の症例を報告している。組織像は複数の腺腫パターンを示し、超微細構造、免疫組織化学、内分泌学的検討により確定診断された。手術は成功し、患者は健康な男児を正期産で出産した後、フォローアップ中である。
pmid-7240873.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman at 13 weeks of pregnancy with a follicular adenoma arising from thyroid tissue within a benign cystic teratoma of the left ovary. Histology showed several adenomatous patterns, and the diagnosis was confirmed by ultrastructural, immunohistological, and endocrinological studies. The patient underwent successful surgery, delivered a healthy full-term male infant, and is under follow-up.

pmid-7242089.summary_ja: 基底膜糖タンパク質ラミニンが、限定培地中の胎児性癌細胞株F9とその分化細胞の増殖と分化に与える影響を検討した基礎研究である。増殖は細胞密度に強く依存し、ラミニンは低密度下での生存と増殖を改善したが、クローン増殖は支持しなかった。ラミニンは細胞接着も促進し、哺乳類の初期発生における接着機能の関与が示唆された。
pmid-7242089.summary_en: This basic science study examines how laminin, a basement membrane glycoprotein, affects the growth and differentiation of the embryonal carcinoma cell line F9 and its differentiated derivatives in defined medium. Growth of both cell types is strongly density dependent, and laminin improves survival and growth at low density but does not support clonal growth. Laminin also promotes cell attachment. The authors propose an attachment function for laminin in early mammalian development.

pmid-7260832.summary_ja: 父親に両側性の連続したセミノーマ、息子に胎児性癌とセミノーマが認められた父子の精巣悪性腫瘍を報告している。既報例の文献的検討では、父親はセミノーマが多く、息子では悪性度の高い奇形腫、絨毛癌、胎児性癌が多かった。著者らは遺伝的表現促進の関与の可能性を論じている。
pmid-7260832.summary_en: This report describes testicular malignancy in a father and son. The father had sequential bilateral seminomas, while the son developed embryonal cell carcinoma and seminoma. A review of reported father-son testicular malignancies shows that fathers more often had seminomas, whereas sons more often had highly malignant teratomas, choriocarcinomas, and embryonal carcinomas. The authors discuss whether genetic anticipation occurs in these families.

pmid-7351720.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍73例を対象に、病期分類の日常的な手段として鎖骨上窩リンパ節生検を評価した検討である。非セミノーマ性腫瘍61例中3例、セミノーマ12例中1例に転移を認めたが、4例とも他臓器転移を有していた。検出率が低く合併症率は8%であったことから、触知可能な鎖骨上窩腫瘤がない症例での日常的な実施は推奨されないと結論づけている。
pmid-7351720.summary_en: This study evaluated supraclavicular node biopsy as a routine staging procedure in 73 patients with testicular tumours. Metastasis was found in 3 of 61 non-seminomatous and 1 of 12 seminoma patients, and all four already had other metastases. The yield was low and complications occurred in 8% of patients. The authors conclude that routine biopsy is unwarranted without a palpable supraclavicular mass.

pmid-7351721.summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマ2例を提示し、治療前の腫瘍範囲と体積の確定におけるコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の有用性を示している。CTは後腹膜、腸間膜、腹部リンパ節やリンパ節外進展を明瞭に描出し、嚢胞や出血の性状も評価できた。リンパ管造影や下大静脈造影より侵襲が少なく、放射線療法の照射野設定や治療効果のモニタリングにも有用である。
pmid-7351721.summary_en: This report presents two cases of metastatic seminoma to show the value of computed tomography in defining tumour extent and volume before treatment. CT better visualized the retroperitoneum, mesenteric and abdominal nodes, and extranodal extension, and displayed cystic and haemorrhagic components. Compared with lymphography and venacavography, CT is non-invasive and more precise for defining radiation therapy fields, and it helps monitor treatment response.

pmid-7351722.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対して経陰嚢的精巣摘除術が不十分であった患者16例で、腸骨鼠径領域の保存的外科的管理を行った報告である。陰嚢部分切除と精索切除を一塊で実施した。3例に残存病変を認めたが、再発例はなかった。著者らは、鼠径リンパ節郭清を日常的に行う必要はないと結論づけている。
pmid-7351722.summary_en: This study describes 16 patients who underwent conservative surgery of the ilioinguinal region after inadequate transscrotal orchiectomy for non-seminomatous germ cell tumour. Treatment consisted of en bloc partial scrotectomy and removal of the spermatic cord. Residual disease was found in 3 patients, but none had recurrence. The authors conclude that routine inguinal lymphadenectomy is not warranted.

pmid-7351856.summary_ja: 上行大動脈に付着する有茎性の先天性腫瘍である心膜内奇形腫を、乳児2例の手術成功例とともに報告している。大量の心膜液貯留、心圧迫、心肺症状を来すことが多い。心エコーと心臓シネ血管造影が診断に有用で、一般に良性であり、早期の外科的摘除で根治が得られる。
pmid-7351856.summary_en: This report describes intrapericardial teratoma in infancy, a rare congenital pedunculated tumour usually attached to the ascending aorta. It typically causes massive pericardial effusion, cardiac compression, and cardiorespiratory distress. Echocardiography and cardiac cineangiography are diagnostic. The tumour is generally benign, and early surgical removal is curative. Two infants who underwent successful resection are presented as case reports.

pmid-7354545.summary_ja: 9歳男児の過剰精巣（多精巣症）に生じた腫瘍の症例報告。組織学的に未分化セミノーマと診断された。著者らは文献上に類似例を見出せず、小児の胚細胞腫瘍としても珍しい所見である。副精巣に発生したセミノーマの稀少性と、その診断上の課題を示す報告である。
pmid-7354545.summary_en: This case report describes a 9-year-old boy with a neoplasm arising in a supernumerary testicle, a rare configuration known as polyorchidism. Histologic examination diagnosed anaplastic seminoma. The authors could find no comparable case in the literature, making this an unusual presentation of a germ cell tumor in a prepubertal child. The short report highlights the rarity of seminoma arising in an accessory testis and the diagnostic challenge it presents.

pmid-7355206.summary_ja: 成人の原発性後腹膜奇形腫の良性例2例を報告し、文献レビューを行った。後腹膜奇形腫は成人では稀で、報告例の約26%が悪性であった。石灰化は良性を保証しないため画像診断が重要であり、経過が予測できないことから外科的切除が不可欠とされている。
pmid-7355206.summary_en: This report presents two benign cases of primary retroperitoneal teratoma in adults and reviews the literature. The authors note that retroperitoneal teratomas are rare in adults and malignant in about 26% of reported cases. Radiologic imaging was essential for diagnosis in both patients. Although calcification is common, it does not reliably indicate benign behavior, since a substantial fraction of calcified tumors proved malignant. Because the clinical course is unpredictable, the authors conclude that surgical excision is indispensable.

pmid-7355224.summary_ja: 子宮内で診断された良性仙尾部奇形腫の出生前超音波所見を報告。グレースケール超音波で腫瘍の充実成分と嚢胞成分の割合、ならびに石灰化を確認した。石灰化のない充実性腫瘍は悪性の傾向があり、嚢胞性や石灰化を伴う腫瘍は通常良性とされ、画像所見が出生前の相談や管理に役立つと述べている。
pmid-7355224.summary_en: This case report describes prenatal sonographic diagnosis of a benign sacral teratoma in utero. Sacral teratoma is rarely identified before birth. Gray-scale ultrasound revealed the mix of solid and cystic components and detected calcification in the fetal tumor. The authors emphasize that solid tumors without calcification tend to be malignant, whereas cystic or complex tumors and those with calcification are usually benign. These imaging features help guide prenatal counseling and management.

pmid-7356510.summary_ja: 絨毛癌および栄養膜組織に関連する特異的な乳酸脱水素酵素アイソザイムLDH-Zを同定した研究。絨毛癌細胞株、胞状奇胎、胎盤、肝転移巣で検出されたが、他のヒト腫瘍由来の60以上の細胞株では認められなかった。妊娠性絨毛性疾患のマーカーとしての可能性も示唆される。
pmid-7356510.summary_en: This study identifies a unique lactate dehydrogenase isozyme, LDH-Z, associated with human choriocarcinoma and trophoblastic tissue. LDH-Z was found in choriocarcinoma cell lines, hydatidiform mole, term and second-trimester placenta, and a liver metastasis, but not in more than 60 other human neoplasm-derived cell lines. The authors conclude that LDH-Z is an isozyme linked to choriocarcinoma and indicative of trophoblastic origin, with potential as a marker for gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-7361369.summary_ja: セミノーマが先行し、後に胎児性癌が出現した異時性両側精巣腫瘍の6例目の報告。胎児性癌が生じた精巣の生検で異型胚細胞が認められた。胚細胞の異型性と上皮内癌の認識の高まりを指摘し、不妊症患者の精巣生検を診る病理医への注意を促している。
pmid-7361369.summary_en: This report describes a sixth documented case of metachronous bilateral testicular neoplasia in which a seminoma preceded an embryonal carcinoma. Notably, the biopsy from the gonad that later developed embryonal carcinoma showed atypical germ cells. The authors highlight growing recognition of germ cell atypia and carcinoma in situ, and they urge pathologists examining testicular biopsies from infertile men to be alert to this precursor process.

pmid-7361833.summary_ja: 1966〜1978年に単一施設で治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患257例の治療成績を検討。全体寛解率は92%だった。主体は化学療法だが、化学療法開始時の子宮摘出術は転移の有無にかかわらず入院期間と化学療法量を減らした。化学療法抵抗性病巣の遅延切除や合併症への手術も治療完遂に有用であった。
pmid-7361833.summary_en: This study reviews 257 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease treated at one institution between 1966 and 1978, with a 92% overall remission rate. Chemotherapy was the primary treatment, but concurrent hysterectomy at chemotherapy initiation shortened hospitalization and reduced chemotherapy needs regardless of metastasis. Delayed resection of resistant foci was beneficial but less effective. Surgery for complications also helped complete chemotherapy safely, with no chemotherapy-attributable problems in wound healing.

pmid-7362303.summary_ja: 良性仙尾部奇形腫で治療された乳児33例を25年間にわたり検討。主に新生児に発症し、外部から触知される腫瘤として現れる。迅速かつ完全な切除により予後は極めて良好で、本シリーズの切除率は100%だった。仙尾部の他の腫瘤との鑑別には慎重な組織学的検討が必要とされる。
pmid-7362303.summary_en: This 25-year review analyzes 33 infants treated for benign sacrococcygeal teratoma. The tumor occurs predominantly in newborns, typically as an external mass, and has an excellent prognosis when promptly and completely excised. Resectability was 100% in this series. The authors stress that careful histologic examination is needed to distinguish sacrococcygeal teratoma from other sacrococcygeal masses, which often require different therapeutic approaches.

pmid-7363693.summary_ja: 縦隔後部に発生した嚢胞性類皮嚢腫の一症例を報告した。縦隔のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では、皮脂物質および脂肪組織に相当するCT値が認められた。手術および病理組織学的検査により診断が確定した。脂肪成分を含む縦隔奇形腫の術前評価におけるCTの有用性が示された。
pmid-7363693.summary_en: A patient with a cystic dermoid tumour of the posterior mediastinum is described. Computed tomography showed attenuation values consistent with sebaceous material and fatty tissue. The diagnosis was confirmed at surgery and by pathological examination. The report highlights CT as a useful non-invasive tool for characterising mediastinal teratomas, which can be recognised by their fat and sebaceous content.

pmid-7365888.summary_ja: ステージBおよびCの非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍患者38例で血清乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)を検討した。初診時の上昇は、ステージBで38%、ステージCで65%にとどまり、腫瘍検出の感度は低かった。一方、偽陽性はなく、治療後も上昇が持続した例は全例死亡または進行していた。進行例では初診時と経過観察時にLDHを測定すべきだと結論づけた。
pmid-7365888.summary_en: This study assessed serum lactic dehydrogenase (LDH) in 38 patients with stage B or C non-seminomatous testicular tumours. Initial LDH elevation was found in only 38% of stage B and 65% of stage C patients, so LDH is insensitive for detecting tumour. However, no false-positive elevations occurred, and persistent elevation after therapy predicted death or progressive disease. The authors recommend measuring LDH at diagnosis in advanced disease and serially to monitor response.

pmid-7365898.summary_ja: 近親婚の家系で、いとこ同士の2小児が成熟精巣奇形腫を発症した。両腫瘍は病理学的に類似し、発症時期も近かった。精巣腫瘍家系34件のレビューでは、小児2名が罹患した初の家系であった。双生児の分離傾向と両側性の軽度増加が認められ、病因における遺伝的要因が考察された。
pmid-7365898.summary_en: Two first cousins from a consanguineous family developed mature testicular teratomas at close ages, a rare familial occurrence. The tumours were pathologically similar. A review of 34 families with testicular neoplasms identified this as the first family with two affected children. Analysis suggested twin segregation and a slightly higher rate of bilateral tumours, and genetic roles in aetiology are discussed.

pmid-7366928.summary_ja: 正常満期妊娠と併存した卵巣絨毛癌のまれな一例を報告した。妊娠満期例を伴う卵巣絨毛癌は、本報告で文献上3例目にあたる。正常妊娠が併存したことにより正しい診断に至る難しさが浮き彫りになった点が本論文の主眼である。
pmid-7366928.summary_en: A rare case of ovarian choriocarcinoma coexisting with a normal term pregnancy is reported. This is only the third documented report of ovarian choriocarcinoma with a term pregnancy. The case is presented to show how the coexisting normal pregnancy made the correct diagnosis difficult. The report is short and focuses on this diagnostic challenge rather than on treatment.

pmid-7370241.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株3種（F9、PCC4、PCC3）、奇形癌由来の内胚葉様細胞、およびPCC3から分化させた線維芽細胞の表面蛋白質を比較した。二次元電気泳動により約30種の主要な表面蛋白質が同定された。14種は全細胞型に共通し、200、160、150キロダルトンの3種は未分化細胞のみに認められた。多くの蛋白質は膜下または細胞骨格構造に非共有結合で結合していると推定された。
pmid-7370241.summary_en: Surface proteins were compared across three embryonal carcinoma cell lines (F9, PCC4, PCC3), a teratocarcinoma-derived endodermal line, and fibroblasts differentiated from PCC3, using two-dimensional gel electrophoresis after radioiodination. About 30 major surface proteins were identified. Fourteen were common to all cell types, while three (200, 160 and 150 kilodaltons) were specific to undifferentiated cells. Many proteins were bound to submembrane or cytoskeletal structures.

pmid-7370958.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ22例を検討し、同期間のセミノーマの4.4%を占めた。19例は40歳以上で、無痛性の精巣腫大が主症状であった。他の胚細胞成分を伴わず、転移例は認めなかった。精巣摘除術が治療の第一選択であり、放射線療法の追加を支持する根拠は乏しいとされた。
pmid-7370958.summary_en: Twenty-two cases of spermatocytic seminoma were reviewed, comprising 4.4% of seminomas in the study period. Most patients were over 40, presenting with painless testicular enlargement. The tumour was not associated with other germ cell elements and no metastases occurred. Most patients remained alive for up to 27 years. Orchidectomy is the treatment of choice, and there is no good evidence supporting subsequent radiotherapy.

pmid-7373499.summary_ja: 胃に原発し、大部分が縦隔へ進展した奇形腫の症例報告である。奇形腫は胚細胞腫瘍に属し、性腺外・胃原発で縦隔進展を示した点が特徴である。抄録は簡潔で、治療経過や組織学的詳細は記載されていない。診断に至った過程や追跡期間も抄録からは不明であり、まれな性腺外奇形腫の報告として位置づけられる。
pmid-7373499.summary_en: This case report describes a gastric teratoma in which the bulk of the tumor extended into the mediastinum. Teratoma is a germ cell tumor, and this presentation represents an extragonadal, primary gastric site with mediastinal extension. The abstract is brief and does not detail treatment, follow-up, or histopathologic features beyond the diagnosis. It adds to the rare literature on extragonadal teratomas arising in unusual sites.

pmid-7375942.summary_ja: ヨウ素131標識ヤギ抗hCG抗体を用い、hCG産生性の栄養膜腫瘍および胚細胞腫瘍の放射免疫検出を評価した。体外ガンマ線シンチグラフィーで転移病変を含む腫瘍を局在させ、切除した転移巣では腫瘍/非腫瘍比39.29が示された。著者らは、他の方法で腫瘍を特定できない場合にもhCG産生腫瘍を正確に局在させる臨床ツールとして本法を提案している。
pmid-7375942.summary_en: This study evaluated radioimmunodetection of hCG-secreting trophoblastic and germ cell tumors using iodine-131-labeled goat anti-hCG antibodies. External gamma-ray scintigraphy located tumors in patients, including metastatic lesions. One resected metastasis showed a tumor-to-nontumor ratio of 39.29. The authors propose the method as a clinical tool for precisely localizing hCG-producing tumors, particularly when other clinical methods fail to identify the tumor. The report is an early clinical demonstration of antibody-based imaging in germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-7379022.summary_ja: 両側性に逐次発生した精巣がん患者において、一方の腫瘍の転移巣が自然退縮した症例を報告している。既報を検討したところ、対側腫瘍を伴う患者での自然退縮例は見つからなかった。二度目の精巣摘除術後にのみ退縮した既報例と合わせ、腫瘍増殖のホルモン性修飾が関与する可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-7379022.summary_en: This report describes a patient with bilateral sequential testicular cancer who showed spontaneous regression of metastases from one tumor. A literature review found no prior case of spontaneous regression in patients with contralateral tumors. The authors note that a prior case regressed only after a second orchiectomy. They propose that hormonal modulation of tumor growth may influence regression, suggesting a possible biological mechanism. The case is notable as the first documented instance of this combination in bilateral sequential testicular cancer.

pmid-7382022.summary_ja: 若年成人の兄弟2名が、いずれも右精巣に組織学的に類似したセミノーマを発症した家族内発生例の報告。非双生児の兄弟での類似組織型セミノーマの報告は3組目、精巣腫瘍の家族内発生は10組目とされる。家族性の集積を示す希少例であり、遺伝的素因の可能性を示唆している。
pmid-7382022.summary_en: This 1980 urology report describes two young adult brothers who each developed histologically similar seminomas in the right testis. The authors note this is only the tenth reported set of testicular tumors occurring in family members and the third set of histologically similar seminomas in non-twin brothers. The short report highlights the rarity of familial clustering of testicular malignancy. It suggests a possible genetic or familial predisposition to germ cell tumors, although no mechanistic investigation is presented.

pmid-7382510.summary_ja: 64歳男性に発生した後腹膜の類皮嚢腫（良性嚢胞性奇形腫）の剖検症例報告。無症候性の12cm大の腫瘍で、壁に広範な硬化性脂肪肉芽腫性反応を伴い、右季肋部の重要臓器と広く癒着していた。文献上最高齢の症例とされ、後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別に関わる稀な発生部位・年齢の報告である。
pmid-7382510.summary_en: This 1980 autopsy case report describes a primary retroperitoneal dermoid cyst, a benign cystic teratoma, in a 64-year-old man. The asymptomatic 12 cm tumor showed an extensive sclerosing lipogranulomatous reaction in its wall and adhered widely to vital organs in the right hypochondrium. The patient died after a leaking grafted aortic aneurysm repair, and the authors note he is the oldest reported patient with this lesion. The report documents an unusual site and age for a mature teratoma, relevant to the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal germ cell tumors.

pmid-7383471.summary_ja: 33歳の表現型女性で、真性半陰陽の所見を伴った左性腺の悪性ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告。対側右性腺は卵精巣で、精巣実質と正常卵巣組織を認めた。性腺異形成に伴う胚細胞腫瘍の発生について考察し、表現型女性の真性半陰陽でディスジャーミノーマが報告されたのは初めてとしている。
pmid-7383471.summary_en: This 1980 gynecology case report describes a 33-year-old phenotypic female with true hermaphroditism who had a malignant dysgerminoma of the left gonad. Pathological examination of the contralateral right gonad revealed an ovotestis containing testicular parenchyma with hyalinized seminiferous tubules and normal ovarian elements. The authors describe associated proliferative endometrium and a small uterus, consistent with true hermaphroditism. They discuss dysgerminoma and other tumors in gonadal dysgenesis and note this is the first reported dysgerminoma in a phenotypic female hermaphrodite.

pmid-7388115.summary_ja: ヒトの単為発生の2形態として、卵巣奇形腫と全胞状奇胎を取り上げた小論。卵巣奇形腫では二倍体の染色体がすべて母性由来、全胞状奇胎ではすべて父性由来であることを対比している。胚細胞腫瘍と絨毛性疾患を遺伝学的な枠組みで結び付けた論点を示す。
pmid-7388115.summary_en: This 1980 brief commentary on human parthenogenesis considers ovarian teratomas and complete hydatidiform moles as two forms of parthenogenetic development. In ovarian teratomas, the diploid chromosome complement is entirely of maternal origin, whereas in complete hydatidiform moles it is entirely paternal. The paper contrasts the two entities by chromosomal origin, linking germ cell tumors with gestational trophoblastic disease within a unified genetic framework.

pmid-7388776.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を産生する悪性腫瘍4例(膀胱の絨毛癌、後腹膜の悪性奇形腫を含む)の血漿、尿、腹水、腫瘍抽出物を測定したものである。腫瘍ではβサブユニットの割合が胎盤よりはるかに高く、ゲル濾過で分子形態の不均一性が示された。低分子量型が尿中に認められたが、その生物学的意義は未解明とされている。
pmid-7388776.summary_en: This 1980 study measured human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and its alpha and beta subunits in plasma, urine, ascites, and tumor extracts from four patients with hCG-producing malignancies, including bladder choriocarcinoma and retroperitoneal malignant teratoma. The beta subunit proportion was much higher in tumors than in placenta, consistent with increased beta-subunit mRNA. Gel filtration revealed heterogeneous molecular forms, and lower molecular weight hCG forms appeared in urine. The authors note that the biological significance remains unclear.

pmid-7388807.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の転移巣から、4種類の組織型を含む細胞株833K-Eを樹立したことを報告している。細胞は上皮様の形態と過二倍体の男性核型を示し、軟寒天で増殖し、ヌードマウスでは胎児性癌に類似した腫瘍を形成した。多くの細胞が胚性抗原を発現する一方、主要組織適合抗原の発現は低かった。同一検体から胚性抗原を欠くリンパ芽球様細胞株も樹立されており、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の研究に有用なin vitroモデルを提供する。
pmid-7388807.summary_en: This paper reports the establishment of a cell line, 833K-E, from a metastasis of a human testicular germ cell tumor containing four histological types. The cells showed epithelial morphology and a hyperdiploid male karyotype, grew in soft agar, and formed tumors in nude mice resembling pure embryonal carcinoma. Many cells expressed a stage-specific mouse embryonic antigen, while major histocompatibility antigens and beta-2-microglobulin were expressed at low levels. A paired lymphoblastoid line from the same specimen was also derived, lacking embryonic antigen expression. The work provides a useful in vitro model for testicular germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-7389132.summary_ja: 原発性無月経を呈し、表現型は女性で染色体は男性の20歳患者に、右側生殖腺の胎児性癌が発生した症例である。血清は従来型のβ-hCG測定法とβサブユニット特異的測定法で陽性、完全型絨毛性ゴナドトロピン特異的測定法では陰性であった。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)などは正常範囲であった。測定法の特異性が腫瘍検出に与える影響と、β-hCG測定法の名称の曖昧さが議論されている。
pmid-7389132.summary_en: A 20-year-old patient, phenotypically female and genotypically male, with primary amenorrhea developed an embryonal carcinoma of the right gonad. Serum was positive on a classical beta-hCG assay and a beta-subunit-specific assay but negative on a specific intact choriogonadotropin assay. Placental lactogen, alpha-fetoprotein, and alpha subunit levels were normal. The authors argue for early evaluation of primary amenorrhea and discuss how assay specificity affects detection of neoplasia and the ambiguous nomenclature of beta-hCG assays.

pmid-7390656.summary_ja: マウス初期胚の全体、または胚体部・胚外部を同系成体の腎被膜下に移植し、奇形癌の発生能を検討した研究である。7日胚の全体移植で腫瘍の発生率が最も高かった。7日胚から胚外部を除くと腫瘍数は6日胚並みに低下し、胚外部単独では腫瘍は生じなかった。胚外部組織が胚体部からの奇形癌形成を増強することが示唆され、胚細胞腫瘍の生物学を研究するモデルとして位置づけられる。
pmid-7390656.summary_en: This study examined teratocarcinogenesis in mice by transplanting early post-implantation embryos, or their embryonic and extraembryonic portions, under the kidney capsule of isogenic adults. The highest tumor yield came from whole 7-day embryos. Removing the extraembryonic portion of 7-day embryos reduced tumor numbers to levels seen with 6-day embryos, and the extraembryonic portion alone produced no tumors. The findings suggest extraembryonic tissue enhances teratocarcinoma formation from the embryonic portion, making this a murine model relevant to germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-7391903.summary_ja: 乳児に生じた片側性眼球突出を呈する先天性眼窩奇形腫の1例報告である。外見は重篤であったが、早期の介入と奇形腫の摘出により眼球と視機能を温存できた。この希少な良性疾患について文献的考察を加え、治療上の提言を示している。頭蓋内ではなく眼窩に生じた奇形腫であり、胚細胞腫瘍関連の文献として扱われる。
pmid-7391903.summary_en: This report describes a case of congenital orbital teratoma in an infant that caused unilateral exophthalmos. Despite its alarming appearance, the authors preserved both the eye and vision through early intervention and removal of the teratoma. The paper reviews the literature on this rare benign condition and offers clinical recommendations for management. It is a teratoma of the orbit rather than a CNS tumor and is relevant to germ cell tumor literature as a benign teratoma case.

pmid-7393507.summary_ja: 313名の女性と追加の5例を超音波検査で評価し、50例の胞状奇胎を確認した。超音波検査は診断に有用であったが、黄体嚢胞の検出率は臨床診察より高かった。子宮容積の過大評価傾向が見られた一方、掻爬後の侵入奇胎や絨毛癌の発生は子宮の大きさや黄体嚢胞の有無と関連しなかった。
pmid-7393507.summary_en: This 1980 study evaluated pelvic sonography for hydatidiform mole in 313 referred women plus 5 unsuspected cases; 50 molar pregnancies were confirmed. Sonography showed 2 false-positive and 2 false-negative results. Theca lutein cysts were detected by ultrasound in 37% versus 10% clinically. Sonographic uterine volume tended to overestimate gestational age by 3.5 weeks. Large-for-dates uterus and theca lutein cysts did not predict postevacuation invasive mole or choriocarcinoma, so sonography cannot predict clinical course despite being an excellent diagnostic tool.

pmid-7394959.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍100例を後方視的に解析し、精巣摘除術前の症状とその持続期間を分類した。症状の持続期間は病期と相関し、局所浸潤性病変の75%が病期IIまたはIIIの患者に認められた。症状発現から手術までの遅延が進行病期と関連することが示唆された。
pmid-7394959.summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 100 patients with testicular germ cell tumors examined presenting symptoms and their duration before orchiectomy. Symptom duration correlated with disease stage for each tumor type. Seventy-five percent of locally invasive lesions occurred in patients with stage II or III disease. The findings suggest that prolonged symptoms before surgical evaluation may be associated with more advanced disease, underscoring the importance of prompt evaluation of testicular symptoms.

pmid-7394969.summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清術を受けた患者の後方視的解析で、A型血液型の割合が正常集団より有意に高かった。この所見から、A型血液型を持つ人は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を発症しやすい遺伝的素因がある可能性が示唆された。ただし、本研究は仮説提示の段階であり、因果関係を確立するものではない。
pmid-7394969.summary_en: A retrospective review of patients undergoing retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy found a significantly high proportion with blood type A, well above any known normal population. The authors propose that a genetic predisposition linked to type A blood may increase susceptibility to nonseminomatous germ cell carcinoma. This small clinical observation from 1980 is hypothesis-generating and suggests a possible genetic link rather than establishing causation. It remains a historical report without large control comparison.

pmid-7394994.summary_ja: 46,XY核型を持つ生後6か月の表現型女児の発育不全性性腺で、微小性の性腺芽腫を認めた。電子顕微鏡所見では胚細胞が精巣胚細胞に類似し、性索細胞は未熟であった。これは患者の精巣のセルトリ細胞とは異なり、未熟な顆粒膜細胞に近い所見であった。乳児期でも性索細胞が正常なホルモン調節に反応しうることを示唆する単一症例の超微細構造研究である。
pmid-7394994.summary_en: A microscopic gonadoblastoma was found in the dysgenetic gonad of a six-month-old phenotypic female with a 46,XY karyotype. Electron microscopy showed germ cells resembling testicular germ cells and immature sex cord cells that differed from Sertoli cells of the patient's testis, more consistent with immature granulosa cells. The findings suggest that sex cord cells in infant gonadoblastoma remain responsive to normal hormonal regulation. This is a single-case ultrastructural report from 1980.

pmid-7397629.summary_ja: クアラルンプール大学病院における10年間のレビューで、小児の奇形腫の発生頻度は他の小児腫瘍と同程度であった。好発部位は仙尾部、性腺、後腹膜であった。後腹膜症例の割合が他国より高い理由は不明である。受診の遅れやフォローアップ不良は予後不良と関連しており、早期診断の重要性が示された。
pmid-7397629.summary_en: A ten-year review at University Hospital Kuala Lumpur of teratomas in infants and children. Incidence was similar to other childhood tumors compared with Caucasian children. Common sites were sacrococcygeal, gonadal, and retroperitoneal. The high retroperitoneal proportion versus other countries remained unexplained. Late presentation and poor follow-up were associated with poor prognosis, highlighting the need for early diagnosis and adequate surveillance.

pmid-7401191.summary_ja: 高周波デジタル超音波装置を用いて精巣病変の微細な変化を検出した奇形癌の症例報告である。奇形癌は原発巣が臨床的に明らかになる前に転移巣として現れることがある。本症例では精巣異常を検出し、病変の広がりを描出して手術計画に役立てた。連続的な超音波検査によるフォローアップも行われた。
pmid-7401191.summary_en: Describes the use of high-frequency digital ultrasound to detect subtle testicular abnormalities in a case of teratocarcinoma. Teratocarcinoma often presents as metastases before the primary testicular lesion is clinically evident. In this case the testicular abnormality was detected, though a large secondary mass was also present. Ultrasound mapped the extent of disease, aiding surgical planning, and was used for serial follow-up studies.

pmid-7402659.summary_ja: 頸部に発生した悪性奇形腫の1症例を報告し、急速に進行する本疾患に対して精巣奇形腫で用いられる化学療法プロトコルが治療成績を改善する可能性があると提案する。性腺外に発生した胚細胞腫瘍としての奇形腫の症例であり、治療戦略に関する示唆を含む。
pmid-7402659.summary_en: A case report of malignant cervical teratoma, a rapidly progressive disease in a patient. The authors propose that chemotherapy protocols used for testicular teratoma may improve outcomes in this condition. The paper is short and primarily a clinical case presentation with a therapeutic suggestion rather than a formal cohort analysis. It is relevant as an extragonadal germ cell tumor (teratoma) at an unusual site.

pmid-7402661.summary_ja: 本報告は、重度の上気道閉塞を呈した未熟児に生じた鼻咽頭の真性奇形腫の症例である。奇形腫は複数の異所性組織を含む腫瘍で、この部位では類皮嚢胞が最も多い組織型である。著者らは世界文献を概観し、鼻咽頭奇形腫が極めてまれであることを確認している。
pmid-7402661.summary_en: This 1980 case report describes a premature neonate with severe upper airway obstruction caused by a true teratoma of the nasopharynx. Teratomas are neoplasms containing multiple heterotopic tissues, and dermoids are the most common histologic subtype in this location. The authors review the world literature and confirm that nasopharyngeal teratoma is extremely rare in neonates and infants.

pmid-7403332.summary_ja: 11例を対象とした多施設共同試験で、15(S)-15-メチルプロスタグランジンF2αの筋肉内反復投与による胞状奇胎の妊娠終結を検討した。9例（82%）で奇胎組織の排出が得られ、消化器系の副作用が多くみられた。胞状奇胎の管理におけるプロスタグランジンの位置づけを論じている。
pmid-7403332.summary_en: This multicentre trial evaluated repeated intramuscular injections of 15(S)-15-methyl-prostaglandin F2 alpha for terminating molar pregnancy in eleven patients. Expulsion of molar tissue, complete or incomplete, occurred in nine patients (82%) after a median of about 16 hours. Gastrointestinal side effects were common. The authors discuss the role of prostaglandins in managing hydatidiform mole.

pmid-7404112.summary_ja: 新生児の甲状腺に発生した頸部奇形腫の症例を報告している。腫瘤により閉塞性の呼吸器症状が生じた。甲状腺の奇形腫は極めてまれであり、新生児の気道を圧迫しうることを示す症例である。詳細な病理組織学的所見や長期経過は記載されていない。
pmid-7404112.summary_en: This report describes a cervical teratoma arising in the thyroid gland of a neonate. The lesion caused obstructive respiratory symptoms requiring attention. Thyroid teratomas are exceedingly rare, and this case illustrates how such a mass can compromise the neonatal airway. The report is brief, focusing on the clinical presentation of the neonate rather than detailed histopathology or long-term outcome.

pmid-7404154.summary_ja: 成人の心膜内に生じた奇形腫の外科的切除に成功した症例を報告している。多くが乳児期に発見されるのに対し、本例は成人期に認められた。腫瘍が重要な心臓の構造に強く癒着していたため、人工心肺を補助的に用いた。性腺外奇形腫の手術上の課題が示されている。
pmid-7404154.summary_en: This case report describes successful surgical removal of an intrapericardial teratoma in an adult. The tumour was rare and was recognised in adult life, unlike most cases found in infancy. Cardiopulmonary bypass was used as a technical aid because the tumour was firmly adherent to vital cardiac structures. The report highlights the surgical challenges of this extragonadal lesion.

pmid-7404272.summary_ja: PCC4-aza1奇形癌細胞と胸腺細胞またはリンパ性白血病細胞とのハイブリッドを作製した研究である。ハイブリッドは生体内で奇形癌を形成し、胎児抗原F9を保持していた。白血病由来ハイブリッドでは神経外胚葉への分化が優位であった。胎児性癌様細胞の発生能が検討されている。
pmid-7404272.summary_en: This study generated hybrids between PCC4-aza-1 teratocarcinoma cells and thymus or lymphocytic leukaemia cells. The hybrids were carcinoma cells that formed teratocarcinomas when injected into hosts, and they retained embryonic antigen F9 while lacking detectable H-2 alloantigens. Well differentiated tumours contained many somatic tissues, whereas leukaemia-derived hybrids mainly showed neuroectodermal differentiation. The work examines the developmental potential of embryonal carcinoma-like cells.

pmid-7404915.summary_ja: 不妊症の精査中に、萎縮した精巣からセミノーマが偶発的に発見された。著者らは本症例を文献的に検討している。精巣萎縮と精巣腫瘍の関連を明らかにするため、さらなる検討の必要性を指摘している。抄録には患者の年齢や治療の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-7404915.summary_en: A seminoma was incidentally found in an atrophic testis during infertility evaluation. The authors reviewed the literature on this association. The case highlights that testicular atrophy and germ cell tumour may coexist, and the authors call for further investigation into whether atrophy is linked to testicular tumour development. Clinical details such as patient age and management are not given in the abstract.

pmid-7407917.summary_ja: PGK変異体を異型接合体として持つ雌胚から奇形癌を誘導し、胎児性癌細胞株P10を樹立した。P10細胞は正常な雌核型を持ち、両方のX染色体が活性化している。分化した細胞では一方のX染色体が不活化しており、雌の胎児性癌細胞の分化にX染色体不活化が伴うことが示された。
pmid-7407917.summary_en: The authors induced teratocarcinomas in female embryos heterozygous for PGK electrophoretic variants and isolated the embryonal carcinoma cell line P10. P10 cells have a normal female karyotype, express both PGK forms, and both X chromosomes replicate synchronously in early S phase, so they contain two active X chromosomes. Some differentiated cells show an inactive X chromosome, indicating that X inactivation accompanies differentiation of female embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-7411531.summary_ja: 本報告は、腹水と胸水を伴い、卵巣甲状腺腫（甲状腺組織が主体の単胚葉性奇形腫）が関連した偽Meigs症候群の症例である。腹水の由来は不明な点が多く、この病態の理解は限られている。著者らは症例を文献に加え、慎重な鑑別診断の重要性を指摘している。
pmid-7411531.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with pseudo Meigs' syndrome, a variant of Meigs' syndrome in which ascites and hydrothorax accompany an ovarian tumor. The associated tumor was a struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma composed predominantly of thyroid tissue. The authors add this case to the limited literature on the association of ascites, hydrothorax and struma ovarii. They discuss the uncertain origin of the ascitic fluid, noting how little is known about these conditions, and emphasize the importance of careful differential diagnosis.

pmid-7416555.summary_ja: 前縦隔の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に起因する再発性心膜炎の症例報告である。臨床所見、心血管造影、外科所見、病理所見が記載されている。長期にわたる再発性心膜炎という典型的な臨床像と、良好な外科的治療成績が特徴である。
pmid-7416555.summary_en: This case report presents a patient with a benign cystic teratoma of the anterior mediastinum who presented with long-standing recurrent pericarditis. The authors describe the clinical, angiocardiographic, surgical, and pathologic findings. They highlight the cardinal clinical picture of long-standing recurrent pericarditis and the excellent surgical results, which make the case noteworthy. The report shows how a mediastinal germ cell tumor can present with pericardial disease.

pmid-7417899.summary_ja: 在胎33週半で出生した新生児の仙尾部奇形腫の症例である。腫瘍には異常な腹腔内嚢胞成分が含まれ、肺合併症の原因となった。羊水造影とエコー検査は子宮内での病変診断に有用であったと報告しており、出生前画像診断の価値を示している。
pmid-7417899.summary_en: This report describes a newborn infant delivered at 33 1/2 weeks' gestation who underwent surgery for a sacrococcygeal teratoma. The tumour contained an unusual intra-abdominal cystic component that caused pulmonary problems. The authors note that amniography and echography were useful for diagnosing the lesion in utero, highlighting the value of prenatal imaging for this congenital tumour. The case illustrates both the atypical presentation and the diagnostic role of antenatal imaging.

pmid-7420580.summary_ja: 精巣の胎児性奇形癌患者が、高用量ビンブラスチン投与後に抗利尿ホルモン不適切分泌症候群を発症した症例である。臨床経過と検査所見を検討している。高用量ビンブラスチン投与を受ける患者はこの症候群のリスクがあると結論づけており、胚細胞腫瘍の治療上の注意点となる。
pmid-7420580.summary_en: This report describes a patient with an embryonal teratocarcinoma of the testis who developed the syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion after receiving high-dose vinblastine.
