The authors discuss the clinical course and laboratory findings. They conclude that patients receiving high-dose vinblastine may be at risk of developing this syndrome, which is a relevant consideration in germ cell tumor management.

pmid-7420607.summary_ja: まれな先天異常である脾性腺融合が未分化セミノーマに伴った症例の報告である。関連文献をレビューし、この異常の2つの主要な分類について考察している。腹腔内の精巣腫瘍に伴う脾性腺融合の初の報告とされ、発生異常と胚細胞腫瘍の珍しい関連を示している。
pmid-7420607.summary_en: This report describes a case of splenogonadal fusion, a rare congenital anomaly, associated with an anaplastic seminoma. The authors review the literature on this anomaly and discuss the two principal classifications. They state that this is the first reported case of splenogonadal fusion associated with an intra-abdominal testicular neoplasm. The case highlights an unusual link between a developmental malformation and a germ cell tumor.

pmid-7422393.summary_ja: 新生児に生じるまれで致死的になりうる心膜内奇形腫についての報告である。心胸腺陰影の拡大と心膜液貯留といった特徴的な画像所見が術前診断に重要であると述べている。外科的治療は通常根治的であるが、診断されない場合は多くが致死的となる。早期発見と迅速な手術の重要性を強調している。
pmid-7422393.summary_en: This report discusses intrapericardial teratoma, a rare and potentially fatal neoplasm in newborns. The authors explain that preoperative diagnosis depends on recognizing specific radiographic and echocardiographic findings, such as a large cardiothymic image with pericardial effusion. Surgical intervention is usually curative, whereas undiagnosed intrapericardial teratoma is often fatal. The paper emphasizes early recognition and prompt surgery for this rare germ cell tumor in infants.

pmid-7424978.summary_ja: 本論文は、XY型性腺異形成を伴う身長の高い表現型女性の三姉妹を報告している。最年少者の左側線状性腺から性腺芽腫が見つかり、双方の線状性腺がアンドロゲンを分泌していたことを静脈血中の測定で示した。臨床所見と家族内発症傾向から、著者らはこれを男性仮性半陰陽の重症型と考察している。
pmid-7424978.summary_en: This report describes three tall phenotypic female siblings with XY gonadal dysgenesis, bilateral streak gonads, and androgen secretion from the gonads. A gonadoblastoma was found in the youngest sibling's left streak gonad, and an adenomatoid tumor in the oldest sibling's. Androgen measurements from peripheral and gonadal venous plasma indicated androgen production by the streak gonads. Based on clinical features, familial occurrence, and gonadal androgen secretion, the authors propose that XY gonadal dysgenesis represents a severe form of male pseudohermaphroditism.

pmid-7425701.summary_ja: 播種性精巣がんに化学療法を行った後も胸部病変が残った22例を対象に、外科的切除を行った報告である。6例は両側肺または縦隔病変のため正中切開を要した。化学療法後の転移の一部は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫へと組織像が変化していた。積極的な手術は病理診断の確定と残存悪性腫瘍の切除に有用であり、手術死亡はなく合併症も少なかったと結論している。
pmid-7425701.summary_en: This series reports 22 patients aged 17 to 46 with testicular cancer and persistent thoracic disease after chemotherapy for disseminated disease, all treated surgically. Six required median sternotomy for bilateral pulmonary or mediastinal involvement. Chemotherapy had altered some metastases to mature cystic teratoma, and those patients were disease-free, while others showed embryonal carcinoma or necrotic, fibrosed nodules. The authors conclude that aggressive surgery clarifies pathology, removes residual malignancy, and guides further chemotherapy, with zero operative mortality and low morbidity.

pmid-7426343.summary_ja: 1977年から1979年にかけて悪性奇形腫の53例（男性43例、女性10例）に逐次的多剤化学療法を行った報告である。男性33例では67%が治療を中止し、19例が完全寛解した。生命表による生存率は66%と推定され、卵巣奇形腫の10例中9例が生存していた。悪性奇形腫は多くで治癒の可能性がある疾患となったと結論している。
pmid-7426343.summary_en: This study reports 53 patients with malignant teratomas treated with sequential multidrug chemotherapy between 1977 and 1979, including 43 males and 10 females. Among the 33 males initially treated, 67% discontinued therapy, with 19 achieving complete response. Life-table survival was projected at 66%, and nine of ten ovarian teratoma patients were alive. Most patients who died had adverse prognostic factors at the start of treatment. The authors conclude that malignant teratomas have become potentially curable and should be managed in specialized centers.

pmid-7426950.summary_ja: 後腹膜の傍大動脈転移（2cm超）を伴う精巣悪性奇形腫33例に対し、放射線療法や化学療法を行った後に残存腫瘤を外科的に切除した報告である。手術死亡は3%であった。未分化腫瘍の残存は前治療によって異なり、放射線療法のみでは61%、化学療法と放射線療法の併用では15%、化学療法のみでは57%に認められた。前治療により病理所見が異なることを示している。
pmid-7426950.summary_en: This report describes 33 patients with malignant testicular teratomas and para-aortic metastases larger than 2 cm, treated with radiotherapy, chemotherapy, or both, followed by surgical excision of residual masses. Nephrectomy was needed in 21% and caval resection in 12.5% of patients with right-sided tumors, with 3% operative mortality. Undifferentiated tumor was found in 61% after radiotherapy alone, 15% after combined chemotherapy and radiotherapy, and 57% after chemotherapy alone. The authors suggest that pathological findings depend on prior treatment and that surgical excision remains important.

pmid-7427909.summary_ja: 甲状腺組織とカルチノイドが混在する卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍50例を解析した報告である。多くは類皮嚢腫または成熟奇形腫から生じていた。ほぼ常に良性であり、腫瘍死は1例のみであった。単純卵巣摘出術または卵管卵巣摘出術により治療効果が得られると結論している。
pmid-7427909.summary_en: This study analyzes 50 patients with strumal carcinoid of the ovary, a germ cell tumor combining thyroid tissue and carcinoid, most often arising in dermoid cysts or mature teratomas. Most tumors were unilateral and benign. Only one patient died of tumor, while five died of unrelated causes and the rest remained alive, many for over ten years. Hormonal symptoms were uncommon. Although considered a malignant transformation of struma ovarii, the tumor is almost always benign, and simple oophorectomy or salpingo-oophorectomy is generally effective.

pmid-7428276.summary_ja: 1960年から1973年に治療された精巣セミノーマの横隔膜上転移44例を検討した報告である。9例は初診時に転移を有し、残りは腹部照射後に転移を生じた。全肺照射を受けた33例の完全寛解率は55%と低く、長期生存者は6例のみであった。横隔膜下病変の良好な治療成績とは対照的であったと述べている。
pmid-7428276.summary_en: This study reviews 44 patients with supradiaphragmatic metastases from testicular seminoma, treated between 1960 and 1973. Nine had metastases at presentation, while the rest developed them after abdominal irradiation. Only six were long-term survivors. Thirty-three received whole lung irradiation, which achieved a complete remission rate of only 55% despite a dose causing pulmonary radiation damage in some patients. The authors note that these results contrast with the excellent response seen in subdiaphragmatic disease.

pmid-7429065.summary_ja: 奇形癌の多能性幹細胞であるマウス胎児性癌細胞の初期分化を、フロー細胞酵素学で解析した研究である。長期培養細胞もアルカリフォスファターゼ活性を保持し、分化に伴い活性の低い子孫細胞を生じた。形態学的分化に先立ち、エステラーゼ活性は不均一であった。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍症例を扱う基礎研究である。
pmid-7429065.summary_en: This study uses dual-parameter flow cytoenzymology to examine early biochemical differentiation of mouse embryonal carcinoma cells, the multipotent stem cells of teratocarcinomas. Alkaline phosphatase and carboxyl esterase activities were measured. Long-term in vitro passaged cells retained high alkaline phosphatase activity, similar to cells grown in vivo, and gave rise to progeny with reduced activity. Esterase activity was heterogeneous before morphological differentiation became evident. The alkaline phosphatase was inhibited by 1-p-bromotetramisole, suggesting a relationship with somatic non-intestinal isoenzymes.

pmid-7431360.summary_ja: 大きな仙尾部奇形腫を合併した妊娠で胎盤肥大が認められた症例報告である。奇形腫が動静脈瘻のように作用して胎児の高拍出性心不全を生じ、その結果として胎盤が肥大したと著者は考察している。胎児の奇形腫と胎盤の変化を結びつける機序として、出生前管理の参考となる。
pmid-7431360.summary_en: This report describes a pregnancy complicated by a large sacrococcygeal teratoma in which the placenta was enlarged. The authors propose that placentomegaly resulted from high-output fetal cardiac failure, with the teratoma acting as an arteriovenous fistula that increased cardiac load. They contrast this mechanism with other recognised causes of placental enlargement, including erythroblastosis fetalis, intrauterine infection, and chorioangioma. The report offers a mechanistic link between a fetal germ cell tumour and altered placental growth, which may inform prenatal assessment and monitoring of similarly affected pregnancies.

pmid-7436625.summary_ja: 病期IおよびIIの非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍患者15例に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した報告である。術前準備と経腹的前方アプローチの手技を記載している。大きな手術であったが死亡例や重篤な術後合併症はなかった。停留精巣由来の腫瘍が2例あり、正常な射精機能を回復した患者はいなかった。長期フォローアップ中の5例は無病で経過している。
pmid-7436625.summary_en: This report describes fifteen patients with stage I and II nonseminomatous testicular tumours who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection as part of treatment. The paper details preoperative preparation and the anterior transabdominal surgical approach. No deaths or major postoperative complications occurred despite the extensive surgery. Two tumours arose in an undescended testis, and no patient regained normal ejaculatory function. The authors highlight the proper management of patients who had undergone transscrotal biopsy or orchiectomy. Five patients with relatively long-term follow-up remained disease-free.

pmid-7437970.summary_ja: 1942年から1978年にブリティッシュコロンビアで精巣セミノーマに放射線療法を受けた362例を後方視的に解析した。5年生存率は全体で87%、限局例で96%、転移例で62%であった。再発28例中15例は救済可能で、8例で対側精巣に二次性精巣腫瘍が発生した。
pmid-7437970.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviews 362 patients with testicular seminoma treated with radiation therapy in British Columbia between 1942 and 1978, 40 of whom had a history of maldescent. Disease was classified by TNM stage. Five-year survival was 87% overall, 96% for localised disease without nodal or distant involvement, and 62% for patients with palpable or distant metastases at presentation. Of 28 patients whose disease recurred, 15 were successfully treated. Eight patients developed a second testicular tumour in the contralateral testis, and the incidence of other cancers was not increased over the expected rate.

pmid-7438474.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎5例の除去前後と、手術・化学療法後の侵襲性栄養膜腫瘍12例で、hCGとそのα・βサブユニットを測定した。未除去の奇胎では、ネイティブhCGと遊離βサブユニットが著明に上昇していた。掻爬が成功すると40〜90日で正常化した。hCGとβサブユニットの軽度上昇は腫瘍の残存を示唆したが、αサブユニットは再発の検出に有用性が低かった。
pmid-7438474.summary_en: This study measured native hCG and its alpha and beta subunits in maternal serum from five non-invasive hydatidiform moles, before and after evacuation, and in twelve patients with invasive trophoblastic tumour after surgery and chemotherapy. In unevacuated moles, native hCG and free hCG beta were markedly elevated, while free alpha was normal or slightly raised. Successful curettage normalised levels within 40 to 90 days. Persistent tumour was signalled by a slight rise in native hCG and the beta subunit, whereas measuring the alpha subunit was less useful for detecting relapse.

pmid-7439017.summary_ja: 大網に発生した良性嚢胞性奇形腫の一例を報告する。病理所見から、大網腫瘍は左卵巣から遊離したものと考えられ、左付属器には卵巣組織がわずかに残存していた。右卵巣にも第2の嚢胞性奇形腫があり、術中には転移(性)癌と誤認された。
pmid-7439017.summary_en: A rare case of benign cystic teratoma located in the omentum is reported. Pathological findings suggested that the omental tumor detached from the left ovary, which retained only a small residual portion. The patient also had a second cystic teratoma in the right ovary, a ventral hernia, adhesions, and a ruptured appendiceal mucocele. The coexistence of these lesions led to an initial intraoperative impression of metastatic carcinoma.

pmid-7441838.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍83例と腎細胞癌34例を対象に、全肺断層撮影と胸部X線を比較した。胸部X線陰性の精巣腫瘍患者の17%で、断層撮影により転移(性)病変が確認された。単発病変と判定された症例の一部でも、多発性であることが判明した。X線の偽陽性は両群とも、重なり影、血管、肉芽腫が原因であった。
pmid-7441838.summary_en: This study compared whole lung tomography with chest radiography for detecting pulmonary metastases in 83 patients with testicular tumors and 34 with renal cell carcinoma. Tomography revealed additional metastatic lesions in 17 percent of testicular tumor patients with negative chest x-rays. It also showed multiple lesions in some patients with a solitary lesion on radiography. False-positive radiographic findings due to overlapping shadows, vessels, or granulomas were common in both groups.

pmid-7443119.summary_ja: 原発性無月経を呈した17歳の表現型女性で、45,XO核型と一部ターナー症候群の身体的特徴を有していた。腹腔鏡検査で線条卵巣と幼児子宮が認められ、卵巣生検で性腺芽細胞腫が偶然発見された。全腹式子宮摘出術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術が施行された。
pmid-7443119.summary_en: A 17-year-old phenotypic female with primary amenorrhea and a 45,XO karyotype showed some stigmata of Turner syndrome. Laparoscopy revealed streak ovaries and an infantile uterus, and ovarian biopsy unexpectedly identified gonadoblastoma. The patient underwent total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. The authors discuss the rationale for laparoscopy and ovarian biopsy in an asymptomatic patient and the incidental discovery of a malignant neoplasm.

pmid-7444051.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫を有する新生児4例の術前動脈造影所見を報告する。本腫瘍は出生時に皮膚に覆われた尾側の腫瘤として現れることが多く、骨盤内および仙骨前への進展様式や血行の多様性から出血による死亡率が高い。動脈造影は手術前に血管解剖を明らかにし、他の尾側腫瘤との鑑別に有用である。
pmid-7444051.summary_en: This report describes preoperative arteriographic findings in four neonates with sacrococcygeal teratoma. These tumors often present at birth as skin-covered caudal masses and carry a high risk of fatal hemorrhage because of variable intrapelvic and presacral extension and blood supply. Arteriography helps define vascular anatomy before surgery and distinguishes these tumors from other caudal masses.

pmid-7444199.summary_ja: 本総説は、マウスにおける奇形腫形成を要約したものである。一部の亜系統では精巣奇形腫が原始生殖細胞に由来し、卵巣奇形腫は単為発生により活性化された卵母細胞に由来する。著者らは、胚由来の奇形腫と移植可能な奇形癌について記述し、それらが正常なキメラ発生に寄与しうることを示している。さらに、LT系統における自然単為発生と、単為発生胚が子宮内で生存できない理由についても論じている。
pmid-7444199.summary_en: This review summarizes teratocarcinogenesis in mice. Testicular teratomas arise from primordial germ cells in certain sublines, while ovarian teratomas derive from parthenogenetically activated oocytes. The authors describe embryo-derived teratomas and transplantable teratocarcinomas, including their capacity to contribute to normal chimeric development. They also discuss spontaneous parthenogenesis in LT strain oocytes and why parthenogenetic embryos fail to survive in utero.

pmid-7446011.summary_ja: 正常妊娠および絨毛性腫瘍患者の血清と脳脊髄液でβ-hCGを放射免疫測定法により測定した。正常妊娠および脳転移のない腫瘍では血清/脳脊髄液比が高値であった。脳絨毛癌の2例では比が約21〜23対1と著しく低かった。血清/脳脊髄液のβ-hCG比は、絨毛癌の脳転移の早期検出に有用である可能性がある。
pmid-7446011.summary_en: This study measured beta-hCG by radioimmunoassay in paired serum and cerebrospinal fluid from women with normal pregnancies and trophoblastic neoplasia. Normal pregnancies and non-metastatic neoplasia showed high serum-to-CSF ratios. Two patients with cerebral choriocarcinoma had markedly lower ratios of about 21 and 23 to 1. The authors suggest that the serum-to-CSF beta-hCG ratio may enable earlier detection of choriocarcinoma metastasis to the brain.

pmid-7446619.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の良性嚢胞性奇形腫16例（6年間）を解析した1980年の報告。悪性腫瘍の発生率は19%、両側性は20%だった。腫瘍組織の著明な膠原線維化が認められ、終末期の状態を示すと解釈された。悪性腫瘍の頻度が高いことから、病変の範囲を明らかにするための積極的な外科的病期分類が必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-7446619.summary_en: This 1980 study of 16 postmenopausal women with benign cystic teratomas over six years found a 19% incidence of malignancy and 20% bilateral involvement. Marked collagenization of the tumor tissue was seen, interpreted as an end-stage process. The authors conclude that the high malignancy rate in this group warrants vigorous surgical staging to define the extent of disease.

pmid-7447794.summary_ja: 生後1か月の乳児にみられた鼻咽頭奇形腫の症例報告。有毛性ポリープ様の外観を呈した。哺乳時や腹臥位で咳嗽、呼吸困難、チアノーゼを繰り返し、腹臥位では長い茎を持つ腫瘍が喉頭入口部に移動して上気道閉塞を起こした。速やかな摘出により致死的な呼吸イベントを防いだ。新生児・乳児の上気道窮迫の鑑別診断で本疾患を考慮すべきと強調している。
pmid-7447794.summary_en: This case report describes a one-month-old infant with a nasopharyngeal teratoma presenting as a hairy polyp. Recurrent episodes of cough, dyspnea, and cyanosis occurred, particularly during feeding or in the prone position; in that position the tumor's long stalk moved over the laryngeal entrance, causing upper airway obstruction. Prompt surgical removal prevented a potentially fatal respiratory event. The authors emphasize that this rare congenital teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of neonatal or infantile upper airway distress.

pmid-7452785.summary_ja: セミノーマによる下大静脈閉塞の超音波診断を報告した症例論文である。下大静脈内の腫瘤と外部からの圧迫を区別する超音波所見を考察している。セミノーマ患者では病期分類の過程で腹部・後腹膜腫瘤の評価に超音波検査が頻用されることを踏まえ、その有用性を論じている。
pmid-7452785.summary_en: This report describes a patient with a seminoma causing obstruction of the inferior vena cava, a complication not previously reported. The authors discuss the ultrasonographic diagnosis of this lesion and the sonographic features that distinguish an intracaval mass from extrinsic compression of the vena cava. The paper emphasizes the role of ultrasound in evaluating abdominal and retroperitoneal masses in seminoma patients during staging.

pmid-7452810.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、領域・遠隔転移の頻度が低いことで知られる精巣胚細胞腫瘍の亜型、転移性精母細胞性セミノーマを記述している。画像検査で、以前に照射された領域内での腫瘍再発が示された。著者らは、この病型の患者には積極的な初期治療と慎重なフォローアップが必要であると強調している。転移が稀な亜型であっても注意を払うことの重要性を示す報告である。
pmid-7452810.summary_en: This case report describes metastatic spermatocytic seminoma, a testicular germ cell tumor subtype noted for its low rate of regional and distant metastasis. Imaging showed tumor recurrence within a previously irradiated field. The authors emphasize that patients with this entity require aggressive initial management and careful long-term follow-up. The report underscores the importance of vigilance even though metastatic spread is uncommon in this histologic variant.

pmid-7453186.summary_ja: 原発性悪性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の3症例を提示し、文献を簡潔にレビューした報告である。これらの腫瘍の分類と鑑別診断は文献間で一貫しないことを指摘している。セミノーマは切除と放射線照射で比較的良好な成績が得られる一方、悪性奇形腫・胎児性癌・絨毛癌は治療法によらず予後不良であると述べている。
pmid-7453186.summary_en: This paper presents three patients with primary malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors and briefly reviews the literature. The authors note substantial inconsistency in published classification and differential diagnosis of these tumors. They report that resection and irradiation give relatively satisfactory results for seminomas, whereas malignant teratomas, embryonal carcinomas, and choriocarcinomas carry a poor prognosis regardless of treatment mode.

pmid-7456184.summary_ja: セミノーマに対する一次治療としての放射線療法の役割を論じた論文。病期Iでは傍大動脈・骨盤・鼠径リンパ節への照射を推奨し、hCG陰性の病期IIの多くでは縦隔・鎖骨上窩を含む照射が有効とする。巨大病変や術後hCG持続上昇例には手術と化学療法を、病期IIIには化学療法を提案している。腫瘍マーカーは診断と病期分類の鍵とされる。
pmid-7456184.summary_en: This article discusses the role of radiation therapy as a primary treatment for seminoma, a radiosensitive germ cell tumor. It recommends radiation to para-aortic and pelvic/inguinal nodes for stage I disease and to mediastinal and supraclavicular fields for most hCG-negative stage II patients. Surgery and chemotherapy are reserved for bulky stage II disease or persistent postorchiectomy hCG elevation, and stage III patients should receive initial chemotherapy. Serum tumor markers, particularly AFP, are described as key to diagnosis and staging.

pmid-7457573.summary_ja: マウス奇形腫－奇形癌モデルを、腫瘍性形質転換、発生生物学、遺伝学研究の系として論じた報告。129系統に自然発生し、他系統では胚の移植で誘発できる。胎児性癌細胞は全胚葉に分化しうる能力を持ち、胞胚への移植によって正常マウスの形成に寄与する。この系は新たな遺伝系統マウスの作出に応用できる可能性があると述べている。
pmid-7457573.summary_en: This paper reviews the murine teratoma-teratocarcinoma system as a model for neoplastic transformation, developmental biology, and genetics. Tumors arise spontaneously in 129 mice and can be induced in other strains by transplanting embryos or embryonic fragments to extrauterine sites. The authors explain that the embryonal carcinoma stem cell can differentiate into all germ layers, and that embryonal carcinoma cells injected into blastocysts can contribute to normal mice. They suggest this system may enable creation of new genetic mouse strains.

pmid-7460981.summary_ja: 1960年以降に精巣悪性奇形腫の60例に施行された足背リンパ管造影の有用性を検討した報告。後腹膜リンパ節の組織学的所見との比較で正確度は88%であった。予後予測的価値は重要とされ、下大静脈造影や尿路造影の追加情報は少なかった。コンピュータ断層撮影や超音波検査などの現代的画像診断は、精巣腫瘍の病期分類に大きく寄与すると結論づけている。
pmid-7460981.summary_en: This study evaluated pedal lymphangiography in 60 patients with testicular malignant teratoma treated since 1960, who subsequently underwent retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. Lymphangiography accurately predicted retroperitoneal nodal status in 88% of cases when compared with histology. The authors found its prognostic value important, while cavography and urography added little information. They conclude that modern imaging such as CT, and possibly ultrasound, will greatly aid staging of testicular tumors.

pmid-7463301.summary_ja: 1980年の新生児の心膜内奇形腫の症例報告。乳児期早期に重篤な心肺窮迫を呈し、心胸郭陰影の拡大を伴っていた。心エコーで心膜液貯留と心臓の偏位を認め、診断の手がかりとなった。早期に認識できたことで外科的切除により救命に成功した点が報告されている。
pmid-7463301.summary_en: This 1980 case report describes an intrapericardial teratoma in an early infant that caused critical cardiorespiratory distress with enlargement of the cardiothymic silhouette. Echocardiography revealed pericardial effusion and cardiac displacement, which pointed to the diagnosis. Early recognition enabled surgical resection and a successful outcome. The authors emphasize that prompt echocardiographic evaluation of neonates with unexplained cardiorespiratory distress can enable timely surgery, since this rare extragonadal tumor often proves fatal in infancy.

pmid-7469199.summary_ja: 精巣細胞核のDNA解析により、精子形成の抑制や捻転による壊死、悪性精巣腫瘍を評価した1980年の研究。非セミノーマはセミノーマより正常精巣との差が大きかった。DNAヒストグラムは術中の精巣温存・摘出判断や、精巣がんの予後情報の補助になり得ると述べている。
pmid-7469199.summary_en: A 1980 study used flow-through cytophotometric DNA analysis of testicular nuclei to assess spermatogenesis, torsion-related necrosis, and malignant testicular tumors. Malignant tumors showed more S-phase cells, hypertetraploid regions and aneuploid peaks, and nonseminomas differed more from normal testes than seminomas did. The authors suggest DNA histograms can aid intraoperative decisions about conserving or removing a testis and may offer prognostic information for testicular carcinomas.

pmid-7471049.summary_ja: ヌードマウス内で増殖させたヒト腫瘍によるhCGとそのサブユニットの産生を検討した1980年の研究。絨毛癌由来のJAR細胞は、培養時に比べ生体内で完全型hCGの割合が増加した。生体内環境によって腫瘍のhCGサブユニット分泌パターンが変化することが示された。
pmid-7471049.summary_en: This 1980 study examines production of hCG and its alpha and beta subunits by human tumors grown in nude mice. JAR choriocarcinoma cells produced more intact hCG and less free alpha subunit in vivo than in culture, while HeLa, ChaGo and BT-20 lines continued producing mainly free alpha. A glioblastoma line also produced both alpha and hCG-beta in vivo, unlike its culture pattern. The findings show that the in vivo environment alters the pattern of hCG subunit secretion by tumors compared with cultured cells.

pmid-7471097.summary_ja: 精巣がん11例の細胞株14株を染色体分染法で解析し、1番染色体の非ランダムな異常を報告した1980年の研究。q腕のトリソミーが多く、同一の標識染色体が原発巣と転移巣で共通して見られた。1番染色体の異常が精巣がんの高い悪性度と関連する可能性を論じている。
pmid-7471097.summary_en: Trypsin G-banding karyotyping of 14 cell lines from 11 patients with testicular cancer showed nonrandom chromosome 1 abnormalities, most often trisomy of the q arm, with breakpoints at p12, q12, p36 and p22 producing recurrent marker chromosomes. Identical markers appeared in lines from primary tumors and metastases of the same patient, suggesting the changes are not culture artifacts. The authors propose that consistent chromosome 1 involvement may relate to the highly malignant nature of testicular cancer.

pmid-7471109.summary_ja: 精巣由来の胎児性癌ECCSをヌードマウスに移植すると、分化を示さずに急速に増殖した。移植由来細胞の培養では胚様体に似た凝集体が形成されたが、マウス由来の悪性様細胞が培養を覆うことがあった。異種移植モデルの解釈には注意が必要であることを示している。
pmid-7471109.summary_en: A human testicular embryonal carcinoma, ECCS, was transplanted into athymic mice, where it grew rapidly without evident differentiation, and was also established as an in vitro culture from xenograft-derived cells. Cultured tumor cells formed embryoid body-like aggregates with an epithelial-like periphery, but a mouse-derived population with malignant features eventually overgrew the culture. The authors suggest these mouse cells may arise from transformation of stromal cells in vivo or in vitro, a caution for xenograft-derived models.

pmid-6162542.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、環状AMP類似体がSV40形質転換胎盤細胞と絨毛癌細胞のhCG合成に及ぼす影響を検討した。胎盤細胞ではhCGαサブユニットが主に誘導され、絨毛癌細胞では8BrcAMPがhCGを優先的に増やした。絨毛癌細胞は二つの実験系の一つである。
pmid-6162542.summary_en: This 1980 study examined how cyclic AMP analogues affect hCG and hCG alpha subunit synthesis in SV40 tsA-transformed human placental cells and in choriocarcinoma cells. In transformed and nontransformed placental cells, 8BrcAMP and Bt2cAMP strongly induced hCG alpha with little effect on intact hCG, raising the alpha-to-hCG ratio. In choriocarcinoma cells, both nucleotides stimulated hCG and hCG alpha, but 8BrcAMP preferentially increased hCG, lowering the ratio. The authors conclude that cyclic nucleotides differentially regulate hCG production without affecting hCG alpha production in these systems.

pmid-6244561.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9を、血清の代わりにフィブロネクチン・インスリン・トランスフェリンを含む定義培地で培養した研究。15世代以上にわたり造腫瘍能と分化能を保持した。接着にはフィブロネクチンが必須であった。レチノイン酸により分化が誘導され、形態変化とプラスミノゲンアクチベーター分泌の増加が見られた。ヒトの胚細胞腫瘍への直接的な言及は限定的である。
pmid-6244561.summary_en: The mouse embryonal carcinoma line F9 was grown and differentiated in a completely defined medium (EM-3) containing fibronectin, insulin, and transferrin instead of serum. Cells retained tumorigenicity and differentiation capacity over more than 15 passages. Fibronectin was essential for attachment and was blocked by anti-fibronectin antibody. Retinoic acid induced differentiation, with newly formed cells showing altered morphology and increased plasminogen activator secretion.

pmid-6246284.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来の細胞株における内因性キセノトロピックC型ウイルスRNAを解析した研究である。未分化細胞は分化細胞に比べ約6倍のウイルスRNAを発現し、3種類のRNAが同定された。ただし、ウイルス粒子やウイルスタンパク質は検出されなかった。奇形癌細胞をモデル系として用いた基礎ウイルス学の研究である。
pmid-6246284.summary_en: This study characterizes endogenous xenotropic type C virus RNA in murine teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines. Undifferentiated cells express about sixfold more viral RNA than differentiated cells, with three polyadenylated species detected. Despite this, no viral particles or viral proteins were found, which the authors describe as paradoxical. The work is basic virology using teratocarcinoma cells as a model system.

pmid-6251099.summary_ja: SV40で形質転換した5種類の奇形癌由来細胞株におけるウイルスT抗原の発現を調べました。抗原の保持量や合成速度と形質転換の程度との間に直接の相関は見られませんでした。増殖特性には、ウイルス抗原の量よりも細胞の背景が強く影響すると結論づけています。
pmid-6251099.summary_en: This study examines SV40 tumor antigen expression in five SV40-transformed teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines. The lines differ in growth characteristics and differentiation state. Antigen expression was assessed by immunoprecipitation in growing cells and by synthesis rate in density-inhibited cells. No direct correlation was found between antigen retention or synthesis rate and the degree of transformation. The authors conclude that the cellular background influences growth more than the level of viral antigen expression.

pmid-6262577.summary_ja: 未分化胚性癌株PCC4では、分化株PCD1と異なりC型レトロウイルスの増殖が強く制限される。両株ともウイルスDNA中間体は初期に形成されるが、PCC4では後期にそれが消失する。制限はウイルスDNAの形成と成熟の後の段階で起こることが示された。
pmid-6262577.summary_en: Investigates why Gross strain N-tropic type C retrovirus replicates poorly in the undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma line PCC4 from murine teratocarcinoma, while replicating productively in the differentiated line PCD1. Both lines form viral DNA intermediates early, but PCC4 loses them later, so restriction occurs after viral DNA formation and maturation. The paper is primarily virological, using teratocarcinoma-derived cells as the experimental system.

pmid-6774975.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞由来の高マンノース型糖ペプチドを解析した1980年の生化学研究である。4種の主要オリゴ糖は線維芽細胞由来のものと区別できなかった。初期胚細胞のN型糖鎖生合成は、初期のプロセシング段階まで成体細胞と同様に制御されていると結論づけている。腫瘍生物学ではなく糖鎖生物学が主題である。
pmid-6774975.summary_en: This 1980 biochemical study analysed high-mannose glycopeptides from embryonal carcinoma cells. Endo-beta-N-acetylglucosaminidase H released four major oligosaccharides, which were indistinguishable from those obtained from fibroblasts. The authors conclude that asparagine-linked oligosaccharide processing in early embryonic cells is regulated similarly to adult cells, at least through initial processing steps. Embryonal carcinoma cells serve as model material, and the paper focuses on glycosylation biology rather than tumour biology.

pmid-6934819.summary_ja: 下顎正中部に生じ、類皮嚢腫の組織学的特徴を示した嚢胞を報告している。全骨内性の類皮嚢腫としては、下顎で初めて詳細に記録された例とされる。歯原性および非歯原性の下顎正中部嚢胞との関係から、病因を考察している。胚細胞腫瘍の生物学や治療は扱っておらず、口腔外科領域の単一病変の報告である。
pmid-6934819.summary_en: This paper describes a midline cyst of the mandible showing histologic features of a dermoid cyst. The authors state it is apparently the first fully documented totally intra-osseous dermoid cyst of the mandible. They discuss its pathogenesis in relation to odontogenic and non-odontogenic cysts that occur in the mandibular midline. The report is a single-lesion description in oral and maxillofacial surgery and does not involve germ cell tumor biology or management.

pmid-6985757.summary_ja: タルムードの記述が膣類皮嚢腫の最初の記載である可能性を論じた短い歴史的考察である。原典の翻訳には不正確さが伴い、古代の「疣」の意味は確定できないと述べる。臨床例や病理、治療に関する記載は含まれず、主題は医学史的な解釈にある。
pmid-6985757.summary_en: This short historical commentary revisits a Talmudic passage that may be the earliest description of a vaginal dermoid cyst. The authors caution that translating the Talmud from its original language into English introduces imprecision, and that the ancient meaning of the word for wart remains uncertain. They suggest, without firm proof, that the reference may represent the first description of a vaginal dermoid. The paper contains no clinical case data, pathology, or treatment details. The dermoid cyst is a teratoma-family lesion arising outside the gonads.

pmid-6994266.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌株PCC4azaRと胸腺細胞・L細胞の体細胞雑種における抗原発現を調べた1980年の基礎研究。胸腺細胞雑種は胎児性抗原を保持し、H-2の発現はcis制御を示唆した。同系宿主では幹細胞と分化細胞を含む腫瘍を形成した。ヒトの胚細胞腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、胎児性癌細胞は実験モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-6994266.summary_en: This 1980 study examines somatic cell hybrids between a murine embryonal carcinoma line (PCC4azaR) and thymocytes or L cells. Thymocyte hybrids retained embryonic antigens SSEA-1 and 3C4-10 and expressed thymocyte-derived H-2Kk, while PCC4 H-2Db was not re-expressed, suggesting cis control. In syngeneic hosts, thymocyte hybrids formed tumors containing stem cells and differentiated derivatives. L-cell hybrids resembled the L-cell parent and formed undifferentiated sarcomas. The embryonal carcinoma line serves as a murine experimental model of immunogenetics rather than a clinical germ cell tumor study.

pmid-7407676.summary_ja: 未分化状態を維持したヒト奇形癌由来のPA-1細胞から得た糖ペプチドを解析した生化学的研究である。プロナーゼ消化により、マンノース、フコース、ガラクトース、N-アセチルグルコサミンからなる大型の糖鎖が得られた。パルスチェイス実験により、2つの糖ペプチド分画間の前駆体・産物関係が示唆された。
pmid-7407676.summary_en: This biochemical study analyses glycopeptides from PA-1 cells, a human teratocarcinoma-derived line maintained in an undifferentiated state. Pronase digestion yielded large glycopeptides with oligosaccharides composed of mannose, fucose, galactose, and N-acetylglucosamine. Oligomannosyl-type glycans ranging from Man5GlcNAc to Man9GlcNAc were also detected. Pulse-chase experiments suggested a precursor-product relationship between two glycopeptide fractions.

pmid-7430268.summary_ja: 全能性のマウス奇形癌細胞と骨髄腫細胞から体細胞雑種を作製した研究である。雑種は奇形癌の胎児性抗原を発現し、奇形癌親細胞のように振る舞った。一方で骨髄腫のH-2抗原も発現していた。再構成済みの免疫グロブリン遺伝子の発現を、マウス発生過程で調べる道具としての有用性が示されている。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を扱うものではない。
pmid-7430268.summary_en: The authors produced somatic cell hybrids between totipotent mouse teratocarcinoma cells and myeloma cells. The hybrids behaved like the teratocarcinoma parent and expressed teratocarcinoma embryonal antigens, but they also expressed myeloma H-2 antigens. The hybrids are proposed as a tool for studying expression of already rearranged immunoglobulin genes during mouse development. The brief report focuses on methods and utility rather than clinical germ cell tumors, so its relevance to germ cell tumor literature is limited.

pmid-7441158.summary_ja: 2種類の胎児性癌細胞株（F9およびPC13）が、着床前の8細胞期マウス胚と凝集する能力を検討した。両細胞株は胚に接着して圧縮され、培養下で胚盤胞を形成した。EC細胞は主に内細胞塊に位置した。一方、分化した誘導体（PYS-1、PYS-2）およびSTO線維芽細胞は凝集しなかった。
pmid-7441158.summary_en: This study examines the ability of two embryonal carcinoma cell lines, F9 and PC13, to aggregate with preimplantation 8-cell mouse embryos. Both cell lines adhered to and compacted with the embryos, forming blastocysts in culture, with EC cells located mainly in the inner cell mass. Differentiated derivatives (PYS-1 and PYS-2) and STO fibroblasts did not aggregate, suggesting that undifferentiated EC cells specifically interact with early embryos.

pmid-103398.summary_ja: 1979年の報告で、原発性縦隔セミノーマの新規4症例と既報103例をレビューしています。前縦隔に発生し、多くは30〜40代で、約30%は無症状でした。放射線療法への感受性が高く、腫瘍の著明な縮小が見られ、5年生存率は約75%です。組織発生に関する議論と病理診断基準も検討しています。
pmid-103398.summary_en: This 1979 review presents four new cases of primary mediastinal seminoma and summarizes 103 previously reported cases. Tumors arose in the anterior mediastinum, often appearing as lobulated noncalcified masses on chest radiography. Patients were mostly in their third and fourth decades, and about 30% were asymptomatic. Roughly 10% had superior vena cava obstruction. Tumors were radiosensitive and potentially curable, with dramatic shrinkage after radiation therapy and a 5-year survival of about 75%. The authors also review the histogenesis controversy and diagnostic pathologic criteria.

pmid-156064.summary_ja: 1979年のがん研究で、絨毛癌JAr細胞株にメトトレキサートなどのDNA合成阻害薬を処理した影響を検討しています。これらの薬剤でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)合成が2.5〜12倍に増加しました。チミジンやデオキシシチジンの添加で刺激は阻止されました。メトトレキサートによる刺激は主に薬剤除去後に起こり、蛋白合成に依存していました。
pmid-156064.summary_en: This 1979 Cancer Research study investigates choriocarcinoma JAr cells treated for 24 hours with DNA synthesis inhibitors, including methotrexate. These drugs stimulated hCG synthesis 2.5- to 12-fold while RNA and protein synthesis were not significantly depressed. Stimulation was blocked by thymidine or deoxycytidine and correlated with the duration of DNA synthesis inhibition. Methotrexate-induced stimulation occurred mostly after drug removal and required protein synthesis. The authors conclude that hCG stimulation is a direct consequence of DNA synthesis inhibition.

pmid-157614.summary_ja: 1979年の病理学誌に掲載された報告で、合胞体栄養膜巨細胞を伴う精巣セミノーマ2例を提示しています。この亜型はhCGを分泌するため、セミノーマと絨毛癌の混合腫瘍との鑑別診断が困難になることがあります。古典型、精母細胞型、未分化型などの各亜型との関係も検討しています。正確な分類のための臨床的・形態学的問題を論じています。
pmid-157614.summary_en: This 1979 Virchows Archiv paper describes two cases of testicular seminoma with syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells (STGC), a special form that can secrete hCG. The authors note that this feature complicates differential diagnosis from combined seminoma-choriocarcinoma tumors. They review classical, spermatocytic, and anaplastic seminoma variants and discuss the clinical and morphologic problems of this subtype. The report highlights the pathologic and clinical significance of accurate classification.

pmid-216053.summary_ja: 原発性精巣腫瘍の患者26例にCTを施行した研究です。CTはリンパ節転移の鑑別に非常に高い精度を示し、両足リンパ管造影では描出されないリンパ節病変も捉えられました。治療計画、フォローアップ、血清腫瘍マーカー陽性時の再発部位の同定にも有用であり、CTの落とし穴も論じています。
pmid-216053.summary_en: Twenty-six patients with primary testicular tumors were evaluated with computed tomography. CT was highly accurate in distinguishing lymph node metastases from testicular tumor and detected nodal disease not visualized on bipedal lymphangiography. The authors also note its value for treatment planning, follow-up, and localizing recurrence when serum tumor markers become positive, and discuss pitfalls of the technique.

pmid-216959.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍は従来予後が極めて不良でした。手術単独や放射線療法の併用では生存率はあまり改善しませんでした。手術と化学療法を組み合わせた治療で、純粋なディスジャーミノーマを除く26例の2年生存率は89%でした。短期化学療法は長期療法と同等に有効と結論しています。
pmid-216959.summary_en: Historically, ovarian germ cell malignancies had a very poor prognosis, and surgery alone or with radiation therapy did not substantially improve survival. Combining surgery, chemotherapy and, in some cases, radiation therapy yielded an 89% two-year survival in 26 patients with ovarian germ cell malignancies, excluding pure dysgerminoma. The authors conclude that short-term chemotherapy is as effective as long-term regimens advocated by others.

pmid-217890.summary_ja: 培養ヒト絨毛癌株JEG-clone 3が分泌するαサブユニット(JEG-α)を、尿由来hCG-αと比較解析しました。JEG-αはpI 4.8の主要成分を含み、見かけの分子量が大きいことが分かりました。糖鎖とタンパク質部分の双方に不均一性があり、より大きな分子型はhCG形成に使われる前駆体の可能性があります。
pmid-217890.summary_en: The authors characterized the alpha-subunit secreted by the cultured human choriocarcinoma line JEG-clone 3 (JEG-alpha) and compared it with standard urinary hCG-alpha using gel filtration, isoelectric focusing and radioimmunoassay. JEG-alpha contained a major component with pI 4.8 and larger apparent molecular weight, indicating heterogeneity in both carbohydrate and protein moieties. The larger forms may represent a precursor of the alpha subunit used to assemble hCG.

pmid-218197.summary_ja: 独立に樹立された2株の妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株が、胎盤と成人肝臓に似た2種類のアルカリホスファターゼ・アイソザイムを共発現することを示しました。5-ブロモデオキシウリジンとジブチリル環状AMPへの応答を解析し、絨毛性ゴナドトロピンのαサブユニットの応答と比較しました。胎盤型と肝型の遺伝子は非協調的に制御され、胎盤型の誘導は少なくとも2つの独立した経路で起こります。
pmid-218197.summary_en: Two independently derived gestational choriocarcinoma cell lines were found to coexpress two structurally distinct human alkaline phosphatase isoenzymes, resembling those of term placenta and adult liver. The authors studied how these isoenzymes respond to 5-bromodeoxyuridine and dibutyryl cyclic AMP, comparing with the alpha subunit of chorionic gonadotropin. Placental and liver phosphatase genes were regulated noncoordinately, each independently of the alpha subunit, and placental-type induction occurred through at least two independent pathways.

pmid-218607.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎組織、嚢胞液、妊娠週数を揃えた正常胎盤の組織トロンボプラスチン活性と線溶活性を比較しました。活性は3者で同程度でしたが、奇胎組織と嚢胞液では線溶活性が増加していました。線溶活性が高いほど性器出血が多い傾向があり、線溶活性の低い奇胎では後の絨毛癌発生が多く、有意差に近い傾向でした。
pmid-218607.summary_en: The study compared thromboplastic and fibrinolytic activity in hydatidiform molar tissue, vesicular fluid and normal placenta matched for gestational age. Thromboplastic activity was similar across the three, but fibrinolytic activity was increased in molar tissue and vesicular fluid, and vaginal bleeding tended to be heavier when it was high. Subsequent choriocarcinoma occurred more often in patients whose molar tissue had low fibrinolytic activity, an association that approached statistical significance.

pmid-222528.summary_ja: 1940年以降にマンチェスターで治療された小児卵巣腫瘍40例の後方視的レビュー。ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、悪性奇形腫などを含む。ディスジャーミノーマと性索間質系腫瘍以外は予後不良だった。片側卵巣に限局したディスジャーミノーマの完全切除後に定型的な術後放射線療法を行うことには疑問を呈し、卵黄嚢腫瘍を中心に併用化学療法による予後改善の可能性を示した。
pmid-222528.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 40 children treated for ovarian tumours in Manchester since 1940, including dysgerminomas, endodermal sinus tumours, malignant teratomas, and sex cord-stromal tumours. Survival was generally poor except for dysgerminomas and sex cord-stromal tumours. The authors question routine postoperative radiotherapy for dysgerminoma confined to one ovary after total resection. They suggest combination chemotherapy may improve survival in the future, particularly for children with endodermal sinus tumour.

pmid-223101.summary_ja: 23歳男性の精巣腫瘍症例で、歯肉への転移を呈した稀な症例報告。精巣腫瘍は男性の悪性腫瘍の約1%だが、思春期・若年成人男性では比較的多い悪性疾患の一つである。口腔内、特に歯肉への転移は稀であり、歯科医師を含む臨床医が認識すべき病態であることを示している。
pmid-223101.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old man with a testicular neoplasm that presented with metastasis to the gingiva, an unusual site. Testicular tumors make up about 1 percent of male malignancies but are among the more common malignant diseases in adolescent and young adult males. The authors emphasize that oral metastasis is rare and may be the first sign of disease. The report highlights the need for clinicians, including dentists, to recognize such unusual presentations.

pmid-224823.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の2症例（後腹膜の胎児性癌、縦隔の絨毛癌・セミノーマ混在型）を報告し、病因、症候、診断、治療を概説している。稀な腫瘍の臨床像と治療について、発表時点での知見を示した症例報告である。
pmid-224823.summary_en: Two patients with extragonadal germ cell tumours are described: one with a retroperitoneal embryonal carcinoma and one with a mediastinal choriocarcinoma-seminoma. The authors discuss the pathogenesis, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment of these rare tumours in some detail. Clinical features and therapeutic approaches are reviewed for these uncommon presentations. The report reflects the knowledge of extragonadal germ cell tumours and their management at the time of publication.

pmid-225464.summary_ja: Memorial病院で治療された小児の悪性仙骨前奇形腫6例の検討。多くは17か月〜3歳で、臀部や鼠径部の腫瘤、便秘、排尿困難などで発症した。3例は卵黄嚢腫瘍の所見が主体であった。手術、放射線療法、多剤化学療法が施行され、6例中4例が無病生存している。現在の治療プロトコルに至るまでの変遷も議論している。
pmid-225464.summary_en: Six children treated at Memorial Hospital for malignant presacral teratoma are reviewed, most aged 17 months to 3 years. Presenting features included buttock or groin masses, constipation, difficulty voiding, and local pain. Three tumors had predominantly endodermal sinus features. One child developed malignant teratoma 18 months after resection of a benign sacrococcygeal teratoma in the newborn period. All received surgery, irradiation, and multiagent chemotherapy, and four of six remain disease-free. The evolution of treatment toward the current protocol is discussed.

pmid-226206.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者50例の対側精巣生検を検討。セミノーマ21例中3例、その他の胚細胞腫瘍29例中1例に上皮内癌が認められ、全体で約8%だった。上皮内癌の診断から46か月後に浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍を発症した例があった。確認されれば、胚細胞腫瘍患者では対側精巣の定期的生検が考慮される可能性がある。
pmid-226206.summary_en: Contralateral testicular biopsies were examined in 50 consecutive men with germinal testicular cancer. Carcinoma in situ was found without clinical signs in 3 of 21 men with seminoma and 1 of 29 with other germ cell types, about 8 percent overall. One patient developed invasive germ cell cancer 46 months after carcinoma in situ was diagnosed, while the others had less than one year of follow-up without tumor growth. The authors suggest routine contralateral biopsy may be indicated in germ cell tumor patients if these results are confirmed.

pmid-226699.summary_ja: 1979年のパラグアイの研究。1960〜1974年の悪性絨毛性疾患の発生率を、入院患者データと総人口を比較して検討した。全体の発生率は低く、低所得層で高く見えたのは入院患者に占める割合が大きいためと解釈された。貧困が病的妊娠の入院集中と正常妊娠の自宅分娩を招き、発生率に偏りを生むと論じている。
pmid-226699.summary_en: This 1979 Paraguayan study examined the incidence of malignant trophoblastic disease from 1960 to 1969 and 1970 to 1974, using unselected hospital admissions compared with total population data. Overall incidence was low, although frequencies appeared high among lower socioeconomic groups, which the authors attribute to their predominance in the hospital population. They argue that poverty concentrates pathologic pregnancies at hospitals while normal pregnancies are delivered at home, biasing observed disease incidence. The disease pattern resembles that of other developing countries with elevated trophoblastic malignancy frequencies.

pmid-227567.summary_ja: 1979年の研究。1973〜1978年に併用化学療法を受けた播種性胚細胞腫瘍139例を検討した。15.1%に脳転移が出現し、絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍で多い傾向があった。中枢神経系への進展は多くが全身再発に伴い、全生存期間には影響しなかった。予防的中枢神経系治療で利益を得る亜群は同定できなかった。
pmid-227567.summary_en: This 1979 Cancer study reviewed 139 patients with disseminated germinal neoplasms treated between 1973 and 1978 with combination chemotherapy. Brain metastases occurred in 15.1% of patients, somewhat more often with choriocarcinoma and yolk sac histologies, although all types were at risk. CNS spread almost always accompanied systemic relapse and did not affect overall survival. The authors could not identify a subgroup that would benefit from prophylactic CNS therapy. Brain metastasis was a major source of morbidity and mortality.

pmid-227600.summary_ja: 1979年の総説。精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の組織学的パターンを、WHO分類に基づいて概説している。原発巣と転移巣の十分な切片採取の重要性を強調した。施設間で比較可能とするため、精巣腫瘍のWHO分類の広範な使用を勧めている。症例集積研究ではなく、簡潔な論評である。
pmid-227600.summary_en: This 1979 Cancer Treatment Reports review describes the histologic patterns of testicular germ cell tumors, defined and classified according to World Health Organization criteria. The authors stress the importance of obtaining adequate sections from both primary and metastatic tumors for accurate classification. They encourage broader use of the WHO classification of testicular tumors so that meaningful comparisons can be made between treatment centers. The paper is a brief commentary rather than a patient cohort study.

pmid-228696.summary_ja: 1979年の英国の研究。胞状奇胎後に化学療法が必要となる要因を解析した。母体年齢（30〜34歳で高い）や排出法により差があり、医学的誘発・子宮摘出・子宮切開では真空吸引や掻爬に比べ2〜3倍のリスクだった。妊娠初期ほどリスクが高く、排出後のホルモン投与も影響すると考察している。
pmid-228696.summary_en: This 1979 British Journal of Obstetrics and Gynaecology study analyzed factors influencing the need for subsequent chemotherapy after hydatidiform mole in the United Kingdom. Chemotherapy risk varied with maternal age, peaking in women aged 30 to 34. It was two- to three-fold higher after medical induction, hysterectomy, or hysterotomy than after vacuum or surgical curettage or spontaneous abortion. Risk was greatest in earlier gestational weeks. Mole morphology and postevacuation oestrogen or progestogen use were also thought to influence trophoblastic tumour development.

pmid-228844.summary_ja: 1979年の研究。VAB化学療法を受けた精巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍242例で脳転移を検討した。組織型により頻度が異なり、純粋な絨毛癌では83%と高率だった。絨毛癌の脳病変は多発し、小脳に好発した。脳転移後の予後は不良で、純粋な胎児性癌の方がやや長かった。
pmid-228844.summary_en: This 1979 Cancer study examined brain metastases in 242 patients with disseminated malignant germ cell tumors of the testis treated with VAB chemotherapy. CNS metastases occurred in 16% of patients overall and in 25% of those who died. Frequency varied by histology: 13% for pure embryonal carcinoma, 18% for mixed tumors with embryonal or choriocarcinoma elements, and 83% for pure choriocarcinoma. Pure choriocarcinoma brain deposits were often multiple and cerebellar. Survival after brain metastasis was poor, with pure embryonal carcinoma deposits surviving somewhat longer than choriocarcinoma.

pmid-229762.summary_ja: 1979年の総説。精巣腫瘍を年齢別に分類している。成人ではセミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形腫、絨毛癌などが主で、小児では卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫が多い。ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍やセルトリ・顆粒膜細胞腫瘍は全年齢で見られる。腫瘍マーカーの組織内証明が近年の重要な進歩であり、組織像とマーカーの対応づけが必要だと述べている。
pmid-229762.summary_en: This 1979 review in Annals of Clinical and Laboratory Science classifies testicular tumors by age. In adults, tumors are mainly seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratoma, choriocarcinoma, and mixtures; in infants and children, yolk sac tumor and teratoma predominate; older patients more often have spermatocytic seminoma and lymphoma. Leydig and Sertoli-granulosa cell tumors occur at all ages. The authors highlight tumor markers and their demonstration in tissue as major recent advances, while calling for better correlation between histology and markers.

pmid-230189.summary_ja: 1950〜1974年のグリーンランド先住民女性の絨毛性疾患を解析した。良性胞状奇胎37例と侵襲性絨毛性腫瘍11例が報告された。侵襲性疾患と絨毛癌の発生率は、人口ベースで最高水準だった。奇胎後の侵襲性腫瘍の関連が強く、遺伝的素因の可能性も論じられているが、原因は不明である。
pmid-230189.summary_en: This 1979 Journal of Cancer Research and Clinical Oncology paper reports trophoblastic disease in Greenland from 1950 to 1974. It recorded 37 benign hydatidiform moles and 11 invasive trophoblastic tumors among indigenous Greenlandic women. Incidence of invasive disease and choriocarcinoma was among the highest population-based rates on record. There was a strong association between mole and subsequent invasive tumor, with 20% of molar women developing IGTT. A teenage mole peak and possible HL-A 9 genetic predisposition are discussed, though the cause remains unknown.

pmid-233127.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)幹細胞とレチノイン酸で誘導した内胚葉様細胞(END細胞)のEGF受容体を比較した。EC細胞ではEGF結合がほとんど検出されず、分化に伴い受容体数が増加し、レチノイン酸でさらに増加した。分化とともに腫瘍形成能が低下し、受容体増加との関連が示唆された。
pmid-233127.summary_en: This study examines epidermal growth factor (EGF) receptors on mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) stem cells and on endoderm-like END cells induced from them by retinoic acid. EC cells bind EGF poorly, while receptor numbers rise during differentiation, and retinoic acid further increases receptors on END cells. Tumorigenicity declines as cells differentiate, suggesting a possible link between receptor expression and tumor-forming ability. The work uses murine EC cells as a model of germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-284353.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞株C86-S1で免疫したラット脾細胞とマウス骨髄腫細胞を融合し、モノクローナル抗体を作製した。クローン3C4-10は奇形癌株、内胚葉株、神経芽腫に限局する抗原を認識し、4A1-9は培養マウス細胞全般と成体脳に反応した。いずれも着床前胚とは反応せず、3C4-10抗原は100kDa超のタンパク質関連抗原であった。
pmid-284353.summary_en: The authors fused mouse myeloma cells with rat spleen cells immunized against the C3H mouse teratocarcinoma line C86-S1 to generate monoclonal antibodies. Clone 3C4-10 recognized an antigen restricted to teratocarcinoma lines, an endoderm line, and neuroblastoma, while clone 4A1-9 reacted with all cultured murine cells and adult brain. Neither antibody reacted with preimplantation embryos. The 3C4-10 antigen is protein-associated with an apparent molecular weight above 100,000. The study characterizes antigens of murine teratocarcinoma cells.

pmid-285554.summary_ja: 40歳女性が吐血と食道腫瘤で受診し、擦過細胞診で悪性の栄養膜細胞様細胞が認められた。剖検で下部食道の腫瘍と肺・肝・腎への転移が確認され、細胞性・合胞体性栄養膜成分から成っていた。食道原発の絨毛癌は極めてまれで、擦過生検により診断可能であることを示した。
pmid-285554.summary_en: A 40-year-old woman presented with hematemesis and an esophageal mass, and brush cytology showed malignant cells with trophoblastic features. Autopsy revealed a lower esophageal tumor with metastases to lung, liver, and kidneys, composed of cytotrophoblastic and syncytiotrophoblastic elements. Esophageal choriocarcinoma is extremely rare, with only two prior cases in the literature. The authors show that brush biopsy can identify the characteristic cells and recommend recognizing this ectopic occurrence to enable diagnosis.

pmid-286116.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍97例の血清SP1を測定し、絨毛癌、奇形腫・奇形癌、胎児性癌で上昇がみられた。セミノーマでは上昇例はなかった。精巣絨毛癌の1例では、SP1の性状が胎盤由来のSP1と類似していた。SP1が非セミノーマ性腫瘍、とくに絨毛癌のマーカーとなりうることが示唆された。
pmid-286116.summary_en: Serum levels of pregnancy-specific beta1-glycoprotein 1 (SP1) were measured in 97 men with testicular germ cell tumors. SP1 was elevated in 3 of 6 choriocarcinomas, 5 of 17 teratomas or teratocarcinomas, and 5 of 50 embryonal carcinomas, but in none of 24 seminomas. Values in 143 patients with nonmalignant disease were at most 9.1 ng/ml. In one patient with testicular choriocarcinoma, SP1 resembled placental SP1 immunochemically and chromatographically. SP1 may serve as a marker for nonseminomatous tumors, especially choriocarcinoma.

pmid-287828.summary_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来のTera-1およびTera-2細胞株を電子顕微鏡で観察し、レトロウイルス様粒子の有無を調べた。5-ヨード-2'-デオキシウリジンとデキサメタゾンで処理したTera-1培養でのみ低頻度に粒子が認められた。未処理のTera-1とTera-2では検出されなかった。形態学的な観察にとどまり、ウイルスの分子学的性状は解析されていない。
pmid-287828.summary_en: Electron microscopy examined the Tera-1 and Tera-2 human testicular germ cell tumor cell lines for retrovirus-like particles. Extracellular and budding particles appeared at low frequency only in Tera-1 cultures treated with 5-iodo-2'-deoxyuridine and dexamethasone. Untreated Tera-1 cultures and all Tera-2 preparations lacked detectable particles. The study identifies inducible retrovirus-like particles in germ cell tumor-derived cells based on morphology alone, without molecular characterization of the virus.

pmid-288439.summary_ja: 26歳女性の直腸内類皮嚢胞（成熟奇形腫）の症例報告である。直腸病変は左卵巣と茎で連続しており、直腸前壁の類皮嚢胞が卵巣由来で直腸へ浸潤するという従来の仮説を示す所見が得られた。これまで十分な裏付けがなかった卵巣起源説に対し、具体的な症例証拠を提示した点に意義がある。
pmid-288439.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman presented with an intrarectal dermoid, a mature teratoma. The rectal lesion was connected by a stalk to the left ovary. This supports the long-held but previously unproven view that anterior rectal dermoids arise in the ovary and erode into the rectum. The case provides direct evidence for this origin, which had lacked substantial support in the literature.

pmid-291927.summary_ja: 培養した絨毛癌JAR細胞において、hCGのαおよびβサブユニット前駆体を同定した。前駆体はマンノースコアを持つが末端糖鎖を欠き、細胞内半減期は少なくとも1時間であった。成熟したサブユニットは細胞内に蓄積せず、速やかに分泌されることが示された。hCGの生合成と分泌過程を理解するうえで重要な知見である。
pmid-291927.summary_en: Pulse and pulse-chase experiments in cultured JAR choriocarcinoma cells identified partially glycosylated precursors of the human chorionic gonadotropin alpha and beta subunits. The alpha precursor was about 18 kDa and the beta precursor about 24 kDa, compared with fully processed forms of 22 kDa and 34 kDa. The precursors had intracellular half-lives of at least one hour, and processed subunits were rapidly secreted rather than accumulating in cells.

pmid-293749.summary_ja: マウス胚盤胞が胎児性癌の悪性発現を制御する仕組みを、腫瘍形成能に基づくバイオアッセイで解析した。胚盤胞は胎児性癌細胞1個の腫瘍形成を一貫して抑制し、3個に対しては部分的効果を示したが、4〜5個では制御できなかった。細胞の位置も重要で、胚盤胞腔内では抑制され、透明帯と栄養外胚葉の間では腫瘍形成能が増強された。メラノーマ細胞には作用せず、特異性が示された。
pmid-293749.summary_en: A tumorigenicity bioassay was developed to test how the mouse blastocyst controls malignant expression of embryonal carcinoma. The blastocyst regulated a single embryonal carcinoma cell consistently and had a partial effect on three cells, but could not regulate four or five. Placement mattered: cells in the blastocoele were regulated, while cells between the zona pellucida and trophectoderm had enhanced tumorigenicity. The blastocyst did not regulate melanoma cells, showing specificity.

pmid-294054.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘤77例を細い針で穿刺吸引し、組織学的所見と対比した研究である。胚細胞腫瘍10例を含み、3種類の胚細胞腫瘍はそれぞれ診断的な細胞像を示した。悪性病変は細胞成分が豊富な検体となり、良性病変や嚢胞では細胞が少なかった。穿刺吸引細胞診は卵巣腫瘤の分類に有用であり、卵巣機能温存が求められる若年者で特に意義があるとしている。
pmid-294054.summary_en: Seventy-seven ovarian masses were aspirated with fine needles and compared with histology. The series included 10 germ cell neoplasms, which each showed features diagnostic of their entity. Malignant lesions gave cellular aspirates, while benign lesions and cysts gave scanty cells. The study concludes that aspiration cytology can satisfactorily classify ovarian masses, which is especially valuable in young patients for preserving ovarian function.

pmid-35620.summary_ja: 1979年の文献的検討で、停留精巣に対する精巣固定術後に発生した精巣胚細胞腫瘍220例を集計した。詳細が記録された97例を解析している。10歳未満で固定術を受けた症例は6例にとどまり、早期固定術の予防効果は未確定である。10〜20歳の片側停留精巣では固定術に不利な報告が多いと結論づけている。
pmid-35620.summary_en: This 1979 literature review compiled 220 cases of testicular germ cell tumour arising after orchiopexy for undescended testis. Only 97 cases had documented scrotal placement and tumour details, and the true number of at-risk patients is unknown. Only six cases followed orchiopexy in children under 10, which the authors found encouraging. Reports in patients aged 10 to 20 with unilateral undescended testis argued against orchiopexy at that age.

pmid-369982.summary_ja: 1979年の病理研究で、カルシトニンを分泌する卵巣のストルマ・カルチノイド腫瘍を報告した。甲状腺組織を含む特殊型の卵巣奇形腫である。超微細構造は光学顕微鏡より複雑で、甲状腺髄様癌との鑑別が問題になりうる。両者とも5-HIAAとカルシトニンを産生し、神経外胚葉由来の共通起源が示唆された。
pmid-369982.summary_en: This 1979 pathology study examines a calcitonin-secreting struma-carcinoid tumour of the ovary, a specialised ovarian teratoma containing thyroid-type tissue. Its ultrastructure was more complex than light microscopy suggested, and it could resemble medullary thyroid carcinoma. Both tumour types produced 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid and calcitonin, which the authors interpret as evidence of a shared neuroectodermal origin.

pmid-374600.summary_ja: マウス精巣奇形癌の幹細胞と、その分化細胞(壁側・臓側卵黄嚢細胞、神経細胞、扁平上皮様細胞)を多角度光散乱法で解析した研究。幹細胞と各分化細胞は区別できたが、多分化能幹細胞と単一系統に限定された幹細胞は区別できなかった。胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞の分化状態を光学的に評価できることを示した。
pmid-374600.summary_en: This study used multiangle light-scattering measurements in a flow system to analyze stem cells from a mouse testicular teratocarcinoma and their differentiated derivatives, including parietal and visceral yolk sac cells, neuronal cells, and squamous cells. The technique distinguished stem cells from these differentiated types, but it could not separate multipotent stem cells from stem cells restricted to a single developmental pathway. The work shows how optical scattering can characterize the differentiation state of embryonal carcinoma-derived cells.

pmid-377290.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC3/A/1をHMBAで分化誘導し、細胞形態と細胞骨格の変化を解析した研究。分化細胞では新たに合成されるトロポミオシンが増加し、アクチン線維束と結合することを示した。胎児性癌細胞の分化に伴う細胞骨格再編成との関連が示唆される。
pmid-377290.summary_en: This study examined mouse PCC3/A/1 embryonal carcinoma cells treated with hexamethylene bisacetamide (HMBA), which induces their differentiation in vitro. Treated cells changed from rounded to flat adhesive forms with a developed cytoskeleton. Among newly synthesized proteins, tropomyosin (Mr 34,000) increased markedly and associated with actin microfilament bundles, as shown by immunofluorescence. The findings link tropomyosin synthesis to cytoskeletal reorganization during embryonal carcinoma differentiation.

pmid-379868.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来細胞株TerCの表面抗原を、ウサギおよびマウス抗血清を用いて免疫化学的に解析した研究。糖タンパク質と糖脂質の種類は、交差反応する細胞株cl 1dより多く認められた。抗原は緩衝生理食塩水に抽出可能で、処理したリンパ球は奇形癌抗血清と反応するようになった。
pmid-379868.summary_en: This study characterized surface antigens of TerC, a teratocarcinoma-derived mouse cell line, using rabbit and mouse antisera. The antisera precipitated glycoproteins and glycolipids that resolved into multiple species, more numerous than in the cross-reacting cell line cl 1d. Teratocarcinoma antigens could be extracted into buffered saline, and treated lymphocytes became reactive with teratocarcinoma antisera, absorbing most of its activity.

pmid-381330.summary_ja: 播種性絨毛癌の患者に高力価の抗i寒冷凝集素が出現し、治療された絨毛癌患者でも抗i価の軽度上昇が見られた。胎児抗原iは臍帯赤血球と栄養膜で証明された。正常妊婦の6%にも同様の上昇がみられ、絨毛癌に特異的な現象ではないことが示された。
pmid-381330.summary_en: This study describes high-titre anti-i cold agglutinins in a patient with disseminated choriocarcinoma, with minor elevations seen in four of six further treated choriocarcinoma patients. The fetal i antigen was demonstrated on cord erythrocytes and placental trophoblast. In normal pregnant women, 6% showed similar increases in anti-i titres, suggesting that the antibody response is not specific to choriocarcinoma.

pmid-385030.summary_ja: hCG産生性のヒト精巣奇形腫を免疫不全マウスに連続移植し、原腫瘍と組織像、hCG免疫染色、マーカー産生、増殖速度を比較した研究。5代を超える移植でhCG産生成分は減少したが、ほぼ原腫瘍の特徴を保持していた。異種移植モデルとしての有用性を示す。
pmid-385030.summary_en: This study describes serial transplantation of an hCG-producing human testicular teratoma into immune-deprived mice. The xenograft was compared with the original tumor in histology, hCG immunohistochemistry, autoradiography, marker production, and growth rate. The xenograft largely retained the original tumor's characteristics, although hCG-producing elements decreased after more than five serial passages.

pmid-389406.summary_ja: 細胞傷害性化学療法後に終末期の低血糖を来した致死的な2症例を症例報告として示す。1例は白血病、1例は絨毛性精巣奇形腫の患者であった。これら悪性腫瘍との関連は稀であるため、考えられる機序を文献レビューとともに考察する。
pmid-389406.summary_en: The authors describe two fatal cases in which hypoglycemia occurred as a terminal event after cytotoxic chemotherapy: one patient with leukemia and one with a trophoblastic testicular teratoma. Because this association is rare in these malignancies, the report discusses possible mechanisms alongside a brief literature review. It is a case report of two rare terminal complications.

pmid-393795.summary_ja: 抗DNase-I IgGを用いた免疫蛍光法で、分化過程のマウス奇形癌細胞のDNaseを検出した。胎児性癌細胞は細胞質に不定形の蛍光を示し核は染色されなかったのに対し、分化した細胞株では核と線維状の細胞質に特徴的な蛍光を示した。奇形癌細胞由来のDNaseは細胞分化のマーカーとなりうると結論された。
pmid-393795.summary_en: This immunofluorescence study used anti-DNase-I antibodies to examine deoxyribonuclease in mouse teratocarcinoma cells during differentiation. Embryonal carcinoma cells showed amorphous cytoplasmic staining without nuclear signal, whereas differentiated lines displayed bright nuclear and fibrillar cytoplasmic patterns. The authors conclude that DNase from teratocarcinoma cells can serve as a marker of cell differentiation, distinguishing cell types with a common origin.

pmid-39521.summary_ja: 1979年の報告で、停留精巣に生じた悪性腫瘍12例を検討した。腹腔内にある精巣は症状が曖昧で診断が遅れやすかった。セミノーマの60%は未分化で侵襲性の強い亜型であった。小児期の早期の精巣固定術または精巣摘除術が推奨され、開腹による腹腔内リンパ節の凍結切片検査とクリップ留置が病期分類と治療計画に役立った。
pmid-39521.summary_en: This 1979 report reviewed twelve malignant tumors arising in undescended testes. Diagnosis was often delayed because intra-abdominal testes produced vague symptoms. Sixty percent of the seminomas were the anaplastic, aggressive variant. The authors recommended early management with orchiopexy or orchidectomy in childhood. Exploratory laparotomy with frozen-section examination of abdominal nodes and silver clip placement improved staging and guided further treatment planning.

pmid-40686.summary_ja: 本症例報告では、13歳男児の両側停留精巣例を報告する。精巣生検と左精巣摘除術により悪性胚細胞腫瘍と診断されたが、明らかな腫瘤はなく、精細管と間質に悪性細胞がみられた。既報の上皮内または初期の胚細胞腫瘍5例では不妊と停留精巣が関連していた。うち2例は後に明らかな癌を発症し、侵襲性胚細胞腫瘍の初期段階を示唆する。
pmid-40686.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old boy with bilateral cryptorchidism who underwent testicular biopsy and left orchiectomy for malignant germ cell tumor, although no discrete mass was found. Malignant cells were seen within seminiferous tubules and the interstitium. The authors reviewed five prior cases of in-situ or incipient germ cell neoplasia, noting infertility and cryptorchidism as associated features. Two of these patients later developed frank carcinoma, suggesting an early phase of invasive germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-41764.summary_ja: ベイルートの病院で治療された卵黄嚢腫瘍8例（性腺外2例、性腺内6例）を報告する。3例は特徴的な臨床・病理所見を示し、胚外起源や異形成性性腺との関連を支持した。卵黄嚢パターンと多小胞性卵黄嚢パターンは同一腫瘍の一部とみなされた。本シリーズの予後は不良であった。
pmid-41764.summary_en: This report examines eight endodermal sinus tumors, two extragonadal and six gonadal, treated at the American University of Beirut. Three cases showed distinctive clinical and pathologic features supporting an extraembryonic origin for this teratoid tumor and its association with dysgenetic gonads. The authors regard the endodermal sinus and polyvesicular vitelline patterns as part of the same tumor. Prognosis in this series was unfavorable.

pmid-418976.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者を検討した報告である。正期妊娠後に生じた絨毛癌20例の生存率は60%で、他の患者の95%より低かった。予後不良群では、正期妊娠後の治癒率は47%と特に低かった。先行する正期妊娠を新たな高リスク因子として加えることが提唱された。
pmid-418976.summary_en: This Duke series of patients with malignant trophoblastic disease found choriocarcinoma after term gestation in 20 patients, with 60% survival, compared with 95% in the others. Among patients with poor-prognosis features, post-term-gestation cases had a markedly lower cure rate of 47%. Such choriocarcinoma tended to spread widely and respond poorly to conventional chemotherapy. The authors propose adding antecedent term pregnancy as a high-risk factor.

pmid-420604.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の治療後1年で右側頭窩に転移性セミノーマを生じた34歳男性の症例報告である。症状は顔面痛、外眼筋麻痺、耳炎、腹部症状であった。頭蓋内転移は稀であり、積極的な治療に値すると述べられている。
pmid-420604.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man who developed a right temporal fossa metastatic seminoma one year after orchidectomy, surgery, and radiotherapy for a primary testicular tumor. Symptoms included facial pain, extraocular paresis, otitis, and abdominal complaints. The authors note this is an unusual intracranial metastasis that merits active treatment.

pmid-421188.summary_ja: 46,XY純粋性腺異形成の表現型女性6例を対象に、性腺芽腫内から生じた胚細胞腫瘍を解析した。ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）は上皮内から転移性まで進展段階を示し、2例では奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の混在がみられた。臨床経過や治療反応は卵巣・精巣・性腺外に生じる胚細胞腫瘍と類似し、性腺芽腫が悪性化しうることを強調する。
pmid-421188.summary_en: This 1979 Cancer series analyzes six phenotypic females with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis who developed germ cell tumors within gonadoblastomas. Germinomas evolved through in situ, incipient, microinvasive, and metastatic stages. Two patients had admixed teratoma and endodermal sinus tumor. The authors report that these tumors behave clinically and respond to therapy similarly to germ cell tumors arising de novo in the ovary, testis, or extragonadal sites. They emphasize that gonadoblastomas can give rise to fully malignant germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-424104.summary_ja: 妊娠に合併したディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）26例の文献的レビューと新たな1例を報告する。捻転や嵌頓が多く、産科的合併症は約半数にみられた。ステージIAの片側卵巣摘出後に30%で再発し、対側卵巣への浸潤例も示された。妊孕性温存を強く望む女性に限り片側手術を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-424104.summary_en: This 1979 Obstetrics and Gynecology article reviews 26 previously reported cases of dysgerminoma associated with pregnancy and adds one new case. Adnexal torsion was common, obstetric complications occurred in nearly half, and fetal demise in one quarter. The authors found recurrence in 30% of stage IA tumors treated with unilateral oophorectomy, and infiltration of the contralateral ovary in their case. They conclude that unilateral surgery should be reserved for women who strongly wish to preserve fertility.

pmid-42570.summary_ja: 播種性絨毛癌の女性患者において、臨床的・生化学的に甲状腺中毒症を認めた症例を報告する。過去の文献から、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の高値が栄養膜性疾患における甲状腺刺激作用の原因となりうることが示唆されており、絨毛癌と甲状腺機能亢進症の関連を考察した症例報告である。
pmid-42570.summary_en: This 1979 case report describes a woman with disseminated choriocarcinoma who also showed clinical and biochemical features of thyrotoxicosis. Thyrotoxicosis associated with choriocarcinoma has rarely been reported. The authors review prior literature suggesting that high levels of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) may be responsible for the thyroid-stimulating activity seen in patients with trophoblastic disease and thyrotoxic signs. The report highlights hCG as a possible mechanism linking gestational trophoblastic malignancy to hyperthyroidism.

pmid-42610.summary_ja: 人絨毛癌細胞を用いたin vitro研究で、酪酸ナトリウムなどの短鎖脂肪酸によるアルカリホスファターゼの誘導を検討した。誘導は速やかで、タンパク質・RNA・DNA合成に依存し、転写レベルでの調節が示唆された。胎盤型酵素との免疫学的類似性と熱安定性の違いも報告されている。
pmid-42610.summary_en: This 1979 in vitro study examines how sodium butyrate and other short-chain fatty acids induce alkaline phosphatase activity in human choriocarcinoma cells. The induction is rapid, nearly linear, and selective for the alkaline pH-optimum enzyme. The induced enzyme resembles term placental alkaline phosphatase immunologically but is less heat-stable. Induction requires ongoing protein, RNA, and DNA synthesis, suggesting regulation at the transcriptional level. The work uses choriocarcinoma cells as a model for placental-type enzyme regulation rather than addressing clinical management.

pmid-427721.summary_ja: 1938年から1977年に治療された純粋型卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ21例を検討した。初回治療を当施設で受けた12例中11例(91.7%)が2〜38年無病生存した。一方、再発して紹介された9例では4例(45%)のみが救済された。予後は腫瘍の初期サイズ、適切な病期分類、適切な治療に依存した。初期の過度に保存的な治療には慎重であるべきと結論づけ、治療プロトコルを提案している。
pmid-427721.summary_en: This Memorial Sloan-Kettering series reviewed 21 patients with pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated from 1938 to 1977. Among 12 patients treated initially at the institution, 11 (91.7%) remained disease-free for 2 to 38 years. Among 9 patients referred with recurrence, only 4 (45%) were salvaged. Survival depended on initial tumor size, adequate staging, and appropriate therapy. The authors cautioned against overly conservative initial treatment and proposed a treatment protocol.

pmid-432175.summary_ja: 成人女性の仙骨前奇形腫により分娩が閉塞した症例報告である。症例の臨床経過と治療について記述されている。仙骨前奇形腫は性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍で、妊娠中に産道を機械的に閉塞させることがある。このような症例では個別化した分娩計画と腫瘍の外科的治療が必要であることが強調されている。
pmid-432175.summary_en: This short case report describes an adult female with a presacral teratoma that caused obstructed labour. The clinical details and management of the patient are presented. Presacral teratomas are extragonadal germ cell tumours arising in the sacral region, and during pregnancy they may mechanically obstruct the birth canal. The report highlights the need for individualized delivery planning and surgical management of such masses.

pmid-433048.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの局所病変の2例で、排泄性尿路造影により同側に骨盤内異所性腎が認められた。病期Aのセミノーマの標準治療は3,000 radsの腹部外照射であるが、遮蔽されていない異所性腎では放射線腎炎と腎機能喪失のリスクが高い。そのためこうした解剖学的特徴をもつ患者では、腹部照射の代わりに後腹膜リンパ節郭清を推奨している。
pmid-433048.summary_en: Two patients with localized testicular seminoma had an ipsilateral pelvic (ectopic) kidney on excretory urography. Standard treatment for stage A seminoma is abdominal external beam radiation at 3,000 rads, but the authors note a significant risk of radiation nephritis and loss of the unshielded ectopic kidney. They therefore recommend retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in place of abdominal irradiation for patients with this anatomy.

pmid-433058.summary_ja: 通常とは異なる先天異常を伴う小児の馬蹄腎内に奇形腫が認められた症例を報告する。馬蹄腎では小児の腎芽腫が多いが、奇形腫の報告はこれまでなかった。腎臓は奇形腫のまれな発生部位であり、本症例はその記録となる。馬蹄腎は腎腫瘍の発生が有意に多いとされる。
pmid-433058.summary_en: A teratoma was identified in the horseshoe kidney of a child with unusual congenital anomalies. The authors note that nephroblastomas frequently occur in horseshoe kidneys of children, but no teratoma had previously been reported in this setting. The report adds a rare renal location for teratoma. Renal tumors are significantly increased in horseshoe kidneys, which are themselves congenital anomalies.

pmid-433587.summary_ja: 19歳女性の甲状腺に発生した悪性奇形腫（5.0×4.0×3.6cm）を報告する。組織学的に三胚葉の成熟・未熟な成分が認められ、がん性上皮細胞が甲状腺組織に浸潤し血管内腫瘍塞栓も見られた。リンパ節転移は認められなかった。手術と4000 radsの外照射を受け、8か月後に再発や転移は認められなかった。
pmid-433587.summary_en: A 19-year-old woman had a malignant teratoma of the thyroid gland measuring 5.0 x 4.0 x 3.6 cm. Histology showed mature and immature derivatives of all three germ layers, with cancerous epithelial cells invading the thyroid and forming vascular tumor thrombi. No lymph node metastasis was found. She received surgery and external irradiation of 4,000 rads, and eight months later showed no recurrence or metastasis.

pmid-433851.summary_ja: 表現型女児の46,XY核型例で、生後3か月の生殖腺には少数の卵とともに多数の胚細胞が存在したが、3歳10か月時点では性腺芽腫のみが残っていた。著者らは、異形成性生殖腺からの胚細胞消失は正常の生殖腺より速いが、46,XYでは45,Xより遅いと提唱している。46,XY性腺異形成における胚細胞腫瘍リスクの上昇と関連する。
pmid-433851.summary_en: In a phenotypic female with a 46,XY karyotype, gonads at 3 months contained a few ova and numerous germ cells, while at 3 years 10 months only a gonadoblastoma remained. The authors propose that germ cells are lost from dysgenetic gonads more rapidly than from normal gonads, but more slowly in 46,XY than in 45,X patients. The observation relates to the increased germ cell neoplasm risk in 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis.

pmid-439211.summary_ja: 進行期（B3・C期）の精巣セミノーマに対し、従来の放射線療法単独では治癒率22%と不十分だった。アクチノマイシンD・ビンクリスチン・シクロホスファミドによる化学療法を放射線療法前に行い、その後後腹膜・縦隔・鎖骨上リンパ節へ放射線療法を行う治療法を提案する。残存腫瘤やαフェトプロテイン・β-hCG陽性例では後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行うべきとし、補助化学療法を受けた5例は無病生存した。
pmid-439211.summary_en: This 1979 report examines advanced testicular seminoma (stages B3 and C). Conventional radiotherapy alone achieved an unacceptable cure rate of 22%. The authors propose pre-radiation chemotherapy with actinomycin D, vincristine, and cyclophosphamide, followed by standard radiotherapy to retroperitoneal, mediastinal, and supraclavicular nodes. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy was recommended for persistent bulk disease or elevated AFP or beta-hCG. Five patients receiving adjuvant chemotherapy remained disease-free 18 months to 5 years after treatment.

pmid-441376.summary_ja: 骨盤内腫瘤を有する40例に超音波検査を行い、手術で卵巣奇形腫と確認された症例を対象とした。エコー像は極めて多彩で、軸方向の位置や充実性壁在成分などの典型所見は40例中17例にしか認められなかった。臨床的に卵巣奇形腫が疑われる場合は、内部構造によらず本症を念頭に置くべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-441376.summary_en: Forty patients with pelvic masses underwent ultrasonography, and surgery subsequently confirmed ovarian teratoma. Echographic appearances were highly variable; classic features such as axial location, solid mural component, acoustic shadowing, and hair-fluid level were present in only 17 of 40 patients. The authors advise considering ovarian teratoma whenever the clinical setting suggests it, regardless of the mass's internal architecture.

pmid-441779.summary_ja: 対側卵巣に悪性奇形腫を伴う性腺芽細胞腫の症例を報告する。異形成性性腺の悪性化の可能性について考察し、このような状況における診断と治療の方針を論じている。異形成性性腺は悪性化のリスクを伴うため、慎重な評価が必要であることを示している。
pmid-441779.summary_en: This case report describes gonadoblastoma coexisting with a malignant teratoma in the contralateral ovary. The authors discuss the malignant potential of dysgenetic gonads, which can harbor germ cell neoplasia. They also address diagnostic and therapeutic approaches for this combination of findings. Because dysgenetic gonads carry a risk of malignancy, careful evaluation is needed in such patients.

pmid-442336.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清術後に重篤な合併症を生じた4例を報告する。乳び胸、高血圧に伴う失明と下肢麻痺、癒着部周囲の腸捻転と壊死、小腸閉塞と放射線性脊髄炎が認められた。それぞれの治療と予防法について考察し、手術を行う医師に注意を促している。
pmid-442336.summary_en: This report presents four patients with serious complications after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for nonseminomatous testicular tumors. Complications included chylothorax, hypertension with blindness and lower-extremity paralysis, volvulus with necrosis around an adhesion, and small-bowel obstruction with radiation myelitis. The authors discuss the management and prevention of these complications, which are important for surgeons treating these tumors.

pmid-442352.summary_ja: X/XY染色体モザイクを伴う男性仮性半陰陽の患者に生じた精巣腫瘍の症例を報告する。性分化疾患の管理では性腺悪性腫瘍の危険性を把握することが重要だと強調している。腫瘍学、発生学、内分泌学、遺伝学が交差する領域であり、臨床研究の対象として価値があるとしている。
pmid-442352.summary_en: This report describes a testicular tumor in an intersex patient with male pseudohermaphroditism and X/XY chromosomal mosaicism. The authors emphasize that awareness of gonadal malignancy risk is important in managing disorders of sexual differentiation. They note that these patients lie at the intersection of oncology, embryology, endocrinology, and genetics, making them a valuable subject for clinical investigation.

pmid-452232.summary_ja: 小児精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の男児2例に対し、待機的（無治療）方針をとった結果、治療に失敗した症例報告である。その根拠を現在の知見に照らして考察し、治療計画には病期分類の高度化と化学療法の改善が必要だと指摘している。
pmid-452232.summary_en: Two boys with yolk sac tumors of the testis were managed with an expectant approach, which led to therapeutic failure. The authors discuss the rationale for such nontherapy in light of current knowledge. They suggest that more sophisticated tumor staging and improved chemotherapeutic approaches are needed for treatment planning in childhood testicular yolk sac tumors.

pmid-455223.summary_ja: 34歳男性の右精巣表面の結節が、白膜内の転移性胎児性癌と判明した。精巣摘除術の標本では、胎児性癌とセミノーマの管内病変を伴う広範な未分化管内胚細胞腫瘍（上皮内癌）が認められた。超微細構造は未分化胚細胞に類似しており、上皮内癌が他の型の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変であるという考えを支持する。
pmid-455223.summary_en: A 34-year-old man had a nodule on the surface of the right testis, which proved to be metastatic embryonal carcinoma within the tunica albuginea. The orchiectomy specimen showed extensive undifferentiated intratubular germ cell tumor (carcinoma in situ) with foci of intratubular embryonal carcinoma and seminoma. Ultrastructure of these cells resembled undifferentiated germ cells, supporting the concept that carcinoma in situ is the precursor of other testicular germ cell tumor types.

pmid-455236.summary_ja: 1979年の報告で、陸軍医療センター3施設において精巣摘除術と放射線療法で治療された早期未分化セミノーマ77例を解析した。病期Iと病期IIの10年生存率は良好であった。病期Iでは縦隔・鎖骨上への追加照射に生存上の利点は示されなかった。hCG高値例は予後不良で、併用化学療法を考慮すべきとされた。
pmid-455236.summary_en: This 1979 Cancer report reviewed 77 patients with early-stage anaplastic seminoma of the testis treated with orchiectomy and lymphatic irradiation at three Army medical centers over 28 years. Ten-year survival was 96% for Stage I and 87% for Stage II. Adding mediastinal and supraclavicular irradiation to para-aortic and pelvic fields gave no survival benefit in Stage I, and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy increased major gastrointestinal complications without improving survival. Elevated serum beta-hCG predicted poor prognosis, supporting consideration of adjuvant combination chemotherapy. Anaplastic seminoma behaves similarly to typical seminoma and should be managed the same way.

pmid-455237.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞性悪性腫瘍531例を対象に、UICC推奨のTNM病期分類と施設独自の分類(Peter MacCallum病院方式)を比較した。後者は予測能が高く簡便であり、病期分類の改訂に向けて検討すべきと提唱された。また、腫瘍マーカーは病期分類に独立したカテゴリーとして組み込むべきだと論じられている。
pmid-455237.summary_en: This 1979 Cancer article analyzed 531 germinal malignancies of the testis to compare the UICC TNM staging system with a locally devised scheme, the Peter MacCallum Hospital system. Analyzing histologic subtypes separately minimized the influence of pathology on prognosis. The Peter MacCallum system showed better predictive ability and greater simplicity, and was proposed for consideration in future staging revisions. The authors caution that rigorous staging can make survival appear better across centers without changing actual outcomes. They also argue that biochemical markers are essential to any staging system and should be given a separate category.

pmid-455250.summary_ja: 精巣腫大のない隠蔽性セミノーマ2例を報告する。左側リンパ節転移の組織像(PAS陽性の明るい細胞質と肉芽腫性反応)からセミノーマを疑い、精巣摘除術で精細管内セミノーマを確認した。このような転移像を認めた場合は隠蔽性セミノーマを考慮すべきである。現代の治療では早期発見の意義が大きいとされる。
pmid-455250.summary_en: This case report describes two patients with occult testicular seminoma presenting as left-sided lymph node metastases without a palpable or enlarged testis. The nodal tumor cells had PAS-positive clear cytoplasm with a granulomatous stromal reaction, suggesting seminoma. Left orchiectomy revealed intratubular seminoma, confirming the diagnosis. The authors conclude that this nodal morphology should prompt consideration of occult seminoma, since early detection has important therapeutic implications.

pmid-455255.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌と甲状腺中毒症を合併した26歳女性の症例報告で、同合併の8例目である。T4・TSHの推移はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値と腫瘍量に相関した。hCGのTSH様作用または腫瘍が産生する甲状腺刺激物質が原因と考えられた。絨毛癌では甲状腺機能異常が生じうることを示した。
pmid-455255.summary_en: This 1979 Cancer case report describes a 26-year-old woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma and biochemical thyrotoxicosis, the eighth such association reported. Serial measurements of thyroxine and TSH paralleled serum beta-hCG levels and tumor burden. The authors propose that the hypermetabolic state arises from either the TSH-like activity of hCG or tumor-produced thyrotropin. The case highlights thyroid dysfunction as a possible clinical feature of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-455896.summary_ja: 悪性奇形腫65例に対しCTを施行し、従来の放射線検査と比較した。肺転移と縦隔リンパ節腫大の検出でCTが優れていた。傍大動脈リンパ節病変の評価にも有用で、逐次CTは治療反応の評価、再発の検出、残存病変の切除可能性の判断に用いられた。
pmid-455896.summary_en: This 1979 Clinical Radiology study evaluated CT in 65 patients with malignant teratoma examined between August 1977 and June 1978. CT outperformed conventional radiography for detecting pulmonary metastases and mediastinal lymphadenopathy. It provided fuller assessment of para-aortic nodal disease than lymphography alone. Sequential CT scans were used to monitor treatment response, detect relapse, and determine operability of residual disease.

pmid-465388.summary_ja: 1979年の英国の研究で、北東大都市圏の卵巣悪性疾患を検討した。良性嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化が、胚細胞由来の悪性腫瘍として最も多いことが示された。12例の臨床・病理学的詳細が報告されている。成熟奇形腫の重要な合併症として悪性転化を取り上げ、臨床管理上の注意点を示す文献である。
pmid-465388.summary_en: This 1979 British study reviewed malignant ovarian disease in a North East Metropolitan region and found that malignant transformation of benign cystic teratoma was the most common malignancy of germ cell origin. The authors report clinical and pathological details of 12 patients. The paper highlights malignant transformation as a notable complication of mature ovarian teratoma, a key consideration for clinicians in management and follow-up.

pmid-465974.summary_ja: 1958年から1976年にジャマイカで記録された精巣腫瘍26例を検討した疫学研究である。世界標準化罹患率は年間10万人あたり0.40であった。罹患率はアフリカ系黒人より高く、北米の黒人より低かった。ピーク年齢は高罹患国より約10年遅いことが示され、カリブ地域の精巣腫瘍の疫学データを提供している。
pmid-465974.summary_en: This 1979 Jamaican study reviewed testicular malignancies recorded at the University Hospital of the West Indies and the Jamaica Cancer Registry from 1958 to 1976. Among 26 cases, the world-standardised incidence was 0.40 per 100,000 per year. Incidence was higher than in African Black populations but lower than in North American Black populations, and the peak age was about a decade later than in high-incidence countries. The paper provides epidemiological data on testicular tumours in a Caribbean population.

pmid-465975.summary_ja: 1963年から1975年に治療された精巣セミノーマ患者199例の治療成績を報告している。放射線療法は病期I〜IIIの80%以上でリンパ節転移を制御した。病期IVおよび再発例では16例中12例がセミノーマで死亡した。シクロホスファミド単剤の奏効率は50%であった。長期無腫瘍生存者で放射線に関連した死亡率の上昇は認められなかった。
pmid-465975.summary_en: This 1979 Royal Marsden Hospital series analysed 199 patients with testicular seminoma treated from 1963 to 1975. Radiotherapy controlled nodal metastases in over 80% of Stage I to III patients, and death from seminoma was low in early stages. Among Stage IV patients and those with relapse, 12 of 16 died of seminoma. Cyclophosphamide monotherapy gave a 50% response rate in the chemotherapy experience. Long-term tumour-free survivors showed no radiation-related increase in mortality.

pmid-466963.summary_ja: 1943年から1977年にマンチェスターで診断された卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ33例を検討した。5年生存率は85%であった。片側病期Iで完全切除を受けた若年患者は、放射線療法を再発時に限って経過観察できると結論している。その他の患者には手術に加え全腹部放射線療法が推奨され、病期IIIでも腫瘍減量術が勧められている。
pmid-466963.summary_en: This Manchester review analysed 33 cases of ovarian dysgerminoma diagnosed from 1943 to 1977, with a five-year survival of 85%. All Stage I patients and all under age 20 survived. The authors conclude that young patients with unilateral Stage I disease after total resection can be followed without radiotherapy, reserving it for recurrence, while others should receive surgery plus whole-abdominal radiotherapy. Even in Stage III, debulking surgery is recommended.

pmid-468125.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫（グレードI）から生じた成熟（グレード0）神経原性腹膜インプラントの超微細構造を示す症例報告である。複数の神経外胚葉系細胞が存在し、単一の増殖細胞型を前提とする用語に疑問を呈している。神経細胞はシナプスを形成しており成熟を示した。星状膠細胞には中枢神経系のグリオーシスに類似した変化、上衣細胞には異常な線毛が認められた。原発性の中枢神経系腫瘍ではなく腹膜病変に関する報告である。
pmid-468125.summary_en: This case report describes the ultrastructure of mature (grade O) neurogenic peritoneal implants arising from an ovarian immature teratoma (grade I). Multiple neuroectodermal cell types were present, challenging the existing terminology that implies a single proliferating cell type. All cell lines showed maturity, with neurons forming well-formed synapses. Astrocytes showed fibrillary changes resembling central nervous system gliosis, and ependymal cells had abnormal cilia. The findings concern peritoneal lesions rather than a primary CNS tumour.
