pmid-876537.summary_en: A patient with bilateral gonadoblastomas presented with primary amenorrhea and infertility. Clinical findings included clitoromegaly, a hypoplastic uterus, elevated serum testosterone, and markedly raised gonadotropins with very low estrogens. The karyotype was XY. Both gonads were removed and showed typical histology. The authors propose a postulate to explain the clinical findings.

pmid-876538.summary_ja: 原発性無月経と全身性多毛を呈し、性腺異形成の身体的特徴を示した両側性性腺芽腫の患者を報告した。気腹式骨盤造影では子宮と低形成な性腺が認められ、石灰化は認められなかった。口腔粘膜細胞の性染色質は陰性で、核型は46,XXr/46,XXp-q-45,Xであった。染色体異常を伴う性腺芽腫の1例である。
pmid-876538.summary_en: A patient with bilateral gonadoblastoma presented with primary amenorrhea and generalized hirsutism, with somatic stigmata of gonadal dysgenesis. Pneumopelvigraphy showed a uterus and hypoplastic gonads without microcalcification. Buccal mucosal cells were sex chromatin negative, and the karyotype was 46,XXr/46,XXp-q-45,X. The report describes gonadoblastoma associated with a chromosomal aberration.

pmid-880739.summary_ja: 性腺異形成の女性患者で、右側に性腺粘液性嚢胞腺腫、左側に性腺芽腫を認めた。核型は45,X/46,X,dic(Yp)モザイクであった。dicentric Y染色体の報告例は本例で計23例となった。著者らは、Y染色体長腕が精巣分化の開始に、短腕が精巣の成熟に関与するとの仮説を本例から支持している。
pmid-880739.summary_en: A female patient with gonadal dysgenesis had a mucinous cystadenoma on the right gonad and a gonadoblastoma on the left. The karyotype was 45,X/46,X,dic(Yp) mosaicism, bringing the total number of reported dicentric Y chromosome cases to 23. The authors use this case to support the hypothesis that the long arm of the Y chromosome initiates testicular differentiation, while the short arm is responsible for testis maturation.

pmid-881632.summary_ja: 21歳男性の縦隔ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）を報告した。腫瘍は精巣セミノーマに類似し、リンパ球と形質細胞の浸潤を伴っていた。血清中には精子形成組織に対するIgG抗体が認められた。外科的切除後2年かけて抗体価は低下し、現在は検出されない。腫瘍宿主の防御機構と、この稀な腫瘍の組織発生への示唆について論じている。
pmid-881632.summary_en: A 21-year-old man with mediastinal germinoma, morphologically resembling testicular seminoma, had serum IgG antibodies against spermatopoietic tissue. The tumor showed heavy lymphocyte and plasma cell infiltration with germinal centres in lymph follicles. Antibody titres declined over two years after surgical removal and became undetectable. The authors discuss implications for tumor host defence and the histogenesis of these rare neoplasms.

pmid-881710.summary_ja: 1977年の報告で、46,XY核型を有する三姉妹がいずれも性腺芽腫と診断された症例を記載する。性腺芽腫は性分化疾患の性腺に生じる胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変である。家族内発症から、本腫瘍の発生に遺伝が重要な役割を果たす可能性が示唆された。
pmid-881710.summary_en: This 1977 report describes three sisters, all with gonadoblastoma and a 46,XY karyotype. Gonadoblastoma is a precursor lesion of germ cell tumors arising in dysgenetic gonads. The familial occurrence led the authors to suggest that heredity may play an important role in the development of this tumor. Although brief, the report provides early evidence of familial clustering in gonadoblastoma. The finding is relevant to genetic counseling and to understanding gonadal germ cell tumor pathogenesis in patients with disorders of sex development.

pmid-883061.summary_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍6例を報告し、奇形腫3例、胎児性癌1例などを含む。3例は水瘤を呈した。全例が精巣摘除術のみで治療され、1.5〜8.5年の無病生存を得た。2歳未満では精巣摘除術のみで多くが治癒し得ると著者らは示唆している。
pmid-883061.summary_en: Six pediatric testicular tumors are reported: three teratomas, one embryonal carcinoma, one orchioblastoma, and one paratesticular rhabdomyosarcoma. Three patients presented with hydroceles. All were treated with orchiectomy alone and remained disease-free for 1.5 to 8.5 years. The authors suggest that orchiectomy alone is curative for most children under two years of age with testicular tumors. The series supports conservative surgical management in young children and illustrates the spectrum of pediatric testicular neoplasms, including germ cell tumors and non-germ cell lesions.

pmid-886250.summary_ja: C3Hマウス胚由来の移植性奇形腫4種と胚様体の核型と分化能を解析した。正常核型を保つ腫瘍は多様な組織に分化した。一方、分化能が制限された3腫瘍は第11染色体の三倍体を共通して有した。染色体変化と分化能の関係を示し、胚細胞腫瘍の異質性の細胞遺伝学的基盤を示唆する。
pmid-886250.summary_en: The authors analyze karyotypes and differentiation capacity in four transplantable teratomas and their embryoid bodies derived from C3H mouse embryos. One tumour and one subline retained a normal karyotype and differentiated into a wide range of tissues. Three restricted tumours shared trisomy 11, and two showed similar changes in chromosomes 1 and 14. The findings link chromosomal alterations to restricted differentiation capacity in murine teratomas. They offer an early experimental view of the cytogenetic basis of germ cell tumor heterogeneity.

pmid-889185.summary_ja: 膵臓の類皮嚢腫は極めてまれな先天性病変で、胚組織遺残に由来すると考えられている。通常は無痛性の腹部腫瘤として発見され、腹痛や背部痛を伴うこともあるが、無症状の例もある。消化管閉塞を来す場合もあり、治療は外科的摘出である。性腺外に生じる成熟奇形腫型病変として位置づけられる。
pmid-889185.summary_en: This report reviews pancreatic dermoid cysts, which are very rare congenital lesions thought to arise from embryonic rests. They usually present as a nontender abdominal mass, often with abdominal pain and backache, though some are asymptomatic. Gastrointestinal obstruction may occur in some cases. Surgical extirpation is the recommended treatment. Because dermoid cysts represent mature teratoma-type lesions at an extragonadal site, the paper contributes to understanding how extragonadal germ-cell-derived lesions present clinically.

pmid-891479.summary_ja: 28歳患者が上腹部の触知可能な腫瘤と急速な閉塞性黄疸で受診した。膵腫瘍を疑いERCPを施行し、総胆管の狭窄・浸潤と主膵管の偏位を認めた。剖検で転移性精巣奇形腫と診断された。胚細胞腫瘍の転移が原発性膵癌様に黄疸を来しうる点を示す。
pmid-891479.summary_en: A 28-year-old patient presented with a palpable upper abdominal mass and rapidly developing obstructive jaundice. A pancreatic tumour was suspected, and ERCP was performed. It revealed narrowing and invasion of the common bile duct by metastatic lesions, along with displacement of the main pancreatic duct. Post-mortem examination later confirmed metastatic testicular teratoma. The case shows that metastatic germ cell tumor can mimic a primary pancreatic malignancy and cause biliary obstruction, and that ERCP can aid diagnosis in such presentations.

pmid-894444.summary_ja: 眼窩に生じた先天性奇形腫の症例である。組織は三胚葉すべてに由来し、高度に分化していた。悪性の疑いと、兎眼に続発した重度角膜炎による穿孔切迫のため眼窩内容除去術が施行された。性腺外に生じた奇形腫の稀な発生部位を示す。
pmid-894444.summary_en: The authors describe a congenital teratoma arising in the orbit. Histologically, the tumor tissues were derived from all three germ layers and showed an advanced degree of differentiation, consistent with a mature teratoma. Exenteration was performed because malignancy in the orbit was suspected and because severe keratitis with impending perforation had developed secondary to lagophthalmos. The case illustrates an extragonadal teratoma at an unusual site, with surgical management guided by diagnostic uncertainty and complications.

pmid-894825.summary_ja: 46,XY型の男児に生じた仙尾部奇形腫が低位尿道下裂の尿道を取り囲み、陰茎を偏位させた症例の報告。膀胱切開と人工肛門造設を行い、性別の変更を伴って腫瘍を摘出した。仙尾部奇形腫に伴う腎・膀胱病変は泌尿器科的管理を要することが多いと述べている。
pmid-894825.summary_en: This 1977 case report describes a genetically 46,XY male infant whose sacrococcygeal teratoma encircled the hypospadiac urethra and deviated the penis. Cystotomy and colostomy were required, along with a change in sex of rearing, to permit surgical removal. A congenital ventral transposition of the scrotum partially covered the resulting defect. The authors emphasize that renal and bladder complications of sacrococcygeal teratomas commonly require urologic management.

pmid-897168.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫26例の臨床・画像所見を文献レビューとともに検討した報告。多くは良性で出生時に認められ、女児は男児の約4倍多い。男児では悪性例が多い。手術が第一選択で、悪性例では早期診断と切除が重要とされる。
pmid-897168.summary_en: This 1977 radiology paper analyzes 26 new sacrococcygeal teratoma cases together with a literature review. Most lesions are benign and evident at birth, with females affected four times more often than males, while affected males are more likely to harbor malignant tumors. Benign teratomas are typically cystic and contain calcifications. Surgery is the primary curative treatment, and early diagnosis and removal are essential for malignant tumors.

pmid-904069.summary_ja: 縦隔リンパ節のサルコイドーシスと精巣の奇形胎児性癌が併存した症例報告。精巣腫瘍の縦隔転移や精巣サルコイドーシスとの鑑別が重要と強調している。適切な症例では精巣探索に加え縦隔生検を勧めている。
pmid-904069.summary_en: This case report describes sarcoidosis of the mediastinal lymph nodes coexisting with teratoembryonal carcinoma of the testis. The authors emphasize that this combination must be distinguished from mediastinal metastases of testicular tumours and from testicular sarcoidosis. In appropriate cases they favor mediastinal biopsy alongside testicular exploration as the diagnostic approach.

pmid-904745.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者の精巣摘除術中に行った精索リンパ管造影と精索静脈フレボグラフィーの検討。精索静脈は精巣のリンパ節に近接することが示された。リンパ節転移例では補助的な診断情報が得られ、悪性精巣腫瘍8例で有用であった。
pmid-904745.summary_en: This 1977 study evaluates funicular lymphography and spermatic vein phlebography performed during orchiectomy in patients with testicular tumours. The authors show that the spermatic vein lies close to the lymph nodes draining the testis. In patients with metastatic lymph node involvement, phlebography may provide supplementary diagnostic information. The method was successful in eight patients with malignant testicular tumours.

pmid-906560.summary_ja: 純粋セミノーマの患者にIgG依存性の温式自己免疫性溶血性貧血と単クローン性IgM-κクリオグロブリン血症が認められた。セミノーマと溶血の双方を治療した結果、これらの抗体は完全に消失し、腫瘍に対する免疫反応によって生じた可能性が示唆された。固形腫瘍に伴う類似の免疫現象についても文献的に概説されている。
pmid-906560.summary_en: A patient with pure seminoma developed severe IgG-mediated warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia, along with monoclonal IgM-kappa cryoglobulinemia and a biologically false-positive syphilis test. Treating both the seminoma and the hemolysis made all these antibodies disappear completely, suggesting an immune response to the tumor. The authors also review warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia and monoclonal paraproteinemia associated with solid tumors.

pmid-912263.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者において、後腹膜リンパ節の組織像が予後を予測しうるかを検討した研究。セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍の症例で、腫瘍に対する免疫反応と解釈される非腫瘍性のリンパ節変化を評価した。予後との明確な相関は得られず、その意義について考察している。
pmid-912263.summary_en: This study examined whether retroperitoneal lymph node histology in patients with testicular tumors could predict prognosis. Non-neoplastic lymph node changes, interpreted as immune responses to the tumor, were assessed in patients with seminoma and non-seminoma germ cell tumors. The authors report that these patterns did not correlate successfully with prognosis and discuss the implications of this negative finding.

pmid-912648.summary_ja: 精巣の精細管内セミノーマ病変を光学・電子顕微鏡で観察し、腫瘍細胞が精細管から間質へ広がる初期過程を検討した。腫瘍細胞は基底膜の陥入部に突出するか膜を直接浸潤し、遊走部位では基底膜が肥厚・多層化していた。間質の腫瘍細胞は索状・小葉状に増殖して充実性腫瘍を形成すると考察されている。
pmid-912648.summary_en: Intratubular seminoma lesions of the testis were examined by light and electron microscopy to clarify how tumor cells leave the seminiferous tubules. Neoplastic cells were seen protruding into basement membrane evaginations or invading the membrane directly, with thickened, multilayered basement membrane at emigration sites. Tumor cells lacking basement membrane were found in the interstitium, but transmigration through the membrane was not observed. The authors propose that these cells form strands and lobules that build the solid tumor.

pmid-912656.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫から生じた扁平上皮癌の4症例を報告し、臨床・手術・病理所見と予後の関連を検討した。最も重要な予後因子は、被膜が保たれ腫瘍が卵巣内に限局していることであった。被膜外進展を示した患者は2年以内に死亡した。関連文献の総説も含まれる。
pmid-912656.summary_en: Four cases of squamous cell carcinoma arising in benign cystic ovarian teratoma are reported, with clinical, operative and pathological findings correlated with prognosis. The most important prognostic factor was confinement of the tumor to the ovary with an intact capsule. Patients with extracapsular extension died within two years. The authors also review the relevant literature.

pmid-914274.summary_ja: 良性卵巣奇形腫は単為生殖由来で常染色体がホモ接合であり、受精なしでX染色体不活性化が起こるかを検討するモデルとして用いられた。BrdU色素法により、奇形腫細胞は後期複製のX染色体を1本のみ持ち、その複製パターンは正常線維芽細胞と一致し末梢リンパ球とは異なることが示された。受精がなくてもX不活性化は生じうると結論づけられている。
pmid-914274.summary_en: Benign ovarian teratomas, which are parthenogenetic and homozygous at autosomal loci, were used as a model to test whether fertilization is needed for X-chromosome inactivation. BrdU dye techniques showed that teratoma cells have a single late-replicating X chromosome, with a pattern matching normal fibroblasts but differing from peripheral lymphocytes. The authors conclude that X-inactivation can occur without fertilization.

pmid-926253.summary_ja: 90代の黒人男性に生じた純粋な胎児性癌の稀な症例を報告し、60歳以上の男性における精巣胚細胞腫瘍を文献的に概観している。精巣腫瘍の約9%が当該年齢層に発生し、その3分の1が胚細胞由来であることを示し、高齢男性でも胚細胞腫瘍が臨床上重要であることを指摘している。
pmid-926253.summary_en: Presents a rare case of pure embryonal carcinoma of the testis in a 90-year-old Black man, with a review of germ cell testicular tumors in men aged 60 years or older. Nearly 9 percent of testicular tumors occur in this age group, and about one third of these are germ cell in origin. The report highlights that germ cell testicular tumors remain clinically relevant in elderly men.

pmid-927332.summary_ja: 1961〜1975年に悪性卵巣腫瘍で治療された8〜19歳の15例を検討した。組織型はディスジャーミノーマ、未熟奇形腫、上皮性腫瘍、顆粒膜細胞腫であった。生存者5例のうち4例はディスジャーミノーマであり、進行期でも治癒しうることが示唆された。
pmid-927332.summary_en: Reviews 15 patients aged 8 to 19 years treated for malignant ovarian tumors between 1961 and 1975. Histology included dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, epithelial tumors, and granulosa cell tumor. Five patients survived, four of whom had dysgerminoma. The authors conclude that dysgerminoma, unlike other germ cell tumors, may be curable even in advanced stage, as shown by survivors with stage III disease.

pmid-927754.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫で手術を受けた213例を21年にわたり検討し、27例が両側性であった。肉眼的に正常な対側卵巣を切開・切除した90例では隠れた腫瘍は認められず、未処置の対側卵巣に後に奇形腫が生じた1例が報告された。正常所見の卵巣を日常的に二分割すべきではないと結論している。
pmid-927754.summary_en: Analyzes 213 women operated on for mature ovarian teratoma over 21 years, of whom 27 had bilateral tumors. Bilaterality was clinically evident in 22, while 5 required biopsy of a visually abnormal ovary. Investigation of visually normal contralateral ovaries in 90 cases found no hidden tumor. One later developed a teratoma in the untouched contralateral ovary. The authors conclude routine bivalving of normal-looking ovaries is unnecessary.

pmid-930591.summary_ja: 生後3か月男児の胃奇形腫の症例を報告する。6.5cmの腫瘤が噴門部小弯に認められ、組織学的には三胚葉由来の成分からなり、大部分は成熟していたが一部に未熟な神経組織を伴っていた。既報の胃奇形腫44例の文献レビューも併せて示し、性腺外の奇形腫の一例として位置づけられる。
pmid-930591.summary_en: Describes a gastric teratoma in a 3-month-old boy, presenting as a 6.5 cm mass on the lesser curvature of the cardiac region. Histology showed tissues from all three germ layers, mostly mature, with focal primitive neural tissue. The authors also review 44 previously reported cases of gastric teratoma. The case highlights that teratomas can arise in extragonadal sites such as the stomach in infants.

pmid-201648.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌の胚様体から、SV40で形質転換した31の細胞株を樹立し、増殖性、腫瘍形成能、分化マーカーを解析した研究である。同系マウスでの腫瘍形成はみられず、3株のみが全基準で形質転換を示した。分化マーカーの発現パターンは株により異なり、二つの酵素活性が同時に高い株はなかった。in vitroで奇形腫の分化経路を再構築する系としての利用が示唆されている。
pmid-201648.summary_en: The authors established 31 SV40-transformed cell lines from mouse teratocarcinoma embryoid bodies and characterized their growth properties, tumorigenicity, and differentiation markers. None formed tumors in syngeneic mice, and only three showed transformation across all criteria. Some lines expressed creatine phosphokinase while others expressed plasminogen activator, and no line expressed both. The authors suggest these lines may help reconstruct developmental pathways of differentiating teratomas in vitro.

pmid-264681.summary_ja: PCC4.azal悪性奇形癌細胞に変異原を作用させ、55クローンを単離した研究である。そのうち12クローンは同系マウスで腫瘍を形成しなかったが、照射マウスでは形成した。これらの株は免疫記憶細胞を誘導し、養子移入により防御能を与えた。同系宿主での免疫拒絶が原因と結論づけられている。胎児性癌由来細胞を用いたマウス腫瘍免疫モデルの研究である。
pmid-264681.summary_en: Researchers treated PCC4.azal malignant teratocarcinoma cells with a mutagen and isolated 55 clones, of which 12 failed to form tumors in syngeneic 129/Sv mice. These tum-minus clones still formed tumors in irradiated mice and stimulated immune memory cells that protected animals and conferred resistance by adoptive transfer. The authors conclude that the tum-minus clones are rejected by an immune response in syngeneic hosts. The study is a murine tumor immunology model using embryonal carcinoma-derived cells.

pmid-269895.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、乳児の口腔底に生じた類皮嚢腫を取り上げたものである。病因は主に発生学的であり、嚢胞壁の組織学的分化に基づくMeyerの分類を紹介している。嚢胞上皮の差異、鑑別診断、治療について述べている。精巣や卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍を扱う論文ではなく、当サイトの対象との関連は間接的である。
pmid-269895.summary_en: This case report describes a dermoid cyst of the floor of the mouth in an infant. The authors review its embryological etiology and the classification proposed by Meyer, which is based on histological differentiation of the cyst wall. Differences in the epithelial lining of the cysts are highlighted, followed by a discussion of differential diagnosis and treatment. The paper concerns an oral developmental cyst rather than a testicular or ovarian germ cell tumor, so its link to the site's scope is indirect.

pmid-271982.summary_ja: 変異導入したHPRT欠損のマウス奇形癌細胞を胚盤胞に注入し、モザイクマウスを作製した基礎研究。腫瘍由来細胞は腫瘍を形成せず正常発生に参加し、分化した組織でも機能を保った。ヒトのLesch-Nyhan病のモデルとなりうる。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の研究ではない。
pmid-271982.summary_en: Mutagenized, HPRT-deficient cells from a mouse teratocarcinoma line were injected into blastocysts to generate mosaic mice. The tumor-derived cells contributed to normal embryogenesis without forming tumors, showing developmental totipotency and tissue-specific differentiation. The model mirrors human Lesch-Nyhan disease and may help identify tissue sources of disease features. The study is basic developmental genetics rather than clinical germ cell tumor research.

pmid-558990.summary_ja: 1977年の基礎研究で、奇形癌由来の細胞株がマウスパルボウイルスMVMに感受性を示すかを検討している。多能性の胎児性癌細胞はこの感染に抵抗性を示し、その体細胞雑種も同様であった。感受性を決める細胞因子の解析に役立つ可能性が示されている。
pmid-558990.summary_en: This 1977 cell biology study examines whether teratocarcinoma-derived cells are infected by minute virus of mice (MVM), a parvovirus. Pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cells resisted infection, as did somatic cell hybrids containing them. Among blastocyst-derived lines, only a parietal yolk sac cell line was resistant. Non-pluripotent teratocarcinoma-derived cells were susceptible. The authors suggest these cultures could help identify cellular factors controlling viral susceptibility. The work is basic virology rather than clinical oncology.

pmid-844971.summary_ja: 妊娠5,616例の中で見つかった良性嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍16例を報告した研究です。内訳は漿液性嚢胞腺腫13例と類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）3例です。重篤な合併症は1例の卵巣捻転のみでした。胚細胞腫瘍は一部にとどまり、主題は妊娠中の卵巣腫瘍の頻度と合併症です。
pmid-844971.summary_en: This report describes 16 benign cystic ovarian neoplasms identified among 5,616 pregnancies, including 13 serous cystadenomas and 3 dermoid cysts. The only serious complication was ovarian torsion in one case. Dermoid cysts, which are mature teratomas, form a small part of the cohort, so germ cell tumor content is limited. The study focuses on the frequency and complications of ovarian neoplasms during pregnancy rather than on germ cell tumors specifically.

pmid-886245.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌のクローン細胞株を用いて、器官培養で内胚葉小胞と血島が形成されることを示す。これらは正常胚の卵黄嚢に見られるメガロサイトを生じる。ヘモグロビン含有細胞の形成は一定期間後に停止し、成体型造血には置き換わらない。胚発生と造血の研究モデルとしての性格が強い。
pmid-886245.summary_en: This study examines a clonal mouse teratocarcinoma cell line cultured in submerged and organotypic conditions. The cells differentiate into endodermal vesicles and blood islands, which give rise to megalocytes resembling those of the normal mouse embryo yolk sac. Haemoglobin-containing cell formation ceases after a time and is not replaced by adult haematopoiesis in culture. The work mainly uses the teratocarcinoma line as a model of embryonic differentiation and haematopoiesis. It does not investigate germ cell tumor biology or clinical management.

pmid-916057.summary_ja: 陰嚢内腫瘤を有する27例を対象に、グレースケール超音波検査で評価を行った。臨床診断と照合すると、ほぼ全例で超音波検査は信頼できる結果を示した。精巣腫瘍・胚細胞腫瘍に特化した記述はなく、陰嚢内腫瘤全般の評価に関する短報であり、精巣腫瘍の画像診断として読める内容である。
pmid-916057.summary_en: Gray-scale ultrasound was used to evaluate 27 patients presenting with scrotal masses. Given the clinical diagnosis, ultrasound proved reliable in almost all cases. The brief report does not specifically describe germ cell tumors, so its relevance to this site rests on the general evaluation of scrotal masses, which often include testicular neoplasms.

pmid-1003535.summary_ja: マウス胚の外胚葉を成体マウスの精巣に移植し、奇形癌が生じることを示した1976年の研究。未分化な胚細胞と三胚葉由来の組織を含む奇形癌が形成された。胚細胞腫瘍の起源を考える上で重要な実験的知見である。
pmid-1003535.summary_en: This 1976 study grafted primary ectoderm and endoderm from 6-day hybrid mouse embryos into adult mouse testes. Embryonic ectoderm grafts produced teratocarcinomas containing undifferentiated embryonal cells and derivatives of all three germ layers. Extraembryonic ectoderm produced invasive trophoblastic giant cells, while endoderm grafts did not develop. The work provides experimental evidence on the developmental origins of teratocarcinoma, an experimental model relevant to germ cell tumour biology.

pmid-1003548.summary_ja: 1976年にナイジェリアのイボ族で行われた研究で、約7,500件の手術検体から86例の奇形腫を検討した。86%が卵巣由来で、精巣奇形腫は認められなかった。男性の性腺腫瘍は少ないと結論づけている。
pmid-1003548.summary_en: This 1976 Nigerian study reviewed 86 teratomas from about 7,500 surgical specimens received by a central laboratory. Most teratomas (86%) arose in the ovaries. No testicular teratomas were seen among three testicular primary cancers, while 37 ovarian primary cancers were recorded. The authors conclude that gonadal tumours are uncommon in Igbo males, similar to other African populations. The study is a descriptive epidemiological report on teratoma site distribution.

pmid-1003666.summary_ja: 腎移植後に免疫抑制薬を服用中の30歳男性が、術後3か月で右精巣にセミノーマと奇形腫の混合腫瘍を発症した症例報告（1976年）。免疫抑制と腫瘍発生の時間的関係から、免疫防御機構の関与が示唆されている。
pmid-1003666.summary_en: This 1976 case report describes a 30-year-old man on immunosuppressants after renal transplantation who developed a mixed tumour of seminoma and teratoma in the right testis three months after surgery. The temporal association between immunosuppression and tumour development suggests a possible role of immune defence in controlling germ cell tumour growth. The report highlights the potential influence of immunosuppressive therapy on testicular neoplasia.

pmid-1004942.summary_ja: 本1976年の報告は、甲状腺成分が優勢な嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた乳頭状甲状腺腫性腺癌と解釈された、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫のまれな症例を提示している。患者は手術前に甲状腺機能亢進の症状はなく、術後の甲状腺機能検査は正常であった。3年間の経過観察で異常は認められなかった。著者らは、この悪性腫瘍は予後が良好で治癒率が高いと記している。
pmid-1004942.summary_en: This 1976 report presents a rare case of malignant struma ovarii, interpreted as a papillary strumal adenocarcinoma arising in a cystic teratoma with predominant thyroid elements. The patient had no symptoms of thyroid hyperfunction before surgery, and postoperative thyroid function tests were normal. Follow-up over three years showed no abnormalities. The authors note that this malignancy carries a good prognosis with a high cure rate.

pmid-1006191.summary_ja: 1976年の症例報告で、精巣悪性奇形腫の既往がある患者の狭窄尿管に対し、透視下で経皮的細針生検を行った。転移と瘢痕の鑑別が目的であり、画像診断で鑑別困難な悪性疾患への応用を勧めている。
pmid-1006191.summary_en: This 1976 case report describes percutaneous fine needle aspiration biopsy guided by fluoroscopy during retrograde pyelography. The biopsy aimed to distinguish metastatic involvement from scarring in a strictured ureter of a patient previously treated for testicular malignant teratoma. The authors recommend this approach in malignant disease when retrograde pyelography or urography cannot establish the differential diagnosis. It addresses diagnosis of metastasis from a germ cell tumour.

pmid-1006462.summary_ja: 1976年に南アフリカで行われた研究で、ナタールの黒人とインド系患者426例の原発性卵巣腫瘍を比較した。胚細胞腫瘍は黒人で52%、インド系で19%と、黒人に多かった。人種間で頻度に明らかな差がみられた。
pmid-1006462.summary_en: This 1976 South African study analysed 426 primary ovarian tumours in Black and Indian patients in Natal. Cystomas were more frequent in Indians (67%) than Blacks (29%). Germ cell tumours predominated in Black patients (52%) compared with Indian patients (19%). The Indian distribution resembled that of American and European series. The study shows population differences in ovarian tumour and germ cell tumour incidence.

pmid-1011335.summary_ja: 1976年の報告で、新生児の頸部に急速に増大した腫瘤を切除し、奇形腫と診断した。網膜組織を含む稀な所見があった。嚔下や呼吸の障害が症状であり、外科的切除が治療とされている。
pmid-1011335.summary_en: This 1976 report describes cervical teratomas, rare tumours in an unusual location. A neck mass in a newborn enlarged disproportionately and was excised; histology confirmed teratoma. The tumour contained retinal tissue, an unusual finding. The authors describe symptoms from interference with swallowing and breathing and recommend surgical excision as treatment. The case suggests a possible association with maternal estrogen ingestion during conception.

pmid-1012799.summary_ja: 1976年の症例報告で、3歳児の左肺下方に生じた良性前縦隔奇形腫を示している。当初は限局性胸水と誤認された。CT検査により診断が明確になり、胸膜疾患が疑われる症例での有用性が示唆されている。
pmid-1012799.summary_en: This 1976 case report describes a 3-year-old child with a benign anterior mediastinal teratoma located inferior to the left lung. The lesion was initially confused with loculated pleural fluid and was not apparent at 4 months of age. Computerized axial tomography of the specimen clearly established the diagnosis. The authors suggest that this imaging approach may help in selected patients with apparent pleural disease.

pmid-1015694.summary_ja: 1976年のスペインからの報告で、小児奇形腫109例（良性86例、悪性23例）を検討した。仙尾部・骨盤部が多く、体内深部に位置するほど悪性率が高かった。良性奇形腫の未熟成分は予後不良を示さなかった。
pmid-1015694.summary_en: This 1976 Spanish paper reviews 109 teratomas in children, of which 86 were benign and 23 malignant. Sacrococcygeal and pelvic teratomas predominated, with malignancy increasing as tumours became more internal. Other sites included gonads, head and neck, retroperitoneum, anterior mediastinum, and the central nervous system. Malignant teratomas were usually carcinomas with glandular, capillary, and clear cell areas. Immature elements in benign teratomas did not indicate a worse prognosis.

pmid-1015813.summary_ja: 本論文は1976年の研究で、良性卵巣奇形腫を用いてヒトの遺伝子と動原体との距離を推定する方法を提案している。奇形腫は胚細胞から減数第二分裂の抑制により単為生殖的に生じると仮定し、ヘテロ接合の宿主に由来するヘテロ接合奇形腫の割合から、真菌遺伝学で用いられる第二分裂分離の頻度を導く。奇形腫に基づくヒト遺伝子マッピングのための写像関数が示されている。
pmid-1015813.summary_en: This 1976 study proposes a method for estimating the distance between a gene and its centromere in humans using benign ovarian teratomas. Assuming these teratomas arise parthenogenetically from a germ cell through suppression of the second meiotic division, the authors relate the observed proportion of heterozygous teratomas in heterozygous hosts to the frequency of second-division segregation, a concept borrowed from fungal genetics. Mapping functions for teratoma-based mapping in humans are presented.

pmid-1017919.summary_ja: 1960年から1971年にルンド大学病院で治療された精巣腫瘍128例を解析した報告。発症年齢、症状、組織型、診断、治療、生存率を検討している。奇形腫は67例で、多くは20～30歳代に発生し、組織型や進展度に応じて治療された。5年生存率は40%であった。セミノーマは61例で、30～40歳代に多く、精巣摘除術と放射線療法で治療され、5年生存率は82%であった。
pmid-1017919.summary_en: This report analyzes 128 patients with testicular tumours treated at Lund University Hospital between 1960 and 1971. Age at onset, symptoms, histology, diagnosis, treatment and survival were reviewed. Teratoma occurred in 67 cases, mostly aged 20 to 30 years, and was treated with orchiectomy, lymphadenectomy, chemotherapy and/or radiation depending on histology and spread, with a 5-year survival of 40%. Sixty-one patients had seminoma, mostly aged 30 to 40, treated with orchiectomy and radiation, with a 5-year survival of 82%.

pmid-1027639.summary_ja: 1976年の報告で、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫を反復した17歳の女性例を記載している。初回手術後と放射線照射前に細胞性および液性免疫反応を検査したところ、約2か月半の一過性の免疫反応亢進が認められた。照射後はPHA反応が著明に低下したが、11か月後に改善した。二回目の手術後22か月の時点で患者は良好であった。
pmid-1027639.summary_en: This 1976 report describes a 17-year-old girl with recurrent ovarian dysgerminoma. Cell-mediated and humoral immune responses were examined after the first operation and before irradiation. A transient increase in immune responsiveness was seen for about 2.5 months. After irradiation, the PHA response was markedly defective, improving by 11 months. The patient remained well 22 months after the second operation.

pmid-1033657.summary_ja: 1976年の日本からの症例報告で、子宮病変を伴わず膣に原発した絨毛癌の閉経後50歳女性を記載している。最終妊娠から23年後に異常な膣出血と咳が出現し、閉経後に腫瘍が発生していた。著者らは、異所性の発生機序と長い潜伏期間について考察している。
pmid-1033657.summary_en: This 1976 Japanese case report describes a 50-year-old postmenopausal woman with choriocarcinoma that arose primarily in the vagina without any uterine lesion. Symptoms of atypical vaginal bleeding and coughing appeared 23 years after her last pregnancy. The authors discuss possible mechanisms underlying the ectopic location of the tumour and the long latency period before clinical presentation.

pmid-1034031.summary_ja: 1976年の泌尿器科学誌掲載の報告で、クロマチン陽性の男児に生じた原発性縦隔絨毛癌を記載している。クラインフェルター症候群を示唆する所見があった。著者らは、同症候群における腫瘍発生頻度、腫瘍の発生学、そして縦隔絨毛癌患者に必要な診断評価について考察している。性染色体異常と胚細胞腫瘍との関連を示す症例である。
pmid-1034031.summary_en: This 1976 urology report describes primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma in a chromatin-positive boy, a finding suggesting Klinefelter's syndrome. The authors discuss the incidence of neoplasms in Klinefelter patients, embryogenesis of this tumour, and the diagnostic evaluation required for patients presenting with mediastinal choriocarcinoma. Such a presentation is rare, and the case highlights the link between sex chromosome abnormalities and germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-1034990.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍34例のゴナドトロピン値を測定した1976年の報告。胎児性癌、奇形癌、絨毛癌や進行例で高値を示し、高値ほど予後不良だった。女性化乳房は高エストロゲン血症と関連した。ホルモン測定は他の臨床所見と併せ、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のフォローアップに有用とされた。
pmid-1034990.summary_en: This 1976 study measured gonadotropin levels in 34 men with testicular germ cell tumors. Elevated titres occurred mainly in embryonal carcinoma, teratocarcinoma and choriocarcinoma and in advanced stages. Higher titres correlated with worse prognosis. Gynaecomastia in four patients was linked to high total estrogens. The authors conclude that hormonal assays are valuable for clinical follow-up of testicular germ cell tumors when combined with other clinical parameters.

pmid-1035209.summary_ja: 4人兄弟のうち3人が悪性精巣腫瘍を発症した1976年の報告。長男は絨毛癌、次男はセミノーマ、三男は奇形癌だった。同一家系内で異なる組織型の胚細胞腫瘍が生じた稀な症例として報告されている。遺伝的・環境的要因の検討は本報告では行われていない。
pmid-1035209.summary_en: This 1976 report describes three of four brothers who developed malignant testicular tumors. The eldest had choriocarcinoma, the second seminoma, and the third teratocarcinoma of the testis. The case highlights the clustering of different germ cell tumor histologies within one family. The brief report offers no analysis of genetic or environmental causes.

pmid-1053336.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ20例の血清hCGを測定した1976年の報告。陽性は2例のみで、いずれも非セミノーマ性転移を予測する所見を示していた。純粋セミノーマ患者において、血清hCGは非セミノーマ性転移の検出と経過観察に有用な腫瘍マーカーであると結論づけられた。
pmid-1053336.summary_en: This 1976 study measured serum hCG in 20 men with histologically proven testicular seminoma. Only 2 patients tested positive, and both had findings predictive of non-seminomatous metastasis. The authors conclude that in pure seminoma, serum hCG is a useful tumor marker for detecting and following non-seminomatous metastases. The report is an early study of hCG's utility in this setting.

pmid-1061157.summary_ja: マウス悪性奇形癌細胞の単一細胞を胚盤胞に注入し、全能性を検証した1976年の基礎研究。腫瘍由来細胞は多くの正常な体細胞組織に寄与した。一例では膵臓のみに寄与し、腺癌様の悪性腫瘍が生じた。得られたモザイクマウスに奇形腫は認められず、腫瘍細胞の分化可能性を示す重要な知見である。
pmid-1061157.summary_en: This 1976 PNAS study tests whether single mouse malignant teratocarcinoma cells retain developmental totipotency. Individually injected cells were cloned in genetically marked blastocysts, producing a mosaic mouse whose tumor-derived cells contributed to many normal somatic tissues. Some chimeras showed sporadic distribution in unrelated tissues, and one contributed only to the pancreas, giving rise to an adenocarcinoma-like malignancy. Mosaic mice were free of teratomas.

pmid-1083496.summary_ja: 歯肉の出血性腫瘤として発症した絨毛上皮腫（絨毛癌）の1976年の症例報告。当初は妊娠腫瘍や血管腫と疑われたが、病理組織学的検査で確定診断された。口腔内への転移が認められ、死因は本腫瘍であった。生検と病理検査の重要性を強調している。
pmid-1083496.summary_en: This 1976 Oral Surgery case report describes a very malignant neoplasm that initially resembled a pregnancy tumor or hemangioma and presented as a bleeding gingival mass. The tumor metastasized to the oral cavity, and it was the cause of death. Histopathological examination established the final diagnosis. The authors emphasize the importance of biopsy and routine pathologic examination regardless of clinical appearance.

pmid-1087181.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoをDNA合成を阻害する用量のメトトレキサートで処理した研究である。hCG合成は約10倍、胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ活性は約3倍に増加し、乳酸脱水素酵素は変化しなかった。チミジンやホリン酸の同時投与でこの効果は抑制された。メトトレキサートが絨毛癌の腫瘍マーカー産生を亢進させるという知見である。
pmid-1087181.summary_en: This study examined the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line treated with methotrexate at doses that inhibit DNA synthesis. Treatment increased human chorionic gonadotropin synthesis about tenfold and placental alkaline phosphatase activity about threefold, without a concomitant rise in lactate dehydrogenase. Thymidine or folinic acid blocked these effects, and neither alone increased hCG or placental alkaline phosphatase. The findings describe an unexpected stimulatory effect of methotrexate on trophoblast tumor marker production.

pmid-1087970.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性悪性疾患の9症例の管理と治療を報告した研究である。胞状奇胎後の経過観察を行い、奇胎の悪性転化が確認された時点で速やかに細胞傷害性化学療法を開始することの重要性を強調している。希少な疾患であるが、化学療法により治癒可能であると述べられている。
pmid-1087970.summary_en: This report presents nine cases of gestational trophoblastic malignancy, which the authors describe as rare but curable with cytotoxic chemotherapy. The authors emphasize that outcomes depend on monitoring post-molar patients and starting chemotherapy once malignant transformation of the mole is documented. Management and treatment of the nine cases are discussed. The paper highlights surveillance after hydatidiform mole as key to timely treatment.

pmid-1088402.summary_ja: 1970年から1974年にフィリピンのマニラ周辺都市で、絨毛癌91例を人口ベースで調べた疫学研究である。発生率は出生10万対17.4で、40歳以上の母親で最も高く、流産歴が多いほどリスクが上昇した。症例対照研究では肺結核既往と経口避妊薬使用が多い傾向が見られたが、協力率が低いため追試の必要性を指摘している。
pmid-1088402.summary_en: This population-based study identified 91 choriocarcinoma cases in Manila and nearby Philippine cities from 1970 to 1974, with an overall incidence of 17.4 per 100,000 live births. Risk was highest in mothers aged 40 and over, slightly elevated under age 20, and rose with the number of fetal losses. A case-control analysis of 28 patients and 187 controls found more prior pulmonary tuberculosis and oral contraceptive use among cases. The authors note low cooperation limited the findings.

pmid-1140.summary_ja: マウス精巣奇形腫(OTT 6050)の神経上皮分化成分について、cAMP、セロトニン、および各種神経伝達系酵素を生化学的に測定した研究である。神経上皮成分が多い腫瘍ほどcAMPやTPH、AADC、TH、DBHの活性が高い傾向が見られた。原始神経上皮性腫瘍における神経分化の研究モデルとして有用であると述べている。
pmid-1140.summary_en: This study biochemically profiled a transplantable mouse testicular teratoma (OTT 6050) with neuroepithelial differentiation. cAMP, serotonin, and enzymes of the serotonergic, adrenergic, and cholinergic systems were measured and compared between tumors with differing proportions of neuroepithelial components and normal neonatal and adult mouse brains. Tumors with more neuroepithelial tissue tended to show higher cAMP and increased TPH, AADC, TH, and DBH activity. The authors propose the neuroepithelial component as a model for studying neuronal differentiation in primitive neuroepithelial neoplasms.

pmid-1246116.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する根治的後腹膜リンパ節郭清で、後腹膜リンパ節をすべて切除できるかを検討した研究である。腰動脈を結紮・離断する改良法により、献体12体で後腹膜リンパ節組織をすべて切除できた。脊髄虚血の合併症は最小限のリスクであり、治療的有用性を損なわないと結論づけている。
pmid-1246116.summary_en: This study tested whether radical retroperitoneal lymph node dissection removes all retroperitoneal nodes, challenging earlier claims of inadequacy. The modified technique ligated and divided the infrarenal lumbar vessels. In 12 cadavers, all retroperitoneal nodal tissue was excised, confirmed by the absence of residual nodes in three patients who died of metastatic embryonal carcinoma. The authors conclude that spinal cord ischemia from lumbar ligation is a minimal risk that does not outweigh the procedure's therapeutic value.

pmid-1246766.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の治療後の性機能、射精、妊孕性をアンケートで調べた研究である。放射線療法のみを受けたセミノーマ29例では性機能の変化は少なかったが、10例で精液量の減少が見られた。外科的治療を受けた非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍50例では42例で精液量が有意に減少した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清が射精を障害しうる機序についても考察している。
pmid-1246766.summary_en: This questionnaire study assessed sexual function, ejaculation, and fecundity in patients treated for testicular tumors with radiotherapy, lymphadenectomy, or both. Among 29 seminoma patients treated with irradiation alone, sexual performance and drive changed little, though 10 reported reduced semen volume. In 50 patients with nonseminomatous tumors treated surgically, 42 reported significantly decreased semen volume. Fecundity success was 2 of 3 for seminoma and 7 of 12 for nonseminomatous patients who desired children. The effects of retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy on ejaculation are discussed.

pmid-1246795.summary_ja: 非双生児の兄弟2組に精巣腫瘍が発生した症例を報告する。著者らは、発生異常(dysgenesis, dysgonesis)や細胞の全能性を含む発症機序について考察している。短報ではあるが、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の家族内集積に関する初期の観察であり、疫学や病因を考えるうえで示唆に富む。
pmid-1246795.summary_en: This report describes two sets of testicular tumors occurring in non-twin sibling pairs, suggesting a familial predisposition. The authors discuss possible pathogenetic mechanisms, including dysgenesis, dysgonesis, and the totipotentiality of germ cells. Although brief, it is an early observation of familial clustering of testicular germ cell neoplasia, relevant to the epidemiology and etiology of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-1247071.summary_ja: Y染色体を持つ間性患者320例を対象に、性腺腫瘍の発生年齢を解析した研究である。性腺異形成など3群では思春期以降に腫瘍が増加し、思春期前の性腺摘出が推奨された。精巣女性化症候群では腫瘍リスクを約3.6%と見積もり、25歳までの手術延期も考慮されるとしている。
pmid-1247071.summary_en: This study analyzed the age at which gonadal tumors appeared in 320 intersex patients with a Y chromosome, classified into four groups, using Johns Hopkins cases and literature data. Tumor incidence rose after puberty in the first three groups, leading the authors to recommend gonadectomy before puberty. In testicular feminization syndrome, they suggest that delaying surgery until age 25 may be acceptable, given an estimated neoplasia risk of about 3.6 percent.

pmid-1248281.summary_ja: 絨毛癌による再発性の腫瘍塞栓の症例報告である。患者は著しい肺高血圧を呈し、当初は多発性肺塞栓症として診断・治療された。腫瘍塞栓を示唆する所見は存在したが、後方視的にしか認識されなかった。絨毛癌既往者における原因不明の肺高血圧では、腫瘍塞栓も鑑別診断に含めるべきことを示している。
pmid-1248281.summary_en: A case of recurrent tumor emboli caused by choriocarcinoma is reported. The patient had marked pulmonary hypertension and was initially diagnosed and treated as multiple pulmonary thromboembolism. Signs suggesting tumor embolism were present but recognized only retrospectively. The report highlights the importance of considering tumor embolism in the differential diagnosis of unexplained pulmonary hypertension in patients with a history of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-1250540.summary_ja: 未流産の胞状奇胎患者35例で血清ヒト絨毛性ソマトマンモトロピン(hCS)を測定した研究である。hCSは妊娠週数や子宮の大きさと相関したが、血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とは相関しなかった。その後絨毛癌を発症した症例のhCS値は非発症例と有意差がなく、悪性化の予測指標としては不良と結論された。
pmid-1250540.summary_en: This study measured serum human chorionic somatomammotropin (hCS) in 35 women with unaborted hydatidiform mole. hCS rose with gestational age and correlated with uterine size, but not with serum hCG. A patient who later developed choriocarcinoma showed hCS levels similar to those without malignant progression, so hCS was judged a poor predictor of malignant sequelae in molar pregnancy.

pmid-1250564.summary_ja: 核型46,XXの真性半陰陽患者に発生した性腺芽細胞腫の症例報告である。性腺芽細胞腫はY染色体を有する異形成性性腺から生じると考えられてきた。本例はY染色体を欠く46,XXの個体で報告された初例であり、性腺の胚細胞性腫瘍が発生しうる遺伝的背景の範囲を広げるものである。
pmid-1250564.summary_en: This report describes gonadoblastoma in a 46,XX true hermaphrodite, a patient who lacks a Y chromosome in the karyotype. Gonadoblastomas were previously known to arise in dysgenetic gonads containing a Y chromosome, so this case is notable as the first reported example in a 46,XX individual. It expands the recognized spectrum of genetic backgrounds in which gonadal germ cell neoplasia can develop.

pmid-1251856.summary_ja: 妊娠初期に両側嚢胞性奇形腫が腹腔内破裂した症例を報告する。1908年から1971年までの良性嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔内破裂例22例を文献的に検討している。既報例はいずれも片側卵巣のみで妊娠中期以降の破裂であり、本例は両側性かつ妊娠初期という点で異例である。
pmid-1251856.summary_en: A case of intra-abdominal rupture of bilateral cystic teratomas during the first trimester of pregnancy is reported. The authors reviewed 22 previously reported cases of intraperitoneal rupture of benign cystic teratoma published between 1908 and 1971. In all those cases only one ovary was involved and rupture occurred after the first trimester, whereas the present case involved both ovaries, making it unusual.

pmid-1258245.summary_ja: 精巣原発の奇形癌から生じた胚細胞癌の単発肺転移に対し、肺切除を行い22年生存した症例を報告する。著者らは関連文献を検討し、肺転移病変の切除基準を提示している。胚細胞腫瘍における転移巣切除の長期成績を示す注目すべき症例である。
pmid-1258245.summary_en: A 22-year survivor is described after pulmonary resection of a solitary embryonal cell carcinoma metastasis arising from a primary testicular teratocarcinoma. The authors review the literature on this problem and present criteria for resecting metastatic lesions in the lung. It is a notable long-term outcome example of germ cell tumor metastasectomy and supports consideration of surgical resection for selected solitary pulmonary metastases.

pmid-1258625.summary_ja: 分娩を妨げた先天性仙尾部奇形腫の症例で、膣内経由の切開排液によって対処した報告である。腫瘍による難産が生じていたが、経膣分娩により健康な生児が得られた。稀な腫瘍に対する異例の産科的対応を示した報告であり、系統的な検討ではない。
pmid-1258625.summary_en: A congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma obstructing labor was managed by incisional drainage through the vagina. The tumor caused obstructed labor, but vaginal delivery produced a live, healthy infant. The report describes an unusual obstetric approach to a rare tumor rather than a systematic study.

pmid-1260672.summary_ja: 1976年の報告で、小児の悪性精巣腫瘍67例を検討した。大半は後腹膜リンパ節、肺、骨へ転移した胎児性癌であった。精巣摘除術に後腹膜照射を併用した症例では89%が長期生存し、転移例のうち2例は化学療法で効果が得られた。予後は年齢と組織型に関連し、早期発見と適切な治療が重要とされた。
pmid-1260672.summary_en: This 1976 series reviewed 67 children with malignant testicular tumors, predominantly embryonal carcinoma that had metastasized to retroperitoneal lymph nodes, lungs, and bones. Simple orchiectomy followed by retroperitoneal irradiation achieved long-term survival in 89% of cases. Two patients with metastases benefited from chemotherapy. Prognosis correlated with patient age and histologic pattern, and the authors emphasized early detection and appropriate treatment as the keys to cure.

pmid-1260688.summary_ja: 17歳の男性化を伴う女性表現型患者の異形成性性腺に生じた性腺芽腫を、光学・電子顕微鏡および超微細構造組織化学で詳細に検討した。胚細胞は胎児性腺や胚細胞腫瘍のものと同一で、セルトリ様細胞やライディッヒ様細胞も認められた。基底膜所見などから、異形成卵巣ではなく異形成精巣由来と結論づけている。
pmid-1260688.summary_en: This study examined a gonadoblastoma arising in the dysgenetic gonad of a virilized 17-year-old with a female phenotype and a 45,X0/46,X-ring-Y karyotype. Light microscopy, electron microscopy, and ultrastructural histochemistry showed germ cells like those in fetal gonads and germ cell tumors, along with Sertoli-like and Leydig-like cells. Basal lamina features, Charcot-Böttcher crystalloids, and 3β-HSD activity supported a testicular identity. The authors conclude that gonadoblastoma arises from a dysgenetic testis rather than a dysgenetic ovary.

pmid-1260698.summary_ja: 1960～1975年に治療した小児の悪性卵巣腫瘍22例を検討した。内訳は悪性奇形腫12例、卵黄嚢腫瘍6例、胎児性癌4例である。従来の治療成績が不良だったため、1971年から積極的手術、直後の放射線療法、強力な化学療法によるT2プロトコルを導入し、10例中6例が無病生存した。病変の広がりによる新たな分類も提案している。
pmid-1260698.summary_en: This study reviewed 22 children with malignant ovarian tumors treated from 1960 to 1975, including 12 malignant teratomas, six endodermal sinus tumors, and four embryonal carcinomas. Surgery alone or combined with radiation or chemotherapy gave poor results. An aggressive protocol (T2) of extensive initial surgery, immediate radiotherapy, and intensive chemotherapy was introduced in 1971. Six of ten patients treated with it were alive and disease-free at a median follow-up of 22+ months. A new extent-of-disease grouping is also proposed.

pmid-1260722.summary_ja: 他の胚細胞成分を含まない純粋な未熟卵巣奇形腫58例を解析した。原発腫瘍と転移巣をそれぞれ0～3の悪性度で分級し、病期Iが40例、病期IIが9例、病期IIIが9例であった。原発腫瘍の悪性度は卵巣外進展の予測に、転移巣の悪性度は経過の予測に最も有用だった。転移巣がグレード3の7例は全例が死亡した。
pmid-1260722.summary_en: This study analyzed 58 pure immature ovarian teratomas, excluding tumors with other germ cell elements. Primary tumors and metastases were graded from 0 to 3, and stage was I in 40, II in nine, and III in nine patients. Primary tumor grade best predicted extraovarian spread, and metastasis grade best predicted the subsequent course. Five-year and ten-year survival was 63%. All seven patients with grade 3 metastases died of disease, underscoring the importance of adequate sampling for prognosis and therapy.

pmid-1262154.summary_ja: 約6,000例の出生がある病院で2年間に経験した新生児の仙尾部奇形腫3例を報告する。経膣分娩2例、帝王切開1例で出生した。1例は直ちに手術を受けて生存したが、残り2例は全身状態が不良で手術適応がなかった。早期切除が治療の第一選択であり、悪性例には放射線療法や化学療法は有効でないと結論づけている。
pmid-1262154.summary_en: This report describes three neonatal sacrococcygeal teratomas identified over two years at a hospital with roughly 6,000 live births. Two infants were delivered vaginally and one by cesarean section. One infant underwent immediate surgery and survived, while the other two were too unwell for surgery. The authors conclude that early excision is the treatment of choice and that radiotherapy and chemotherapy are ineffective for malignant sacrococcygeal lesions.

pmid-1267292.summary_ja: 縦隔の奇形腫様腫瘍について、前縦隔は卵巣と精巣に次ぐ好発部位であると述べている。類皮嚢腫は外胚葉と中胚葉成分からなり、奇形腫は三胚葉すべての派生物を含むと区別している。臨床症状から悪性度を推定することはできず、外科的切除が診断と治療の最良の方法とされる。小児や若年成人の悪性例の予後は不良である。
pmid-1267292.summary_en: This review of teratoid tumors of the mediastinum notes that the anterior mediastinum is the third most common site after the ovaries and testes. The authors distinguish dermoid cysts, which contain ectodermal and mesodermal elements, from teratomas, which contain derivatives of all three germ layers. Clinical features do not indicate malignant potential. Chest radiography, tomography, and esophagography are useful, and surgical excision offers the best method of diagnosis and treatment. Prognosis is poor for malignant teratoids, especially in children and young adults.

pmid-1267639.summary_ja: 14歳の女児から切除された悪性卵巣奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍内に部分的に発育した眼球が認められた。卵巣奇形腫は三胚葉由来の組織を含みうるが、眼球様構造の報告は稀である。詳細な組織学的所見や経過は記載されていないが、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の分化能を示す例である。
pmid-1267639.summary_en: This brief case report describes a malignant ovarian teratoma resected from a 14-year-old girl. Within the tumor, a partially developed eye was found. The finding is notable because ovarian teratomas can contain tissues derived from all three germ layers, and organized ocular structures are rarely reported. It illustrates the developmental potential of ovarian germ cell tumors, although the report provides no detailed histology or follow-up.

pmid-1268587.summary_ja: 1976年の研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する全身ガリウム67クエン酸シンチグラフィを評価しています。播種性セミノーマでは病変を良好に描出した一方、奇形腫では陽性率が低くなりました。初診時の進展度判定やフォローアップに有用とされています。
pmid-1268587.summary_en: This 1976 study evaluates whole-body gallium-67 citrate scanning in patients with testicular germ cell tumors. Scans reliably localized disease in disseminated seminoma, but were less consistently positive in teratoma, where most scans were negative. In combined tumors, the scan reflected the dominant histology at the time of imaging. The authors conclude that gallium scanning is useful for determining disease extent at presentation and for routine follow-up, and may help differentiate combined tumors when masses exceed 2 cm.

pmid-1269285.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫（畸形癌）の縦隔リンパ節転移例で、縦隔腸嚢胞に類似した病変を伴っていました。強力な化学療法後に転移腫瘍が組織学的に成熟して生じたと考察されています。化学療法後の縦隔残存病変の解釈に関わる稀な所見を報告しています。
pmid-1269285.summary_en: This case report describes testicular teratocarcinoma metastatic to a mediastinal lymph node, associated with a mediastinal lesion that resembled an enteric cyst. The authors propose that this cyst-like lesion arose from histologic maturation of the metastatic tumor after intensive chemotherapy. The paper reviews the literature supporting this mechanism. It documents a rare form of post-chemotherapy maturation in a metastatic germ cell tumor, with clinical and pathological implications for interpreting residual mediastinal masses.

pmid-1271542.summary_ja: 1976年の報告で、17歳女性の右腸骨窩に生じた後腹膜奇形腫の症例を扱っています。初回手術は十分と思われたものの、18か月以内に死亡しました。奇形腫の文献について歴史的な観点からレビューしています。非典型部位の奇形腫の進行の仕方を示す症例です。
pmid-1271542.summary_en: This 1976 paper reports a retroperitoneal teratoma arising in an unusual location, the right iliac fossa, in a 17-year-old girl. Despite an apparently adequate initial operation, the tumor proved fatal within 18 months. The authors provide a historical review of the literature on retroperitoneal teratomas. The case illustrates the aggressive course that can follow surgery for teratoma in an atypical site, and the review places it within the broader historical understanding of the condition.

pmid-1275866.summary_ja: 1976年の報告で、ターナー症候群患者の性腺ストリークに生じたディスジャーミノーマを扱っています。Y染色体含有細胞は患者にも腫瘍にも検出されませんでした。性腺ストリーク内での胚細胞腫瘍発生に関わる遺伝学的要因や性腺発生異常について考察しています。
pmid-1275866.summary_en: This 1976 report describes a dysgerminoma arising in a gonadal streak in a patient with Turner's syndrome. Only two prior cases of dysgerminoma or gonadoblastoma had been published in XO Turner's syndrome. No Y-chromosome-containing cell line was detected in the patient or the tumor. The authors discuss whether a primary genetic cause or early secondary gonadal regression or dysgenesis underlies germ cell tumor development in gonadal streaks, emphasizing the role of the Y chromosome in gonadal dysgenesis.

pmid-1277104.summary_ja: 1976年の研究で、2施設のデータを用いて胞状奇胎と卵巣腫瘍に対する超音波診断の精度を解析しています。胞状奇胎の診断正診率は約92%でした。胞状奇胎後のフォローアップで子宮内エコーの増加が侵入奇胎や絨毛癌を示唆する可能性が指摘されています。
pmid-1277104.summary_en: This 1976 study analyzes the diagnostic accuracy of ultrasonography for hydatidiform mole and ovarian tumors, using data from two institutions, SUNY Downstate and Chiba University. Ultrasound correctly diagnosed about 92 percent of hydatidiform moles. The authors note that increased intrauterine echoes in a subinvoluted uterus during postmolar follow-up may signal invasive mole or choriocarcinoma. Diagnostic error rates for ovarian tumors are also reported, with solid tumors harder to diagnose than cystic ones.

pmid-129718.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成と両側性性腺芽腫の症例で、卵巣静脈血と末梢血のステロイドを測定した研究。右側腫瘍は石灰化して内分泌活性がなかったが、生存する左側腫瘍（主にライディッヒ細胞）では、テストステロン、プロゲステロン、エストラジオールが末梢血より有意に高値であった。
pmid-129718.summary_en: A 46,XY patient with bilateral gonadoblastoma underwent measurement of steroids in ovarian and peripheral blood. The right tumor had calcified and was endocrinologically inactive, while the viable left tumor, composed largely of Leydig cells, showed elevated venous testosterone, progesterone and estradiol relative to peripheral blood. The study links viable sex cord elements in gonadoblastoma with local steroid secretion in XY gonadal dysgenesis.

pmid-132023.summary_ja: 病期II精巣奇形腫の患者26例について、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に細胞傷害性化学療法を行い、放射線療法併用の有無も検討した1976年の報告。8例（30.5%）で再発し、3年生存率は85.7%であった。播種性病変での早期化学療法の優位性を示唆し、病期IIで転移を防ぐか遅らせるだけかは未解明とした。
pmid-132023.summary_en: Twenty-six patients with stage II testicular teratoma, with metastasis confined to retroperitoneal lymph nodes, were treated after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with cytostatic chemotherapy with or without radiotherapy. Eight patients (30.5%) relapsed, with a median interval of 21 months. The three-year survival was 85.7%. The authors argue that early chemotherapy is superior to delayed treatment for widespread disease and ask whether it prevents or merely delays metastasis in stage II.

pmid-132027.summary_ja: 12歳女児の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を光顕と電顕で解析した1976年の報告。腺乳頭状および微小嚢胞網状の構造を示し、未熟細胞から分化した細胞へ至る移行像が確認された。胚細胞由来で卵黄嚢の内胚葉へ分化すると考察し、卵巣明細胞癌との超微細構造の違いも論じた。
pmid-132027.summary_en: An ovarian endodermal sinus tumor from a 12-year-old girl was analyzed by light and electron microscopy. The tumor showed glandular-papillary and microcystic areas, and ultrastructure distinguished immature cells from highly differentiated neoplastic endoderm resembling yolk sac. The authors propose that this tumor arises from germ cells and differentiates toward yolk sac endoderm, and they contrast its ultrastructure with ovarian clear cell carcinoma.

pmid-132572.summary_ja: 精巣のdysembryoplastic腫瘍に対する化学療法の有用性を論じた1976年の報告。リンパ節郭清を優先し、転移がない、または顕微鏡で1個のみの場合は1年間の化学療法、2個以上では節への放射線療法と化学療法を勧めた。郭清不能例でも、化学療法とコバルト照射の組み合わせが有効な場合があるとした。
pmid-132572.summary_en: This 1976 report examines chemotherapy for testicular dysembryoplastic tumors. Surgical lymphadenectomy is preferred when feasible: if nodes are negative or only one is found microscopically, the authors recommend one year of chemotherapy; if two or more nodes are involved, they advise nodal irradiation plus chemotherapy. When lymphadenectomy is not possible, a course of chemotherapy followed by cobalt irradiation and further chemotherapy can still help some patients.

pmid-136111.summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍29例で、化学療法のモニタリングに血清hCGを連続測定した1976年の研究。寛解の85%、安定病変の80%でhCGが正常化した一方、進行例の17%ではhCGが正常のままであった。再発の先行上昇は33%にとどまり、hCG単独では不十分で他の評価法の併用が必要とした。
pmid-136111.summary_en: In 29 patients with metastatic testicular tumors, serial hCG measurements were used to monitor cytostatic chemotherapy. Normalization of elevated hCG accompanied clinical remission in 85% and stable disease in 80%. However, 17% had normal hCG despite progressive disease, and only 33% of recurrences were preceded by a rise in hCG. Because teratomas often contain mixed tumor tissue, the authors conclude that other methods should supplement hCG monitoring.

pmid-176395.summary_ja: 1976年の報告で、ラットXC細胞およびヒトKC細胞の指示細胞株と、ウイルス非感染とされるヒト絨毛癌細胞の細胞融合を検討した。ホルモン分泌性の絨毛癌細胞はKC・XC両細胞と著明に融合したが、他のヒト細胞株では認められなかった。直接観察、伝達試験、免疫学的検査でもウイルス関与の証拠はなく、融合はウイルス非依存的と考えられた。
pmid-176395.summary_en: This 1976 study examined cell fusion between rat XC and human KC indicator cell lines and various human cell lines when cocultivated with infected cells. Several hormone-secreting human choriocarcinoma cells, which were reported to be virus-free, fused extensively with both KC and XC cells, whereas other human cell lines did not. Direct examination, transmission, and immunologic tests found no evidence of viral involvement, suggesting the fusion was not virus-mediated.

pmid-177439.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患（胞状奇胎・侵入奇胎・絨毛癌）12例で下垂体-甲状腺機能を評価した。6例で甲状腺刺激活性が検出され、TSHはほぼ検出不能でTRHに反応しなかった。治療後は活性と甲状腺ホルモン値が正常化し、TSH反応も回復した。栄養膜組織由来の異常な甲状腺刺激因子がTSH応答を抑制したと結論された。
pmid-177439.summary_en: This 1976 study assessed pituitary-thyroid function in 12 patients with trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma. Six patients had detectable thyroid-stimulating activity, with mostly undetectable TSH that did not respond to TRH, and elevated thyroid hormone levels. After treatment, thyroid-stimulating activity became undetectable, hormone levels normalized, and TSH responded to TRH. The authors concluded that an abnormal thyroid stimulator from trophoblastic tissue suppressed TSH response.

pmid-178171.summary_ja: 前縦隔の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の男性20例の剖検所見を報告した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍は局所再発が多く、セミノーマは局所制御が良好でも遠隔転移が死因となった。診断後の平均生存期間は10.9か月であった。精巣の詳細な検索で潜在性病変が見つかったのは2例のみで、大半は原発性の性腺外起源と考えられた。
pmid-178171.summary_en: This study presents autopsy findings from 20 men with clinically extragonadal germ cell tumors of the anterior mediastinum, including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratoma, choriocarcinoma, and mixed types. Non-seminomatous tumors often recurred locally, while seminomas had good local control but fatal distant metastases. Mean survival after diagnosis was 10.9 months. Careful sectioning found occult testicular tumor in only two cases, supporting a primary extragonadal origin in most patients.

pmid-178193.summary_ja: 本1976年の後方視的検討は、ハンター放射線療法センターで治療された精巣腫瘍患者63例の放射線療法の成績に焦点を当てている。病期IおよびIIの純粋セミノーマ36例は全例が治癒した。胎児性癌、奇形腫、奇形癌の成績はさまざまであった。初診時に肺転移を有していた患者と、異時性に局所肺転移を生じた患者では予後が異なることが示された。著者らは、放射線腫瘍学と腫瘍内科学の併用治療により多くの患者を救済できると結論づけている。
pmid-178193.summary_en: This 1976 retrospective review of 63 testicular tumor patients treated at the Hunter Radiation Therapy Center focused on radiation therapy outcomes. All 36 patients with Stage I and II pure seminoma were cured. Outcomes for embryonal carcinoma, teratoma, and teratocarcinoma varied. The authors found that patients who presented with pulmonary metastases had a different prognosis from those who developed localized lung metastases metachronously, and concluded that combined radiation and medical oncology efforts can salvage many patients.

pmid-178398.summary_ja: 1947〜1974年にグラスゴーの小児病院で卵巣腫瘍と診断された小児25例を検討した。悪性8例、良性17例であった。悪性例では悪性奇形腫の2例が死亡し、残る6例は無病生存していた。良性例は卵管卵巣摘出術または卵巣摘出術で治療された。悪性例では手術単独または深部X線療法や化学療法が併用された。
pmid-178398.summary_en: This 27-year review from Glasgow describes 25 children treated for ovarian neoplasms between 1947 and 1974: eight malignant and seventeen benign tumors. Benign cases underwent salpingo-oophorectomy or oophorectomy. Malignant cases received surgery alone or with deep X-ray therapy and/or chemotherapy. Two patients with malignant teratoma died, while six others with malignant teratoma, dysgerminoma, or endodermal sinus tumor remained well. The management of these patients is discussed.

pmid-178674.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌の多能性幹細胞である胎児性癌（EC）細胞を5-ブロモデオキシウリジン（BrdU）で処理した。2〜4日間の処理で形態が変化したが、増殖能は未処理培養と同程度であった。BrdU処理EC細胞はSV40およびポリオーマウイルスへの感受性が著明に増加し、未処理細胞は感染に抵抗性を示した。BrdUがEC細胞を修飾し、DNAウイルス感染を可能にすると考えられた。
pmid-178674.summary_en: This 1976 study treated murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) stem cells from a teratocarcinoma with 5-bromodeoxyuridine (BrdU). Treatment for 2-4 days at 1-50 μg/ml altered cell morphology while preserving growth potential similar to untreated cultures. BrdU-treated EC cells became markedly more susceptible to infection by simian virus 40 and polyoma virus, whereas untreated cells were resistant. The authors suggest BrdU modifies EC cells to permit infection with these two DNA viruses.

pmid-178934.summary_ja: 化学療法や放射線療法後も残存、またはリンパ節郭清後に再発した精巣腫瘍の後腹膜転移11例に対して再開腹を行った。4例では良性奇形腫や線維化のみで、不要な治療を回避できた。有症状の大きな腫瘤を有する7例中5例で症状が改善した。9例が6か月〜4年生存し、2例は再発腫瘍で死亡した。完全切除可能で良性組織のみの場合は予後良好と考えられた。
pmid-178934.summary_en: This paper reports re-exploration of the retroperitoneum in 11 patients with testicular tumors who had persistent or recurrent retroperitoneal masses after lymphadenectomy, chemotherapy, or irradiation. Four had only benign teratoma and/or fibrosis, avoiding unnecessary further therapy. Five of seven patients with symptomatic bulky masses improved. Nine survived 6 months to 4 years, while two died of recurrent tumor. Completely resectable masses with benign histology were associated with a good prognosis.

pmid-179692.summary_ja: 1976年の総説で、腫瘍マーカーとしての絨毛性ゴナドトロピン（CG）を検討した。CGは絨毛癌および妊娠性絨毛性疾患で最初に信頼できる指標となり、栄養膜合胞体細胞由来のため腫瘍量の推定にも用いられた。精巣および卵巣の絨毛癌の男女患者の管理に用いられている。非栄養膜性悪性腫瘍でもCG産生が示されており、治療効果や再発のモニタリング改善が期待されている。
pmid-179692.summary_en: This 1976 review examines chorionic gonadotropin (CG) as a tumor marker. CG measurement was the first reliable test for choriocarcinoma and gestational trophoblastic disease, and it estimates functional tumor mass because syncytiotrophoblasts produce it. CG is used to manage male and female patients with choriocarcinoma of the testis and ovary. Many nontrophoblastic malignancies have since been shown to produce CG, and research aims to improve monitoring of tumor response and recurrence.

pmid-179695.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療の歴史と現状を概説した総説です。非転移性および転移性病変を扱い、転移例の約半数は胞状奇胎が先行すると述べています。hCG測定は診断・管理・フォローアップに重要です。低リスク例は単剤化学療法で治癒率95〜100%、高リスク例は多剤化学療法で約75%とされています。
pmid-179695.summary_en: A review of treatment for gestational trophoblastic disease, covering nonmetastatic and metastatic cases. About half of metastatic cases were preceded by a hydatidiform mole. Sensitive hCG assays are essential for diagnosis, management, and follow-up. Low-risk metastatic disease is treated with single-agent chemotherapy, with cure rates of 95-100%. High-risk disease receives multiagent chemotherapy, with about 75% cure. Unresolved questions are also discussed.

pmid-180043.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の女性21例について、胞状奇胎や絨毛癌の組織、血漿、尿中のhCGとそのサブユニットの型を分析しました。化学療法に反応した例では遊離サブユニットのないhCGのみが認められました。広範に転移して死亡した例では、腫瘍と血漿に遊離サブユニットが認められました。腫瘍性栄養膜でhCG合成が変化していることを示します。
pmid-180043.summary_en: Analyzed hCG and its subunit forms in molar tissue, choriocarcinoma, and patient plasma and urine from 21 women with gestational trophoblastic disease. Patients who responded to chemotherapy had intact hCG without free subunits. Women with widely metastatic, fatal disease had free hCG subunits in tumor extracts and plasma. The results indicate altered hCG synthesis in neoplastic trophoblast. The absence of free alpha subunit in responders may be a favorable marker.

pmid-182351.summary_ja: 子宮筋層に浸潤する胎盤部位の良性病変、栄養膜偽腫瘍の12例を報告しました。絨毛癌などの悪性腫瘍と誤認されやすいことを示しています。浸潤細胞にhCGが局在していました。無月経と子宮腫大で発症することが多く、子宮穿孔が主な合併症で、1例が死亡しました。多くの生存例は無病で、良性の経過と考えられます。
pmid-182351.summary_en: Describes twelve cases of trophoblastic pseudotumor of the uterus, a placental-site lesion involving myometrial invasion that can mimic malignancy, especially choriocarcinoma. HCG was localized to invasive cells by immunoenzyme staining. Most patients presented with amenorrhea and uterine enlargement. Uterine perforation was the main complication, with one death. Most survivors remained disease-free, supporting a likely benign course.

pmid-182354.summary_ja: 1957〜1973年に治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍317例を解析しました。先行妊娠の結果、ABO血液型、年齢がリスクに影響しました。尿中hCG量、頭蓋内転移、腫瘍の大きさなどが予後因子でした。HLAは影響しませんでした。診断時に予後と薬剤耐性を予測するスコアリングシステムが提案されています。
pmid-182354.summary_en: Study of 317 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors treated from 1957 to 1973. Risk factors included the outcome of the antecedent pregnancy, ABO blood groups, and age. Prognostic factors included urinary hCG burden, interval to chemotherapy, intracranial metastases, and tumor size. HLA typing had no effect. A scoring system was proposed to predict prognosis and drug resistance at diagnosis.

pmid-184930.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞から得た胚様体を体外で分化させ、クレアチンホスホキナーゼとプラスミノゲンアクチベーターの活性を追跡しました。分化に伴いCPKは上昇し、腫瘍形成能は低下しました。SV40で形質転換したクローン細胞株では両酵素が相互排他的に発現し、発生経路を体外で再構築する材料として有用と考えられます。
pmid-184930.summary_en: Mouse teratocarcinoma cells derived from embryoid bodies were differentiated in vitro, with creatine phosphokinase and plasminogen activator tracked. CPK rose with differentiation, and tumorigenicity declined. SV40-transformed cloned lines showed mutually exclusive enzyme profiles, suggesting these lines could help reconstruct developmental pathways in vitro.

pmid-185553.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍30例の臨床病理学的解析です。全体の生存率は46%、病期I例では50%でした。病期Iの予後は腫瘍径と組織構成に依存し、卵黄嚢腫瘍や絨毛癌成分が多いと予後不良でした。10cm未満の腫瘍は全例生存しており、血清hCG高値は病期分類と治療効果判定に有用と示唆されました。
pmid-185553.summary_en: This study analyzed 30 ovarian malignant mixed germ cell tumors to compare their behavior with pure malignant germ cell tumors. Dysgerminoma was the most frequent component, followed by endodermal sinus tumor and teratoma. Overall survival was 46%, and 50% for Stage I disease. Prognosis in Stage I depended on tumor size and histologic composition: endodermal sinus tumor, choriocarcinoma, or grade 3 teratoma components predicted poor outcome, while tumors under 10 cm all survived. Elevated serum hCG in 38% of nonpregnant patients suggested its use in staging and monitoring.

pmid-185908.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者1,104例とその夫を対象に、HLA抗原と細胞性免疫を検討した研究です。ABO血液型に健常者との差はありませんでした。絨毛癌では特定のHLA不適合が見られ、予後不良群ではMLC値が低値でした。免疫学的因子が予後に関連する可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-185908.summary_en: This study examined histocompatibility antigens and cell-mediated immunity in 1,104 patients with trophoblastic neoplasia and their husbands. No ABO blood group differences were found compared with healthy persons. Anti-HLA antibodies were more frequent in destructive mole. Patients with choriocarcinoma showed HLA incompatibilities, with different antigens associated with good and poor prognosis. Mixed lymphocyte culture values were lower in choriocarcinoma, especially in the poor-prognosis group, suggesting immunologic factors may relate to outcome.

pmid-1891.summary_ja: 45歳男性の両側腹腔内精巣に生じた精巣セミノーマの症例報告です。上葉肺炎での入院中に偶然発見されました。両側の変性した停留精巣を前立腺小室とともに外科的に摘除し、患者は放射線療法を拒否しました。停留精巣に生じる胚細胞腫瘍の稀な例として示されています。
pmid-1891.summary_en: A case of bilateral seminoma arising in intra-abdominal testes in a 45-year-old man is described. The tumor was found incidentally during admission for upper lobe pneumonia. Both degenerated undescended testes were surgically removed along with the prostatic utricle. The patient declined radiotherapy. The report highlights the rare occurrence of seminoma in bilateral intra-abdominal (undescended) testes, which is relevant to the management of germ cell tumors arising in cryptorchid testes.

pmid-193022.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎から侵入奇胎、絨毛癌へと進行する妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の病態をまとめた総説です。進行に伴い異数性が増加します。正常妊娠の絨毛組織の排除に似て、病期を問わず自然退縮が起こりうると述べています。化学療法がよく効く理由として、母体と胎児由来組織の遺伝的差異による免疫的排除が関係すると考察しています。
pmid-193022.summary_en: This review describes gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, a spectrum progressing from hydatidiform mole to invasive mole and choriocarcinoma, with increasing aneuploidy. It proposes that spontaneous tumor regression, analogous to rejection of normal trophoblast, can occur at any disease stage. The authors suggest that the unusual chemosensitivity of trophoblastic disease may reflect this natural tendency toward rejection, which is thought to stem from genetic disparity between the maternal host and fetal-origin tumor tissue.

pmid-3117.summary_ja: 1934年から1973年にメモリアル病院で治療された、停留精巣の既往を持つ精巣がん45例を解析した研究である。セミノーマの5年生存率は78%、その他の組織型は29%だった。術後照射を受けた生存者の多くは、6年から28年にわたり再発なく経過した。停留精巣の既往と腫瘍発生・予後の関連が示された。
pmid-3117.summary_en: This Memorial Hospital analysis of 45 men with testicular cancer and a history of cryptorchidism (1934 to 1973) found ipsilateral or contralateral tumors developing years after repair or in untreated testes. Histology included seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, and teratocarcinomas. Five-year survival was 78% for seminoma and 29% for other types, with better survival in unrepaired than repaired patients. Most survivors who received postoperative irradiation remained free of recurrence for six to 28 years.

pmid-3662.summary_ja: 1950年から1970年に米国陸軍に勤務した男性を対象に、精巣がん患者596例と対照602例を比較した症例対照研究である。停留精巣の既往は精巣がんのリスクを約8.8倍高めた。既往のある患者ではセミノーマが約2倍多かった。鼠径ヘルニアの既往はリスクを約2.9倍とした。片側停留精巣の症例では腫瘍の側が一致する傾向がみられ、ヘルニアの側とは関連がなかった。
pmid-3662.summary_en: This case-control study compared 596 men with testicular cancer to 602 unaffected U.S. Army veterans who served between 1950 and 1970, using routine service medical records. Undescended testis was associated with 8.8 times the risk of testicular cancer, and seminoma was nearly twice as frequent among patients with a cryptorchidism history. A history of inguinal hernia conferred a 2.9-fold risk. In unilateral cases, the tumor was on the side of the undescended testis in 12 of 14 patients, while hernia side and tumor side were unrelated.

pmid-55299.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の患者9例を対象に、治療中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の血清値を連続測定した研究である。hCGは8例、AFPは5例で上昇し、4例は両方が上昇していた。化学療法中に腫瘍が縮小しなくても、マーカーは適切に低下した。再発時には一方または両方のマーカーの上昇が見られ、連続測定が治療反応の評価に有用とされた。
pmid-55299.summary_en: Nine patients with germinal cell tumors had serial measurements of hCG and AFP by double-antibody radioimmunoassay during treatment. Eight had elevated hCG and five had elevated AFP, with four showing both. Serial levels tracked disease activity in all patients, including cases where tumor masses persisted during chemotherapy while markers fell appropriately. Reactivation was seen as the emergence of only one marker in one patient, and rises in one or both markers coincided with recurrence in others. The authors conclude that serial AFP and hCG measurements aid response assessment and therapeutic decisions.

pmid-55661.summary_ja: この Lancet 誌の論説は、卵巣奇形腫と精巣奇形腫がなぜ異なる挙動を示すのかを検討し、悪性型が異なる年齢で発生することを論じている。悪性奇形腫の発症時期を、卵形成、精子形成、胚細胞の細胞間橋形成の時期と比較している。卵巣奇形腫は単為発生で活性化された卵母細胞に似ており、精巣奇形腫は減数分裂後の融合事象に由来する可能性があると提案している。移植実験から、悪性の潜在能力は突然変異よりも遺伝子制御に依存することが示唆される。
pmid-55661.summary_en: This Lancet commentary explores why ovarian and testicular teratomas behave differently, with malignant forms arising at different ages. It compares the timing of malignant teratoma onset with oogenesis, spermatogenesis, and periods of germ cell intercellular bridge formation. It proposes that ovarian teratomas resemble parthenogenetically activated oocytes, whereas testicular teratocarcinomas may arise from post-meiotic fusion events. Transplantation experiments suggest that malignant potential depends on gene control rather than mutational events.

pmid-56218.summary_ja: 1949年から1974年にインディアナ大学病院で診療された卵黄嚢腫瘍14例(性腺10例、性腺外4例)の解析である。部位によらず組織像は類似していた。予後は不良だったが、3例は化学療法に反応した。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を測定した6例のうち4例が陽性で、AFPは残存または再発病変の指標となりうると示唆された。
pmid-56218.summary_en: This series reviews 14 yolk sac carcinomas, ten gonadal and four extragonadal, treated at Indiana University Hospitals from 1949 to 1974. Histology was similar regardless of site, showing the endodermal sinus pattern and a rare polyvesicular vitelline form. Prognosis was unfavorable, though three patients responded to chemotherapy. Among six patients with serum AFP results, four were positive, and three of these had residual or metastatic disease. The authors suggest AFP can indicate residual or recurrent disease, supporting yolk sac origin.

pmid-57717.summary_ja: 本免疫細胞化学的・定量的研究は、内胚葉洞(卵黄嚢)腫瘍について、腫瘍組織と患者血清のα1-アンチトリプシン(AAT)およびαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を測定した。両タンパクは過ヨウ素酸シッフ陽性の硝子様小球と腫瘍上皮細胞に認められ、AATが優位であった。治療中、血清中の両者は並行して低下した。著者らはAATを腫瘍タンパクマーカーとして初めて特徴づけ、卵黄嚢起源を支持する証拠とした。
pmid-57717.summary_en: This immunocytochemical and quantitative study examined endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors for alpha1-antitrypsin (AAT) and alpha-fetoprotein (AFP), measuring both in tumor tissue and patient sera. Both proteins appeared within periodic acid-Schiff-positive hyaline globules and in tumor epithelial cells, with AAT predominating. Serum levels of both fell in parallel during therapy. The authors identify AAT as a tumor protein marker and show parallel AAT-AFP behavior, supporting yolk sac origin.

pmid-57935.summary_ja: 絨毛上皮腫と胞状奇胎の患者における血清の妊娠特異的β1-グロブリンを検討した研究である。絨毛上皮腫35例中74.3%、胞状奇胎25例中80%で陽性であった。β1-グロブリンは絨毛性腫瘍の患者の血清にのみ認められた。この免疫化学的血清検査の診断的・予後的意義が論じられている。
pmid-57935.summary_en: This study localized pregnancy-specific beta1-globulin (beta1-GP) in placental trophoblast and chorioepithelioma tissue by immunofluorescence. Using immunoautoradiography, beta1-GP was detected in the sera of 74.3% of 35 patients with chorioepithelioma and 80% of 25 patients with hydatidiform or destructive mole, and was found only in trophoblastic tumor patients. The authors discuss the diagnostic and prognostic significance of this serum test in trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-5796.summary_ja: 腹腔内精巣に生じたセミノーマの症例報告で、まれな異所性発生である。患者では肝酵素異常とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の上昇がみられ、原発巣の外科的摘出後にいずれも正常化した。著者らは関連文献を検討し、これらの異常な検査所見の診断およびフォローアップにおける臨床的意義について論じている。
pmid-5796.summary_en: A case report of seminoma arising in an abdominal testis, a rare ectopic location. The patient showed abnormal liver enzymes and elevated human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG). Both findings normalized after surgical removal of the primary lesion, suggesting a link between the tumor and these laboratory abnormalities. The authors review the relevant literature and discuss the clinical implications of these unusual findings for diagnosis and follow-up of testicular seminoma.

pmid-58998.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣悪性腫瘍の患者10例の報告で、化学療法後に完全寛解または臨床病期の低下が得られた後、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。この手術により残存病変をより正確に評価でき、手術所見がさらなる薬物療法の要否の判断に役立った。著者らは、慎重に選択された患者において、この手術が進行精巣がん治療の有用な補助療法となりうると示唆している。
pmid-58998.summary_en: This report describes ten patients with advanced non-seminomatous testicular malignancy who achieved complete remission or clinical stage reduction after chemotherapy. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy was then performed. The procedure allowed more accurate assessment of residual disease, and the operative findings guided decisions about whether further drug therapy was needed. The authors suggest that, in carefully selected patients, this surgery serves as useful adjunctive treatment in advanced testicular cancer management.

pmid-60126.summary_ja: 絨毛癌を発症した初産婦におけるHLA抗体を調べ、先行する子どもから受け継いだ父親由来抗原による免疫化の証拠を示した研究です。複雑な産科歴を持つ2例にも同じ手法を適用し、原因となった妊娠を推定しました。父親のHLA抗原への感作と絨毛癌の発生との関連を、免疫遺伝学的な観点から示しています。
pmid-60126.summary_en: This study examined HLA antibodies in primiparous women who later developed choriocarcinoma. The findings provided evidence that these patients had been immunized against paternal antigens inherited by the antecedent child. The same approach was applied to two patients with complicated obstetric histories to determine which pregnancy was likely the causal one. The work links immune sensitization to paternal HLA with the origin of choriocarcinoma, offering an immunogenetic perspective on the disease.

pmid-60168.summary_ja: 後腹膜の卵黄嚢腫瘍を有し、血清中にαフェトプロテインが検出された症例を報告しています。剖検で右精巣に単純な嚢胞性奇形腫も見つかり、両腫瘍が併存していました。この組み合わせは以前にも報告があるとしています。悪性胚細胞腫瘍の分類と進展の理解に、血清AFPの検出が役立つと論じています。
pmid-60168.summary_en: The authors report a patient with a retroperitoneal endodermal sinus tumor whose serum contained alpha1-fetoprotein. Autopsy also revealed a simple cystic teratoma of the right testicle, so both tumors coexisted. The authors note that this combination has been reported before. They argue that the discovery of serum AFP in these patients may help classify malignant germ cell tumors and clarify their evolution, since AFP is frequently detected in such cases.

pmid-60993.summary_ja: 女性化乳房の男性の乳腺組織で、αフェトプロテインの産生を免疫組織化学的に初めて示した報告です。患者は転移性の性腺悪性奇形芽腫を有しており、乳管上皮にA1FPが検出されました。A1FP産生は悪性腫瘍に特異的なのか、原発腫瘍からのホルモン性増殖刺激に対する細胞応答なのかを考察しています。
pmid-60993.summary_en: The authors demonstrate, for the first time, immunohistochemical evidence of alpha-1-fetoprotein (A1FP) in the mammary gland of a man with gynecomastia. The patient had a metastasizing malignant teratoblastoma of the gonads, and A1FP was detected in the intraductal epithelium. The paper discusses whether A1FP synthesis is characteristic of malignant tumors or instead reflects a cellular response to hormonal growth stimuli from the primary tumor.

pmid-61802.summary_ja: 血清AFPが高値の患者から得た精巣腫瘍の組織片を体外培養し、AFPなどの血清蛋白の合成を示しました。卵黄嚢組織を持つ腫瘍がAFPを産生しました。ラットの胎児摘出により誘発した実験的腫瘍も検討し、移植後は分化傾向が失われる一方、AFP合成は雌ラットでのみ世代を超えて維持されたと報告しています。
pmid-61802.summary_en: The study cultured slices of human testicular tumors from patients with high serum AFP and demonstrated synthesis of AFP and other serum proteins in vitro. Tumors with yolk sac histology produced AFP. The authors also established experimental tumors in rats by fetectomy, which contained teratoma, yolk sac tumor, and immature components. These transplantable tumors lost well-differentiated features after passage, and AFP synthesis persisted across generations in female rats only.

pmid-61803.summary_ja: 移植可能なマウス奇形癌から、さまざまな細胞株が樹立されたことを報告しています。一部は胎児性癌(EC)細胞に相当し、腫瘍内や体外で全ての分化組織へ分化しうる悪性の幹細胞です。EC細胞には多能性胚細胞と共通する生化学的・抗原的特徴があります。分化能や腫瘍形成能の異なる変異株も示し、マウスの発生研究に有用としています。
pmid-61803.summary_en: This paper describes the isolation of various cell lines from transplantable mouse teratocarcinomas. Some correspond to embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, which are malignant stem cells that can differentiate into all tissues of the tumor or in vitro. EC cells share biochemical and antigenic traits with multipotential embryonic cells. The authors also describe in vivo and in vitro variants with altered differentiation, tumorigenicity, or antigenic profiles, including non-EC lines resembling extra-embryonic tissues, which are valuable for studying mouse development.

pmid-61820.summary_ja: 多能性を持つ胎児性癌細胞PCC4aza1と成熟マウスの胸腺細胞を融合し、体細胞ハイブリッドを作製しました。これらは移植後に分化組織と胎児性癌様の領域を含む腫瘍を形成し、一部はαフェトプロテインを産生しました。分化した体細胞の完全な二倍体ゲノムを導入しても、胎児性癌細胞の多能性は失われないことを示しています。
pmid-61820.summary_en: The authors fused pluripotent PCC4aza1 embryonal carcinoma cells with thymocytes from adult mice to create somatic cell hybrids. When these hybrids formed tumors in nude or syngeneic mice, the tumors contained differentiated tissues along with embryonal carcinoma-like areas. Some tumors produced alpha-fetoprotein. The findings show that embryonal carcinoma cell pluripotency is not lost even when a complete diploid genome from a differentiated cell is introduced into the hybrid.

pmid-62607.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌で手術を受けた26例の血清51検体について、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を放射免疫測定法で測定した研究である。AFPは良好な予後指標となり、転移を有する例や後に転移を来した例で高値を示すことが多かった。AFPの経時的変化から治療効果の評価と腫瘍の進展の把握が可能であることを示した。
pmid-62607.summary_en: The authors measured alpha-fetoprotein by radioimmunoassay in 51 serum samples from 26 men operated on for testicular embryonal carcinoma. AFP levels had good prognostic value. Elevated levels were frequently seen in patients who had metastases or who later developed them. Serial AFP kinetics allowed monitoring of treatment efficiency and provided insight into the evolution of the cancer.

pmid-62608.summary_ja: 性腺および性腺外由来の純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍7例を免疫蛍光法で検討した研究である。全例で腫瘍細胞と硝子様小球にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の陽性所見が局所的に認められた。アルブミンなどの血漿蛋白も検出され、硝子様小球が循環血中の蛋白を取り込むことが示唆された。
pmid-62608.summary_en: Immunofluorescence was used to examine seven pure yolk sac tumors of gonadal and extragonadal origin. All showed focal, bright AFP staining in tumor cells and hyaline globules. Albumin, alpha-1 antitrypsin and transferrin were also detected in yolk sac tumors, while other plasma proteins were present only in some tumors, mainly within hyaline globules. Both IgG and IgA were found in two ovarian tumors. The findings suggest that globules take up proteins from the circulation.

pmid-62610.summary_ja: 尿中hCG排泄が低値または消失していた妊娠性絨毛癌11例で、腫瘍関連抗原を測定した研究である。3例で血清hCGβサブユニットが検出され、AFPは全例正常であった。治療後にCEAの上昇は正常化した。AFPは妊娠と絨毛性疾患の鑑別に有用かもしれず、絨毛癌の寛解評価には血清hCGが重要であると結論づけている。
pmid-62610.summary_en: Circulating levels of four tumor- or trophoblast-associated antigens were measured in 11 patients with gestational choriocarcinoma when urinary hCG was low or negligible. Serum hCG beta-subunit was detected in three patients, and AFP was normal in all. Elevated CEA normalized with treatment. The authors conclude that AFP may help distinguish pregnancy from trophoblastic disease, while serum hCG remains essential for monitoring remission in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-62720.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍8例の臨床病理所見を検討した。6例で術後に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇がみられ、1例を除き、AFPは術後の放射線療法や化学療法による腫瘍の進行・退縮と密接に相関した。8例中4例は、AFPが正常範囲で臨床的に腫瘍の所見なく生存していた。著者らは、AFPが術後治療のモニタリングに信頼できる指標であると結論づけた。
pmid-62720.summary_en: The clinical and pathological findings of eight cases of ovarian endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor were reviewed. Six patients had raised serum AFP after surgery, and in all but one, AFP correlated closely with tumor progression or regression during postoperative radiotherapy and/or chemotherapy. Four of eight patients were alive with normal AFP and no clinical evidence of disease. AFP was considered a reliable parameter for monitoring postoperative treatment.

pmid-63318.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍71例の臨床病理学的解析である。免疫組織化学で検討した15例のすべてでAFPが検出された。フォローアップ可能な65例中、生存者は9例、3年実測生存率は13%であった。腫瘍のサイズと病期が予後因子であり、年齢や組織像は予後因子ではなかった。病期Iの患者の84%に潜在性の転移が認められた。著者らは、血清AFPが治療反応のモニタリングに有用である可能性を示唆している。
pmid-63318.summary_en: The clinical and pathological features of 71 ovarian endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors were analyzed. AFP was detected in all 15 tumors examined immunohistochemically. Only nine of 65 patients with follow-up survived, with actuarial survival of 13% at 3 years. Tumor size and stage were prognostic, whereas age and histology were not. Subclinical metastasis was present in 84% of Stage I patients. Serum AFP may be useful for monitoring therapy response.

pmid-63319.summary_ja: 成人精巣の胚性癌に類似する卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍15例を記述し、卵黄嚢腫瘍とは区別されるとした。検査した10腫瘍のうちhCGは全例、AFPは7例に陽性で、両者は異なる細胞型に局在していた。9例に異常なホルモン所見が認められた。全体の生存率は39%、病期Iでは50%であった。著者らは、この卵巣腫瘍に対して「胚性癌」という用語を提唱している。
pmid-63319.summary_en: Fifteen ovarian germ cell tumors resembling adult testicular embryonal carcinoma, distinct from endodermal sinus tumor, were described. hCG was present in all 10 tumors tested and AFP in seven, in different cell types. Nine patients had abnormal hormonal manifestations. Actuarial survival was 39% overall and 50% for Stage I. The authors propose the term embryonal carcinoma for this ovarian neoplasm.

pmid-63567.summary_ja: ラットの原発性卵黄嚢癌1例と移植可能な卵黄嚢癌3例を用い、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を免疫蛍光抗体法で検討した研究である。AFPは特徴的な内胚葉様構造のみに認められた。胎児性癌細胞には検出されなかった。このラットモデルにおいてAFPは内胚葉分化に局在することを示した。
pmid-63567.summary_en: Alpha-fetoprotein was demonstrated by immunofluorescent antibody staining in one primary and three transplantable rat yolk sac carcinomas. AFP was seen only in structures with a characteristic endodermal appearance. It was not detected in embryonal carcinoma cells. The results show that AFP localizes to endodermal differentiation in this rat model.

pmid-63968.summary_ja: 1976年の報告で、6例の陰茎癌と6例の精巣腫瘍に対しブレオマイシンを単独または他剤・放射線・手術と併用した。早期陰茎癌では完全奏効が得られたが、進行例では効果不十分であった。精巣の奇形腫・胎児性癌・絨毛癌では全例で顕著な奏効が見られ、その生物学的作用の違いを考察している。
