pmid-5259759.summary_en: This 1969 PNAS study examined gene loss in benign cystic ovarian teratomas (dermoid cysts) to test whether these tumors arise from a germ cell that has undergone meiosis. Using three independently segregating allelic isozymes, the authors compared 11 tumors with matched normal tissue from the same patients. Several dermoid cysts from heterozygous women were homozygous for the same gene product, consistent with origin from a meiotic germ cell with varying degrees of crossing-over. The work provides early genetic evidence for the origin of ovarian teratomas.

pmid-5347178.summary_ja: 1969年の本研究は、胞状奇胎後の侵入奇胎および絨毛癌100例に対する化学療法の成績を検討しています。奇胎後6か月以内に治療を開始した群では60例中57例で持続寛解が得られ、遅延群では耐性や毒性が増えました。予防的化学療法の有効性は確立されておらず、絨毛性ゴナドトロピン測定を用いた綿密なフォローアップの重要性が強調されています。
pmid-5347178.summary_en: This 1969 British Medical Journal study reviewed 100 patients with invasive hydatidiform mole or choriocarcinoma following mole treated with chemotherapy and other modalities. Treatment started within six months of mole yielded sustained remission in 57 of 60 patients, whereas delayed treatment beyond six months produced resistance, more toxicity, and remission in 22 of 40. The authors found prophylactic chemotherapy after mole unproven and emphasized careful follow-up using sensitive hCG assays. They suggested regionalized follow-up services to reduce deaths from late diagnosis of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-5784983.summary_ja: 1969年の本報告は、卵巣奇形腫が腹膜に神経膠組織の病巣を生じた腹膜神経膠腫症の症例と、既報告12例を集計したものです。予後は根治的手術か単純切除かよりも、原発腫瘍と腹膜病変の組織の成熟度に主に依存すると述べられています。致死例では急速な再発と転移が見られ、26年の生存例も報告されています。
pmid-5784983.summary_en: This 1969 Journal of Clinical Pathology report describes a case of ovarian teratoma producing glial deposits on the peritoneum, termed gliomatosis peritonei, and tabulates 12 previously published cases. Patients ranged from 22 months to 22 years old, with a mean age of 14.6 years. The authors found that prognosis depended mainly on tissue maturity of the primary tumour and peritoneal deposits rather than on radical versus simple excision. Fatal cases showed rapid recurrence and metastatic spread. Survival of up to 26 years was recorded, and the pathogenesis of the glial deposits is discussed.

pmid-5813031.summary_ja: 1969年のCalifornia Medicine誌掲載記事で、サンフランシスコのカリフォルニア大学医療センター内科の週例カンファレンスを書き起こしたものです。主題は絨毛癌です。抄録には収録や編集に関する情報しかなく、臨床データや治療成績は含まれていないため、内容の詳細には全文が必要です。
pmid-5813031.summary_en: This 1969 California Medicine article presents a transcribed weekly staff conference discussion from the Department of Medicine, University of California Medical Center, San Francisco, under the direction of Dr. Lloyd H. Smith, Jr. The conference is titled Choriocarcinoma, indicating that the case discussion centers on this gestational trophoblastic tumour. The available abstract contains only editorial information about the transcription and preparation, and does not provide clinical details, treatment data, or outcomes. The full text would be needed for clinical content.

pmid-4301498.summary_ja: 1968年の症例報告で、左精巣のセミノーマから多発性の栄養膜奇形腫性転移をきたして死亡した例を記載しています。文献上の類似例もまとめ、奇形腫がセミノーマに由来するとの説を支持する証拠と考察しています。精巣腫瘍の組織発生を考える上で歴史的に重要な報告です。
pmid-4301498.summary_en: This 1968 J Clin Pathol paper reports a fatal case in which a left testicular seminoma gave rise to multiple trophoblastic teratomatous metastases. The authors review similar cases in the literature and discuss the morphogenesis of testicular tumours. They conclude that these cases provide evidence supporting a seminomatous origin for teratomas, an important point in the histogenesis of germ cell tumours. The report is historically notable for linking seminoma and teratoma pathways in testicular neoplasms.

pmid-5212306.summary_ja: 1968年のCancer誌の文献レビューで、良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の悪性転化を文献上272例から集計しています。扁平上皮癌が最多で、肉腫は少数でした。新たに43例を追加し、軟骨肉腫とカルチノイド腫瘍の症例を報告しています。嚢胞壁を越えて進展した例では予後不良でした。
pmid-5212306.summary_en: This 1968 Cancer review examines malignant transformation of benign cystic ovarian teratomas, compiling 272 cases from the literature. Squamous carcinoma was the most common histology, and sarcomas were uncommon. The authors tabulate 43 additional cases published since 1957, with a mean patient age of 55 years, and report the first chondrosarcoma and the fourteenth carcinoid tumour arising in such a tumour. Prognosis was poor when the tumour had extended through the cyst wall and good otherwise.

pmid-5637501.summary_ja: 1968年の報告で、若年者の左上葉の気管支内に位置した奇形腫を記載しています。画像では菌球腫に類似していました。肺内奇形腫としては極めて稀な気管支内発生で、周囲肺の気管支拡張症や細気管支拡張症との関係を考察しています。
pmid-5637501.summary_en: This 1968 Thorax report describes a young patient with a teratoma located endobronchially in the left upper lobe, which radiologically simulated a mycetoma. Left lung resection showed the tumour was endobronchial, a very rare site, as only one of 15 previously reported intrapulmonary teratomas was endobronchial. The remaining lung showed widespread bronchiectasis and bronchiolectasis, which the authors suggest caused the nodular shadows. They discuss the relationship between these changes and the teratoma.

pmid-5697367.summary_ja: 1968年の報告で、脾臓摘出と卵巣類皮嚢腫の摘出後に寛解した自己免疫性溶血性貧血を記載しています。抗体は術後に消失し、卵巣腫瘍との因果関係が示唆されました。発症機序を考察し、既報14例をレビューしています。卵巣奇形腫と自己免疫性溶血の関連を示した初期の報告です。
pmid-5697367.summary_en: This 1968 J Clin Pathol report describes autoimmune haemolytic anaemia that resolved after splenectomy and removal of an ovarian dermoid cyst. Antibody disappeared following surgery, strongly suggesting a causal relationship between the ovarian tumour and the haemolytic disease. The authors discuss possible pathogenic mechanisms and review fourteen previously recorded cases of this association. It is an early description of a link between ovarian teratoma and autoimmune haemolysis.

pmid-5753554.summary_ja: 1968年のScience誌の報告で、ヒト妊娠性絨毛癌由来の体外培養細胞株BeWOの樹立を記載しています。この細胞は18か月間にわたり機能的ホルモンを高い水準で合成しました。代謝は主に解糖系で、培地のグルコース濃度に依存しました。胎盤と腫瘍細胞の多くの特性を示す多能性モデルとして有用と述べています。
pmid-5753554.summary_en: This 1968 Science paper describes the establishment of BeWO, a permanent in vitro cell line derived from human gestational choriocarcinoma. The cells maintained a high degree of functional hormone synthesis for 18 months in culture. Their metabolism was predominantly glycolytic and depended on medium glucose levels. The authors note that the line reproduces many features of placental and tumour-cell metabolism, growth and differentiation, making it a useful multipotential model.

pmid-18623935.summary_ja: マウス精巣に移植された生殖隆起から発生する精細管内奇形癌の初期発生を、超微細構造レベルで解析した研究である。腫瘍幹細胞である胎児性癌細胞は原始胚細胞に酷似し、後者に由来すると考えられた。多分化能細胞の細胞質の特徴や、粗面小胞体・ゴルジ装置の発達など初期分化の所見が記載されている。胚細胞腫瘍の組織発生を理解するモデルを提供している。
pmid-18623935.summary_en: This 1967 ultrastructural study examined intratubular teratocarcinomas arising in mouse testes after transplanting 12-day genital ridges. Embryonal carcinoma cells, the stem cells of these tumors, closely resembled primordial germ cells, suggesting they derive from them. The authors describe the cytoplasm of these multipotential cells and the early signs of differentiation, including development of rough endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi complexes, providing a model of germ cell tumour histogenesis.

pmid-6035800.summary_ja: 1967年の報告で、肺動脈が外部から圧迫されて生じた後天性肺動脈狭窄の7例を記述しています。原因は縦隔奇形腫、ホジキン病、上行大動脈瘤で、残り4例は左右の肺動脈分枝の圧迫でした。全例で血管造影により圧迫が確認され、外因性圧迫と器質的狭窄の鑑別にはカテーテル検査と選択的造影が有用と述べています。
pmid-6035800.summary_en: This 1967 Thorax report describes seven patients with acquired pulmonary stenosis caused by external compression of the pulmonary artery. Three cases were due to anterior mediastinal teratoma, Hodgkin's disease, and ascending aortic aneurysm, while four involved compression of the right or left pulmonary artery branches. Angiography demonstrated compression in every case, and pressure tracings in bilateral compression resembled bilateral stenosis. The authors recommend cardiac catheterization with selective angiography to distinguish extrinsic compression from intrinsic stenosis and to localize the obstruction.

pmid-4286898.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍を組織発生に基づき、胚細胞、体腔上皮、特殊間質、非特殊間質・異所性要素の4群に分類する考え方を提示した論文である。全年齢では卵巣腫瘍の16%が胚細胞由来、70%が体腔上皮由来であった。20歳未満では59%、思春期前では90%が胚細胞腫瘍を占めた。正確な組織発生学的分類が適切な治療と予後評価に不可欠と強調している。
pmid-4286898.summary_en: This classic paper proposes a histogenetic classification of primary ovarian tumours into four categories: germ cell, coelomic epithelial, specialized stromal, and non-specialized stromal/heterotopic. Across all ages, 70% of ovarian neoplasms were of coelomic epithelial origin and 16% of germ cell origin. Before age 20, 59% were germ cell tumours, rising to 90% before puberty. The authors stress that accurate histogenetic classification is essential for appropriate treatment and outcome assessment.

pmid-4287056.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患の管理に関する概念を概説した総説である。組織学的に良性の腫瘍が転移する一方、悪性腫瘍が自然消退することもあり、診断の難しさが指摘されている。絨毛癌では化学療法により予後が著しく改善し、持続性・転移性疾患への適応が拡大している。子宮摘出の必要性は低下して妊孕性が温存され、生涯にわたるフォローアップが重要とされる。
pmid-4287056.summary_en: This review summarizes management concepts for trophoblastic disease, including choriocarcinoma. It notes that histologically benign tumors may metastasize while malignant ones may regress spontaneously, and that diagnosis before molar evacuation is difficult. Chemotherapy has markedly improved choriocarcinoma prognosis, and its indications are broadening for persistent and metastatic disease. Hysterectomy is becoming less necessary, preserving fertility, and lifelong active follow-up is essential.

pmid-5911908.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣未分化胚細胞腫（ディスジャーミノーマ）と全身性エリテマトーデス(SLE)が同時に認められた症例報告である。腫瘍摘出後、SLEの臨床症状および生物学的所見が急速に消失した。腫瘍と自己免疫疾患との関連の可能性について簡潔に考察している。稀な併存例として、腫瘍免疫の変化が自己免疫に影響する可能性も示唆されている。
pmid-5911908.summary_en: The authors describe a patient in whom a malignant ovarian dysgerminoma was found together with systemic lupus erythematosus. Both clinical and biological symptoms of SLE disappeared rapidly after the tumour was removed. The report is a brief observation of a rare association, and the authors discuss a possible relationship between tumours and autoimmune disorders, raising the possibility that tumour-related immune changes influence autoimmunity.

pmid-14276145.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの退縮過程を病理学的に記述した研究である。壊死、線維化、リポフスチン沈着などの段階を示し、原発性後腹膜セミノーマの診断前には瘢痕化病変の探索が必要と述べる。退縮した奇形腫様腫瘍との鑑別や、見かけ上の奇形腫様転移が誤認によるものである可能性も論じられている。鼠径リンパ節転移は陰嚢手術や精巣捻転後のリンパ流の変化で生じうるとされる。
pmid-14276145.summary_en: This study describes the stages of retrogression in testicular seminoma, including eosinophilic necrosis, fibrous replacement, and lipofuscin deposition. The authors stress that scarred lesions must be sought before diagnosing primary retroperitoneal seminoma. Retrogressed seminoma can often be distinguished from retrogressed teratoid tumours. Apparent teratoid metastases in seminoma patients are explained as misinterpreted retrogressed teratoid tumours. Inguinal node metastases may arise from altered lymphatic drainage after scrotal surgery or torsion.

pmid-14276148.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢胞）の中で、気管支上皮由来の扁平上皮癌が発生した症例の報告である。基底細胞過形成、扁平上皮化生、上皮内での悪性変化という過程をたどった。嚢胞内容物に含まれる発がん性物質がこの変化を引き起こした可能性が示唆されている。成熟奇形腫における悪性転化の稀な合併症を示す症例である。
pmid-14276148.summary_en: This case report describes a squamous cell carcinoma arising from bronchial epithelium within an ovarian cystic teratoma (dermoid). The sequence progressed through basal cell hyperplasia, squamous metaplasia, and malignant change in situ. The authors suggest that a carcinogenic constituent of the cyst contents may have driven this transformation, highlighting malignant transformation as a rare complication of mature teratomas. The case is a classic example of teratoma-associated carcinogenesis.

pmid-5839223.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の市販の免疫化学的検査（UCG、Prepuerin）を生物学的測定法と比較した研究である。免疫化学的測定は生物学的に不活性なhCGも検出するため、異常妊娠で陽性が長く続いた。嚢胞性奇形腫などの非妊娠患者でも尿中に反応物質が排泄され、腫瘍摘出後に消失した。
pmid-5839223.summary_en: This 1965 study evaluated commercial immunochemical hCG assays (UCG and Prepuerin) against the bioassay. The immunoassays detected hCG at higher concentrations than the bioassay and remained positive longer in abnormal pregnancies because they detect biologically inactive hCG. Several non-pregnant patients with ovarian cysts and cystic teratomas excreted UCG-reactive substances that disappeared after tumour removal.

pmid-19986880.summary_ja: 1929年の症例報告で、生後4か月の乳児が上前縦隔の嚢胞性腫瘤を呈し、生後9か月で死亡した。剖検により腫瘤は奇形腫であることが確認された。小児における縦隔奇形腫（性腺外胚細胞腫瘍）の発生について、詳細な臨床・病理所見とともに簡潔に考察されている。
pmid-19986880.summary_en: This 1929 case report describes a four-month-old infant with a cystic mediastinal mass, clinically evident from an early age, who died at nine months. Autopsy confirmed the mass was a teratoma located in the upper anterior mediastinum. The report briefly discusses the occurrence of mediastinal teratomas in children alongside detailed clinical and pathological findings, representing an extragonadal germ cell tumor case.
